papers.abstract: A legged robot can learn to walk inside a learned simulator: a neural network that predicts the robot's next state and is run forward on its own predictions. They are usually trained and checked one step ahead, although a policy uses them for a hundred steps or more. We audit one published system end to end, without a GPU: the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) for the ANYmal D quadruped, and the uncertainty estimate of its follow-up, RWM-U. We rebuilt the model to match the released code's outputs, losses and gradients exactly, measured 101 trained simulators, 200 compressed copies and 38 simulators of three other architectures, and trained policies inside simulators that we tested in a hand-built MuJoCo model of the robot. Training on the model's own rollouts beat one-step training at 368 steps on all ten held-out episodes (registered), although one-step training was better one step ahead. One-step checks therefore misjudge design choices: pruning 30% of the weights kept 90% of the model's skill one step ahead and 39% at 2 s. Ensemble disagreement ranked rollout error well (Spearman +0.90 at 100 steps), yet covered 4.6% of outcomes at one sigma, against 68% for a calibrated estimate, as each network's own variance collapses under the implemented loss. Two checks that need no recorded future ranked some pools of simulators well, but neither was shown better than 8-step error in a primary test. At the robot level, accuracy has not predicted walking: all 18 fine-tuned copies we tested predicted better than the released model one and eight steps ahead, yet 13 gave failing policies, and registered tests of whether any check ranks simulators by their policies were not settled. In a secondary test, running the authors' policy inside each simulator ranked them well. We also report nine of our own claims that we withdrew. Scope: one robot, one gait, simulated data, no hardware.

analysis.key_results: 在模型自身 rollout 上训练的策略在 368 步时优于一步训练（所有 10 个保留回放中）；剪枝 30% 权重保留 90% 一步预测技能但在 2 秒时仅保留 39%；集成不一致性在 100 步时与 rollout 误差的 Spearman 相关性为 +0.90，但 1-sigma 覆盖仅 4.6%，而校准估计为 68%；18 个微调副本在所有一步和八步预测上均优于发布模型，但其中 13 个给出失败策略；使用作者策略在模拟器内运行可有效排名模拟器。
analysis.limitations: 范围限于一个机器人、一种步态、模拟数据，无硬件实验；一些排名模拟器的检验未在主要测试中胜过 8 步误差。
analysis.main_contribution: 对已发表的 RWM 动力学模型和 RWM-U 不确定性估计进行彻底审计，揭示一步预测指标无法反映多步 rollout 和下游策略性能，并报告模型压缩、不确定性校准和模拟器排名方法的实测表现。
analysis.method: 重建模型以精确匹配已发布代码的输出、损失和梯度；训练 101 个模拟器、200 个压缩副本和 38 个其他架构的模拟器；在模拟器内训练策略，并在手工构建的 MuJoCo 模型中进行测试；使用 Spearman 相关性、校准分析、剪枝和 rollout 误差等指标进行审计。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文对用于 ANYmal D 四足机器人的机器人世界模型（RWM）进行端到端审计，评估其在一步预测与实际多步 rollout 中的表现，并测试模型压缩、不确定性估计及其与策略质量的关系。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对机器人世界模型（RWM），属于 WAM 的核心主题，深入审计了用于腿部机器人控制的已学模拟器的多步预测、不确定性、压缩和策略相关性，对 WAM 的评估、训练和实际部署具有直接的方法论价值。

papers.abstract: Goal-conditioned planning with image observations and goals requires predictions that distinguish visual states and action consequences. Spiking neural networks offer sparse computation, but single-step spikes can obscure motion cues and merge actions with different physical outcomes. We propose the Spiking Latent World Model (SpikWM), an end-to-end joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) with one simulation step per image and one neural update per latent position. Spiking Regional Encoding retains spatial cues through regional pooling. Bi-Spike Action Encoding combines positive and negative binary responses, while Causal Membrane Prediction carries subthreshold evidence across the latent history with learned group-wise time constants. The encoder and predictor are trained jointly on reward-free image--action trajectories using next-embedding prediction and SIGReg. With a common planner, SpikWM achieves mean success rates of $88.67\%$, $97.33\%$, $99.33\%$, and $86.67\%$ on Push-T, Two-Room, Reacher, and OGBench-Cube, respectively, outperforming two spiking baselines. Push-T ablations support each module, and controlled replays examine responses to appearance and physical state changes. Under a matched planning budget, SpikWM reduces estimated arithmetic energy by $75.6\%$ relative to LeWM. Code will be released at https://github.com/ShawnYE618/SpikWM.

analysis.key_results: 在 Push-T、Two-Room、Reacher 和 OGBench-Cube 上平均成功率分别为 88.67%、97.33%、99.33% 和 86.67%，优于两个脉冲基线；相对于 LeWM，在匹配规划预算下估计算术能量降低 75.6%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SpikWM，一种基于脉冲神经网络的世界模型，结合脉冲区域编码、双脉冲动作编码和因果膜电位预测，实现端到端联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），用于高效视觉规划。
analysis.method: 采用一个图像模拟步和一个潜变量位置神经更新步的 JEPA 架构；通过脉冲区域池化保留空间线索，双脉冲动作编码组合正负二值响应，因果膜电位预测以可学习分组时间常数传递阈下证据；编码器与预测器在无奖励图像-动作轨迹上联合训练，使用下一个嵌入预测和 SIGReg。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出端到端联合嵌入脉冲世界模型 SpikWM，以稀疏脉冲计算实现视觉目标条件规划，在低能耗下保持较高成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接属于世界模型与机器人规划范畴，提出脉冲世界模型 SpikWM 用于视觉规划，在多个机器人操作与导航任务上验证，并显著降低推理能耗，对 VLA/WAM 的高效推理具有重要参考价值。

figures.caption: SpikWM architecture and planning. Spiking Regional Encoding (SRE) combines spatial spike processing, regional pooling and an output projection. Bi-Spike Action Encoding (BAE) uses learned group thresholds and combines two binary streams through separate maps. Causal Membrane Prediction (CMP) includes conditional causal blocks, final normalization and an output projection. Within each block, LayerNorm precedes action-conditioned scaling and shifting. Shared SRE branches learn from next-latent prediction and SIGReg. The cross-entropy method replans using terminal goal distance.

papers.title_zh: SpikWM：面向视觉规划的高效端到端脉冲世界模型

papers.abstract: Visual proxies decouple explicit world-state simulation from photorealistic video synthesis, offering a controllable interface for both offline clip creation and real-time interactive streaming. Yet a practical renderer must address two challenges. Upstream proxies vary from coarse layouts to fine articulated geometry depending on the interaction, and streaming inference must operate in a few causal steps without accumulating drift across self-generated history. We present Invoker-Render, pairing a bidirectional creation model with a causal four-step streaming model under a shared conditioning interface over structural proxies, an appearance reference, and language. Trained on an aligned approximately 200-hour multi-granularity corpus, Invoker-Render honors fine geometric constraints when supplied while synthesizing plausible local motion under coarse proxies, enabling runtime selection of input detail. To bridge bidirectional creation and real-time streaming without compounding step compression and rollout drift, we introduce Progressive Forcing (ProForcing). ProForcing first trains a causal predictor and distills it into a four-step renderer using histories derived from training videos. Training then shifts to continuous self-generated rollouts. A pipelined serving stack supports efficient streaming inference. Experiments show versatile control across proxy families, granularities, and camera paths, consistent gains over recent streaming baselines, and stable 30-minute racing rollouts that preserve scene and subject appearance.

analysis.key_results: 支持多代理家族、粒度和相机路径的通用控制，较近期流式基线持续提升，并实现稳定的30分钟赛车滚动视频保持场景和主体外观。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Invoker-Render，一个配对的四步因果流式渲染器，通过统一条件接口实现多粒度视觉代理下的可控实时视频生成，并引入ProForcing解决压缩与漂移问题。
analysis.method: 配对双向创建模型与因果四步流式模型，共享结构化代理、外观参考和语言条件；使用ProForcing先训练因果预测器再蒸馏到四步渲染器，并逐步切换至自生成历史训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Invoker-Render，通过双向创建模型与四步因果流式模型配合渐进强制，实现基于结构化代理、外观参考和语言的可控实时视频生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于世界模型/视频生成范畴，不直接涉及机器人动作预测或VLA/WAM策略学习，但其可控视频生成能力可能作为机器人模拟或世界建模的素材。

(b) Self-collected GTA V and Cyberpunk 2077 examples pair each RGB source frame with matched coarse and fine proxies of the same event, where coarse proxies place canonical root-driven bodies and fine proxies track articulated limbs.

papers.abstract: Natural language-guided UAV navigation enables intuitive human-robot interaction and flexible autonomous flight in complex environments. However, reliable navigation requires accurate instruction following, continuous task progress tracking, and safe obstacle avoidance, which remain challenging for existing world-action models that primarily focus on action prediction. To address these limitations, we propose a world-action learning framework that integrates three complementary mechanisms: a language-conditioned action interface with targeted post-training for instruction-responsive motion, recurrent instruction-consumption prediction to track task progress and determine termination, and Gaussian-scene post-training to enhance obstacle avoidance through trajectory imitation and differentiable geometric feedback. Closed-loop evaluations and ablation studies demonstrate improvements in sequential task completion, safe goal reaching, and timely termination. Furthermore, direct one-step denoising reduces inference overhead, and real-world indoor and outdoor flights validate the framework's effectiveness.

analysis.key_results: 闭环评估和消融研究表明，在连续任务完成、安全目标到达和及时终止方面均有提升；直接一步去噪降低了推理开销；真实室内外飞行验证了框架有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出集成了语言条件行动接口、循环指令消耗预测和高斯场景后训练三种机制的世界-行动学习框架，以改进无人机视觉语言导航中的指令遵循、任务进度跟踪和避障。
analysis.method: 融合语言条件行动接口（针对指令响应运动的定向后训练）、循环指令消耗预测（跟踪任务进度并决定终止）以及高斯场景后训练（通过轨迹模仿和可微几何反馈增强避障）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该文提出一个世界-行动学习框架，通过语言条件行动接口、指令消耗预测和高斯场景后训练来提升无人机视觉语言导航的指令遵循与安全导航能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对无人机视觉语言导航这一机器人任务，提出世界-行动策略精化框架，属于VLA/WAM在具身导航场景下的具体应用与改进，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Recent progress in integrating vision-language-action (VLA) models with world modeling has significantly advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by allowing systems to reason about imagined futures instead of merely reacting to current observations. However, most world VLA models generate future frames at the pixel level with plenty of dense visual tokens. Although such generated futures can be visually plausible, they preserve many driving-irrelevant appearance details, i.e., only a small portion of the tokens directly encode critical planning-relevant factors, such as agent geometry, motion dynamics, and interactions. This introduces a significant performance bottleneck. An important question thus arises: what world state should a world VLA model reason over to support planning beyond pixel-level prediction? We argue that planning-oriented world modeling should focus on a compact and structured agent-centric latent state that captures the interactions between objects in the driving scene over time. As such, we introduce AgentWorld, an agent-centric VLA world model that uses discrete agent tokens jointly for reasoning and trajectory planning. Each token is dynamically grounded to a surrounding agent associated with its object's state, such as semantic identity, 3D geometry, motion, and interaction context. AgentWorld learns these tokens through three key processes: explicit geometric grounding, reasoning-oriented supervised fine-tuning, and agent-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop experiments under diverse driving scenarios show that AgentWorld enhances planning capabilities, fully exploits visual evidence and agent dynamics, and yields interpretable agent-centric world states.

analysis.key_results: 在多种驾驶场景下的开环和闭环实验表明，AgentWorld增强了规划能力，充分利用视觉证据和智能体动态，并产生可解释的以智能体为中心的世界状态。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AgentWorld，一个以智能体为中心的世界VLA模型，使用离散智能体token，这些token动态关联到周围智能体的几何、运动、语义和交互上下文，通过显式几何定位、面向推理的监督微调和智能体导向的强化学习进行训练。
analysis.method: AgentWorld使用离散智能体token进行联合推理和轨迹规划；每个token动态关联到周围智能体的状态（语义身份、3D几何、运动和交互上下文）；训练包括显式几何定位、面向推理的监督微调和智能体导向的强化学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AgentWorld，一种以智能体为中心的世界VLA模型，通过离散的智能体token进行推理和轨迹规划，避免像素级未来生成中的冗余。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接聚焦于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）世界模型，用于自动驾驶中的规划，是VLA与环境建模的结合，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables post-training of flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies by optimizing expected task return through environment interaction. However, this optimization raises two challenges: policy updates can alter the velocity-field geometry underlying the score approximation used for stochastic transitions, and sparse multi-task rollouts can yield uneven learning signals across tasks and advantage signs. We introduce an RL framework that combines Outcome-Balanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with policy-induced flow rectification. Outcome-Balanced PPO reweights positive advantages using task success-rate estimates and rescales positive and negative advantages while preserving their signs. Policy-induced rectification periodically fits a linear-bridge flow to ODE endpoint pairs generated by the current policy, refreshing the representation used in subsequent stochastic optimization. We evaluate the framework on simulated manipulation benchmarks and additionally study a component combination in a Real2Sim2Real task, examining task performance, optimization behavior, and flow consistency. The proposed framework improves success rates over the evaluated baselines across the simulated benchmarks.

analysis.key_results: 在模拟操作基准上，所提框架相比评估基线提高了成功率；在Real2Sim2Real任务中研究了组件组合。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入结合结果平衡PPO与策略诱导流校正的RL框架，用于流式VLA策略的后训练优化。
analysis.method: 结果平衡PPO利用任务成功率估计重加权正优势，并重缩放正负优势；策略诱导流校正定期对当前策略生成的ODE端点对拟合线性桥流以更新后续优化所用的表示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种强化学习后训练框架，通过结果平衡PPO与策略诱导流校正提升流式视觉-语言-动作策略在模拟操作任务中的成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接聚焦于流式VLA策略的强化学习后训练，针对策略更新改变流速几何和稀疏多任务回滚导致的信号不均问题，提出结果平衡PPO与策略诱导流校正，对VLA策略的高效优化与操作任务性能提升具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers deep learning representations from a teacher model to a student model, typically reducing model size or inference cost. However, knowledge distillation tooling has not kept pace with the breadth of research methods: existing toolkits typically support only a limited subset of techniques and use cases. We present SilverSpoon-KD, an open-source PyTorch toolkit that unifies different distillation paradigms and architectural relationships across workloads and applications behind a single API. Moreover, SilverSpoon-KD offers the first general-purpose blockwise knowledge distillation implementation with unique scalability features. We validate its versatility across vision, masked language model, and causal language models on tasks spanning homogeneous, heterogeneous, and quantization distillation across paradigms. We also evaluate SilverSpoon-KD by comparing its performance, including throughput and GPU memory usage, with existing toolkits. Despite extensive support for convenience, metric calculation, and tracking, we have found SilverSpoon-KD's performance to be on par with or better than existing toolkits.

analysis.key_results: 在多种任务上验证了通用性，且性能（吞吐量和 GPU 内存）与现有工具包相当或更好。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SilverSpoon-KD 工具包，统一不同蒸馏范式和架构关系，并提供首个通用分块知识蒸馏实现。
analysis.method: 开源 PyTorch 工具包，集成多种知识蒸馏范式，支持分块蒸馏，并在视觉、掩码语言模型和因果语言模型上验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SilverSpoon-KD 是一个开源 PyTorch 工具包，统一了多种知识蒸馏范式并提供首个通用分块蒸馏实现，性能与现有工具相当或更优。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦通用知识蒸馏工具包，虽不直接面向 VLA/WAM 或机器人任务，但其量化蒸馏支持及高效训练方法对模型压缩具参考价值，可间接用于 VLA/WAM 模型的部署优化。

papers.title: SilverSpoon-KD: A General-Purpose Toolkit for Knowledge Distillation
papers.title_zh: SilverSpoon-KD：一个通用知识蒸馏工具包

papers.abstract: Text, images, audio, touch, and even robot actions can, in principle, all be rendered onto a single canvas, suggesting an ambitious goal of unifying all modalities within vision. Language provides the natural first test. To subsume it, a visual model must reason directly over text in pixels. Across a wide range of image, video, and unified multimodal generators, however, we find that their visual generation modules cannot perform symbolic reasoning over text on the canvas. They succeed only when an underlying text module or prompt rewriter already supplies the answer, effectively reducing the generator to a mere renderer, a limitation that post-training does little to resolve. To test whether this failure stems from pixels themselves or from current training paradigms, we train a family of purely pixel-space generative models from scratch without any text pathway. With images as their sole input and output, these models read questions, write intermediate steps, and produce answers directly on the canvas. Remarkably, they exhibit hallmark behaviors of large language models. Performance improves predictably with scale following a power law. Writing intermediate steps frame by frame substantially outperforms single-frame answering, echoing chain-of-thought, while reinforcement-learning post-training further strengthens reasoning. Moreover, sharing one canvas allows the same model to reason across modalities, a capability that text-only language models lack. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of these phenomena in purely pixel-space generative models free of text tokens.

analysis.key_results: 纯像素生成模型展现出类似大语言模型的推理行为：性能随规模幂律提升，逐帧写出中间步骤显著优于单帧答案，强化学习后处理进一步改善，且共享画布支持跨模态推理。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次系统性地研究了无需任何文本通道的纯像素空间生成模型在画布上进行符号推理的能力，并揭示了其规模定律、多步推理和跨模态推理等类似大语言模型的行为。
analysis.method: 从头训练一个仅以图像为输入和输出的像素空间生成模型，无任何文本路径，通过推理时多帧写出中间步骤来表达链式思考，并使用强化学习后训练进一步增强推理能力。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文通过训练纯像素空间的生成模型，探索视觉模型直接在图像画布上进行文本符号推理的能力，并展示其随规模扩展、链式思考及强化学习后训练的现象。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于纯视觉的生成式建模范式，论证了不依赖文本token的像素级推理能力，对机器人世界模型（WAM）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统可能具有方法论启发，但未直接涉及机器人动作预测或物理世界建模。

papers.abstract: Closed-loop vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely continuously on multi-view cameras, yet existing visual attacks typically hijack sensor streams with 2D patches or alter target object meshes that require retraining when manipulation objects change. We introduce RefCloth, a framework that optimizes one persistent adversarial tablecloth on a frozen source policy and deploys it zero-shot across unseen tasks and target models without modifying task objects or cameras. Throughout manipulation, static third-person and moving wrist views observe this shared world-bound texture under evolving occlusions. To generalize across shifting surface views while bridging the gap between differentiable and native renderers, RefCloth combines bounded texture parameterization with shared surface UV transformations and a same-path clean reference that removes static rendering offsets at initialization. Across four LIBERO suites in native simulation, one frozen texture transfers from OpenVLA-OFT to $\pi_0$ and $\pi_{0.5}$, reducing success relative to an unoptimized cloth by 62.50 and 43.75 percentage points on average and far exceeding amplitude- and variation-matched random controls. Dual-view audits and target closed-loop camera interventions show that moving wrist exposure drives over twice the standalone drop of the main view with strong synergy, while ablations confirm the roles of UV diversification and path calibration.

analysis.key_results: 在四个LIBERO套件的原生仿真中，一个冻结纹理从OpenVLA-OFT迁移到π0和π0.5，相对于未优化桌布分别平均降低成功率62.50和43.75个百分点，远超过幅度和变化匹配的随机对照；双视角审计表明移动腕部视角的暴露导致主视角单独下降的两倍以上，且UV多样化和路径校准有显著作用。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RefCloth框架，利用共享世界系纹理的对抗桌布，通过有界纹理参数化、共享UV变换和同路径干净参考，实现跨任务和跨VLA模型的可迁移鲁棒对抗攻击。
analysis.method: 在冻结源策略上优化一个持久对抗桌布纹理，并结合有界纹理参数化、共享表面UV变换和同路径干净参考来消除静态渲染偏移，实现跨视角和跨渲染器的泛化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: RefCloth框架在冻结源策略上优化一个持续存在的对抗桌布纹理，可零样本迁移到未见任务和目标VLA模型，而无需修改任务物体或相机。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的鲁棒性，通过对抗桌布攻击闭环VLA策略，揭示了VLA模型在多视角、动态遮挡下的脆弱性，为VLA的安全性和评估提供了重要见解。

papers.abstract: Ultra-low-bit quantization of large language models is a challenging task because aggressive compression severely distorts model parameters and disproportionately harms a small number of highly sensitive channels. We present a vector quantization method tailored for this regime. Our approach begins with random preconditioning, which regularizes the weight space and makes it more amenable to quantization. We then represent weights in polar coordinates and decouple the quantization of directions and magnitudes. To quantize directions, we leverage the structure induced by random preconditioning and design a structured codebook based on the $E_8$ lattice, yielding a compact yet expressive representation. To further reduce degradation, we detect extremely important channels using a proxy Hessian and preserve them with an additional cost of only 0.16 bits. Together, these components provide an effective quantization pipeline for LLMs in the extremely low-bit regime. Empirical results demonstrate improved accuracy, highlighting the benefit of combining geometric structure, lattice-based codebooks, and selective channel preservation.

analysis.key_results: 经验结果表明提高了准确性，突出了结合几何结构、格点码本和选择性通道保留的好处。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HADVQ方法，将随机预处理、极坐标下的方向与幅度解耦量化、基于E8格点的结构化码本，以及基于Hessian的重要通道选择性保留相结合，实现超低比特下的有效LLM量化。
analysis.method: 随机预处理正则化权重空间；在极坐标下解耦方向和幅度；方向量化采用基于E8格点的结构化码本；用代理Hessian检测极重要通道并以仅0.16比特的额外代价保留。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一种针对超低比特LLM量化的向量量化方法，通过随机预处理、极坐标分解、基于E8格点的方向码本和Hessian代理检测重要通道来减少量化失真。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于LLM的超低比特量化，是一种通用的高效推理技术，与VLA或WAM无直接联系，但其方法可能对在机器人或世界模型中压缩大型策略网络有参考价值。

figures.caption: Pipeline of HADVQ. The method applies random preconditioning, decomposes each weight block into magnitude and direction, quantizes the two components separately, reconstructs the quantized blocks, and preserves highly sensitive channels using proxy Hessian scores.

papers.abstract: Reference-to-video diffusion transformers pack the variational autoencoder (VAE) latents of all references and the generated tokens into one full-attention sequence, in which reference tokens make up about half. Because attention cost grows quadratically with sequence length, these tokens take up an even larger share of the attention computation, yet most of them are static, smooth or irrelevant to the output. To accelerate reference-conditioned generation, we propose pruning and caching of reference tokens for video generation (PCRG), a training-free, plug-and-play method that uses two signals the model already computes to assign each reference token to one of three tiers, namely pruned, cached or kept. The first is a low-level redundancy r from VAE latents, since a token whose latent barely changes over time or across its neighbors adds little new content. The second is a high-level importance g from the vision-language-model (VLM) conditioner, where the attention that the prompt and any first or last frames pay to a token tells whether the output needs to read it. Tokens that are not redundant are kept, and redundant tokens are cached if important and pruned otherwise. Pruned tokens leave the sequence before the first step with all rotary position embedding positions unchanged. Cached tokens have their keys and values computed once and reused, and kept tokens are processed as usual. On MiniMax-H3, already distilled to 8 timesteps and quantized to int8, PCRG is 1.57x faster end to end on our V2V-Bench and 1.49x faster on the public VACE-Benchmark, while the quality of VBench drops by only 0.24% and 0.17%, respectively. PCRG shortens the sequence rather than changing how attention is computed or which steps are run, so it also stacks on step caching and sparse attention. On V2V-Bench it reaches 1.86x with TeaCache, 1.82x with Spark at nearly unchanged fidelity and 2.15x with Veda.

analysis.key_results: 在 MiniMax-H3 上，PCRG 在 V2V-Bench 上端到端加速 1.57 倍，在公开 VACE-Benchmark 上加速 1.49 倍，VBench 质量分别仅下降 0.24% 和 0.17%；与 TeaCache、Spark、Veda 叠加后分别达到 1.86 倍、1.82 倍和 2.15 倍加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PCRG，一种免训练、即插即用的参考视频生成加速方法，通过将参考标记分为剪枝、缓存和保留三个层级来减少注意力计算。
analysis.method: 使用两个模型已计算的信号：来自 VAE 潜在的低级冗余 r 和来自 VLM 条件器的高级重要性 g，对每个参考标记分配层级；冗余且不重要的标记剪枝，冗余但重要的标记缓存，其余保留。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PCRG 提出一种免训练、即插即用的参考标记剪枝与缓存方法，通过结合 VAE 潜在冗余和 VLM 重要性信号加速参考条件视频生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于参考条件视频生成的高效推理，方法与 VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或 WAM（世界-动作模型）无直接关系，但其标记剪枝与缓存策略对视频生成模型中的高效推理具有参考价值。

figures.caption: Overview of PCRG. (a) Before step 1, the redundancy r r of the VAE latents selects the redundant set ℛ \mathcal{R} , the most redundant fraction ρ \rho of each block. The importance g g from the VLM marks the cells with g > σ g>\sigma as attended. (b) Pruned rows leave the packed sequence, and the remaining tokens keep their RoPE (①). Step 1 computes every remaining row (②). Steps 2– N N skip the cached rows and reuse their keys and values from step 1 (③). In the attention maps (④), from step 2 on, a cached token keeps its key column but loses its query row, and a pruned token has neither.

papers.title: PCRG: Training-Free Pruning and Caching of Reference Tokens for Video Generation
papers.title_zh: PCRG：面向视频生成的参考标记免训练剪枝与缓存

papers.abstract: Our aim is to accelerate autoregressive vision-language-action models (VLAs), which generate robot actions one token at a time. Speculative decoding makes this possible: a lightweight draft model proposes several tokens at once, and the VLA verifies them in a single pass, accepting only those that match its own predictions, so decoding remains lossless. The speedup, however, is limited in robot control, where many different tokens encode nearly the same motion and a draft close to the correct action is still rejected. To address this, our approach, VSpark, is built upon three design choices: (i) rollouts collected with calibrated action noise, which expose the draft to a wider range of robot states; (ii) feature alignment, which trains the draft to match the VLA's hidden features rather than its output tokens alone; and (iii) continuation reuse, which keeps the predictions the VLA has already computed along rejected drafts as candidates for the next verification step, instead of discarding them. On four VLAs with different action tokenizers and four manipulation benchmarks, VSpark achieves 1.28x to 2.10x speedup while keeping the VLA's decoding lossless.

analysis.key_results: 在四个不同动作分词器的 VLA 和四个操作基准上，VSpark 实现 1.28 到 2.10 倍加速，同时保持 VLA 解码无损。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 VSpark 方法，在保持解码无损的前提下加速自回归 VLA，并通过对动作噪声、特征对齐和接续重用的设计解决机器人控制中投机解码加速受限的问题。
analysis.method: VSpark 基于三项设计：(i) 使用带校准动作噪声的 rollout 训练轻量草稿模型；(ii) 特征对齐训练草稿模型匹配 VLA 的隐藏特征；(iii) 接续重用保留被拒绝草稿中已验证的预测用于下一次验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: VSpark 通过校准动作噪声、特征对齐和接续重用三项设计，在保持解码无损的前提下加速自回归 VLA 的动作生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的推理加速，属于将投机解码技术与机器人策略模型结合的核心应用，对 VLA 的高效推理和实际部署具有直接价值。

figures.caption: Accelerating VLAs with VSpark. (a) VSpark accelerates autoregressive vision-language-action models by up to 2.10 × 2.10\times on LIBERO. (b) Different action token sequences can represent similar robot motions, so predictions along a rejected branch often still hold under the corrected prefix. Conventional speculative decoding discards them, whereas VSpark reuses them to improve drafting while retaining exact target verification.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of VSpark. During training, (a) rollouts with calibrated action noise collect target supervision at perturbed states, and (b) feature alignment conditions and supervises the draft with target representations. During inference, (c) continuation reuse guides the next draft tree with target continuations along rejected branches. Strict verification checks all candidates under their current prefixes, preserving lossless decoding.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: VSpark: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models

papers.abstract: Generalised referring expression comprehension (GREC) aims to identify and localise the zero, one or multiple objects referred to by a language expression. In robotic manipulation, grounding also needs to remain accurate when requests for the same objects are paraphrased or embedded in additional context in robotics. However, grounding expert models are sensitive to instruction variation, while generative vision--language models (VLMs) struggle with complete target recovery and rejection of absent targets. These complementary limitations motivate combining the contextual representations of VLMs with the direct spatial prediction capabilities of grounding experts. We therefore introduce VLM-guided Grounding Expert (VGE), which combines a frozen VLM with a trainable grounding expert through layerwise joint attention and text-conditioned instance scoring. These interfaces leverage multimodal understanding of the VLM to guide object-query refinement and candidate selection while retaining direct bounding-box prediction. Across three datasets, VGE achieves the highest averaged F1 score among the evaluated methods on all five test splits, with differences of at most 1.2 percentage points across instruction conditions within each split. On the dataset with robotic scenes, VGE also achieves the highest F1 across instruction variants and no-target, single-target and multiple-target cases. VGE provides a $5.3$--$13.0\times$ inference speedup over the baseline with the same VLM base model. These results support combining VLM context with specialised spatial prediction to address both grounding challenges, with particularly strong performance in robotic scenes. Code will be released upon publication.

analysis.key_results: 在三个数据集的五个测试集上，VGE取得了评估方法中最高平均F1分数，每个split内指令条件间差异不超过1.2个百分点；在机器人场景数据集上，VGE在不同指令变体以及无目标、单目标、多目标情况下均取得最高F1；相比使用相同VLM基线的baseline，推理速度提升5.3至13.0倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLM引导的定位专家（VGE），通过分层联合注意力和文本条件实例评分，结合冻结VLM与可训练定位专家，同时保障目标定位的准确性和排除不存在目标的能力。
analysis.method: 使用冻结的VLM，通过分层联合注意力（layerwise joint attention）和文本条件实例评分（text-conditioned instance scoring）与可训练的定位专家结合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出结合冻结VLM与可训练定位专家的VGE方法，以提高机器人操作中广义指代表达理解的鲁棒性和速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本研究直接针对机器人操作中的视觉语言定位问题，通过结合VLM和定位专家提高指代理解鲁棒性，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型中语言指代和感知定位的关键部分紧密相关，对基于VLA的机器人操作任务具有直接参考价值。

figures.caption: VGE architecture. A frozen VLM supplies layerwise joint attention and contextualised text features to a trainable grounding expert. Gated joint attention refines object queries, whilst text-conditioned scoring adjusts native matching logits. The box prediction head produces candidate boxes; target selection combines boxes and scores into the predicted set.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: Spiking transformers combine attention-based representation learning with sparse spike communication, yet their weights and membrane variables still incur substantial storage and computation overhead. Post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical way to reduce these overheads, but preserving neuronal firing under weight and membrane quantization remains challenging. In this paper, we propose Decision-Aligned Post-Training Quantization (DAQ), a method that calibrates the quantizers to align neuronal firing decisions with those of a floating-point reference. We analyze how errors from these quantizers affect firing at decision boundaries and how they propagate over time steps in recurrent neurons. Based on this analysis, we formulate an objective that encourages quantized membrane variables to remain within the reference firing regions along the quantized model's own state trajectory. Experiments across multiple spiking transformer architectures on image classification, semantic segmentation, and event-based tracking demonstrate the effectiveness of DAQ with 4-bit weights and membrane variables. On FE108, DAQ achieves 58.8\% AUC and 90.9\% PR with SDTrack, while reducing energy by 66.2\%.

analysis.key_results: 在图像分类、语义分割和事件跟踪任务上验证4-bit权重和膜电位量化；在FE108上，DAQ使SDTrack达到58.8% AUC和90.9% PR，同时降低66.2%能耗。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Decision-Aligned Post-Training Quantization (DAQ)，校准量化器使神经元放电决策与浮点参考对齐。
analysis.method: 分析量化误差对放电决策边界的影响及在循环神经元中的时间步传播，构建目标函数使量化膜电位保持在参考放电区域内。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出决策对齐的量化校准方法，在保持脉冲Transformer低比特权重和膜电位的同时对齐神经元放电决策。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于脉冲Transformer的训练后量化，不直接涉及VLA或WAM。但模型量化技术可为机器人策略或世界模型的高效部署提供参考。

figures.caption: Overview of DAQ. The frozen floating-point model provides reference firing decisions, while the quantized model follows its own state trajectory. At shared sampled positions, a weighted decision-aligned loss encourages quantized potentials to remain within the reference decision regions. Event losses are averaged within and across groups to calibrate the weight and membrane quantizers.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: DAQ: Decision-Aligned Post-Training Quantization for Spiking Transformers
papers.title_zh: DAQ：面向脉冲Transformer的决策对齐训练后量化

papers.abstract: Existing agentic manipulation systems treat pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies as opaque, language-only primitives: when a policy call fails under unfamiliar instructions or scene perturbations, the agent cannot steer its behavior and is forced into futile retries or costly manual takeover. We present InteractVLA, a framework that turns pretrained flow-based VLAs into geometrically steerable and inspectable tools through a bidirectional geometric interface with vision-language agents. In the forward direction, test-time geometric guidance translates an agent-specified end-effector target into input gradients through the action expert via a differentiable command-to-pose mapping, while soft-time target alignment treats arrival time as a latent execution index to match the target pose without distorting the policy's approach motion. In the reverse direction, action-informed agentic refinement exposes generated action chunks and calibrated camera reprojections back to the agent, allowing it to diagnose spatial discrepancies, revise targets for subsequent VLA calls, or locally adjust motion segments on top of the guided trajectory. Making the VLA controllable not only boosts online agentic tool use, but also unlocks effective recursive self-improvement (RSI), achieving state-of-the-art performance of 99.4\% on LIBERO-Plus, 48.62\% on RoboDojo, and 89.4\% on RoboCasa365. Project page: https://lingwupro.github.io/InteractVLA/.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-Plus上达到99.4%，在RoboDojo上达到48.62%，在RoboCasa365上达到89.4%，达到当前最优性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出InteractVLA框架，将预训练的流式VLA策略转变为几何可操控且可检查的工具，通过双向几何接口连接视觉-语言智能体，实现正向测试时几何引导和反向动作信息智能体细化。
analysis.method: 正向方向：通过可微的命令-位姿映射将末端执行器目标转化为输入梯度，使用软时间目标对齐作为潜在执行索引匹配目标位姿；反向方向：将生成的动作块和校准的相机重投影暴露给智能体，用于诊断空间差异、修正目标或局部调整动作段。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: InteractVLA通过双向几何接口使预训练的流式VLA策略在视觉-语言智能体中是几何可操控且可检查的，从而提升智能体工具使用并实现有效的递归自改进。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 核心聚焦于VLA策略作为智能体工具的增强，使其具备几何可操控性和可检查性，未直接涉及世界模型（WAM），但通过动作生成与几何引导，间接支持机器人动作预测与策略学习。

figures.caption: Geometric guidance enables task-target generalization. Changing the language instruction to specify a new target sharply reduces VLA success. Incorporating the target pose into action generation enables task transfer while maintaining high success rates.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: InteractVLA turns VLAs into interactive tools for agents. (a) Matching a sparse target too early disrupts the approach motion, causing premature gripper closure and rotation; timely alignment preserves the approach, contact, and lift sequence. (b) InteractVLA combines test-time geometric guidance with soft-time target alignment to steer a frozen VLA toward agent-specified targets, while returning action feedback for target revision and local motion refinement. (c) This interactive interface improves online tool-use success on both LIBERO-Plus and RoboDojo.

papers.title: InteractVLA: Turning VLAs into Interactive Tools for Agentic Robotic Manipulation
papers.title_zh: InteractVLA：将视觉-语言-动作策略转化为智能体机器人操作中的交互式工具

papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as world models for planning, yet a world model that makes plausible, realistic-looking videos that are consistent with the training data can produce poor decisions. We address two key questions: (1) when can we trust a world model for planning, and (2) what should we do when we cannot? We introduce CURE (Certify, Upweight, Rollout, Explore), a certificate-guided technique that assesses whether a world model can be trusted for planning and determines what to do next: whether to upweight the training data to debias the model; roll out more samples at test time; or explore by collecting new data where support (how well the training data cover the planner's decisions) is missing. We deploy CURE across multiple domains, spanning simulated physics based on PhyWorld, MuJoCo arm control, and Language-Table pushing in simulation and on real videos. The decisions our certificate trusts have lower regret than those it does not (e.g., 0.06 vs. 0.38 on Language-Table sim and 0.07 vs. 0.38 on MuJoCo contact), whereas video perceptual quality does not identify good decisions. By focusing on decision quality rather than perceptual quality, CURE lowers regret over the best pessimistic decision rule by 10-25% across support levels, and over world-action models, search and policy learning by 41-64%, given the same data.

analysis.key_results: 在PhyWorld、MuJoCo和Language-Table等环境中，可信决策的遗憾值更低（如Language-Table sim 0.06 vs 0.38，MuJoCo contact 0.07 vs 0.38）；相比最佳悲观决策规则，遗憾降低10-25%；相比世界-行动模型、搜索和策略学习，降低41-64%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CURE技术，通过证书引导评估世界模型是否可信，并决定后续行动：加权训练数据、增加测试时采样或探索收集新数据。
analysis.method: CURE（Certify, Upweight, Rollout, Explore）框架，利用证书评估信任度并采取相应改进措施。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出CURE框架，通过认证、加权、采样和探索来诊断并解决世界模型在规划中可信度不足的问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文研究世界模型在机器人规划中的可信度问题，涉及机器人操作、模拟环境和策略学习，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）和WAM（世界-动作模型）主题高度相关，为机器人世界模型的诊断和改进提供了方法。

papers.title: Plausible Videos Can Lead to Poor Decisions: Diagnosing and CURE-ing World Models for Planning
papers.title_zh: 看似合理的视频可致决策失误：诊断并改进用于规划的世界模型

papers.abstract: Visual world models predict future visual states conditioned on actions, but recursive errors in entity poses and spatial relations limit their long-horizon prediction for robot planning and control. We ask whether a separately predicted relational state can correct this drift without restructuring the visual model. This is challenging because graph nodes and visual states share neither elements nor a feature space. We propose Joint Graph--Visual Dynamics Correction (JointGV), a plug-in based on a cross-granularity dynamics hypothesis: despite their different representations, graph-node and visual-state changes describe the same physical transition. JointGV rolls out a task-conditioned scene graph alongside the visual world model, couples their predicted changes, and combines the resulting graph-motion context with graph-predicted node positions to compute a bounded residual. Graph-learning and correction gradients do not propagate into the original visual dynamics. We attach JointGV to DINO-WM (spatial tokens) and DreamerV3 (a global latent state), evaluating both on DMC Cheetah Run and Walker Walk across three seeds and extending the evaluation to contact-rich manipulation with DMC Finger Turn Hard. Across 32-step rollouts, JointGV improves structural and visual-prediction accuracy, reducing joint-position error by 11--28\%. For spatial tokens, learned graph--visual change coupling gives lower error than broadcasting the same mean graph-motion context to every token, particularly when non-adjacent parts appear close together in the image. On real-robot inverted-pendulum sequences, JointGV reduces DINO-WM's 32-step pole-angle error from $12.56^\circ$ to $6.69^\circ$ and improves DreamerV3 and LeWorldModel as well. In simulated inverted-pendulum control, an actor trained with JointGV-corrected rollouts completes 46 of 50 episodes, compared with none using the original rollouts.

analysis.key_results: 在DMC Cheetah Run和Walker Walk上，32步滚动预测中关节位置误差降低11-28%；在真实机器人倒立摆序列上，DINO-WM的32步杆角误差从12.56°降至6.69°；在模拟倒立摆控制中，使用JointGV校正滚动训练的actor完成50次中的46次，而原始滚动完成0次。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出JointGV (Joint Graph--Visual Dynamics Correction)，一个即插即用的模块，基于跨粒度动力学假设，同时滚动任务条件场景图，耦合图与视觉预测变化，并结合图运动上下文与图预测节点位置计算有界残差，以校正视觉世界模型的长时程预测误差。
analysis.method: 并行滚动任务条件场景图与视觉世界模型，耦合它们的预测变化，并将图运动上下文与图预测节点位置结合以计算有界残差；图学习和校正梯度不反向传播到原始视觉动力学。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个即插即用的跨粒度动力学校正模块JointGV，通过并行滚动任务条件场景图并耦合图节点与视觉状态变化，修正视觉世界模型的长时程预测漂移。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对视觉世界模型（WAM）的长时程预测漂移问题，提出结构感知的校正方法，提升世界模型在机器人规划与控制中的准确性，属于WAM核心主题并具有机器人操作与仿真实证。

papers.abstract: A world model is trusted to answer "what if": how its world responds to an action it has never seen. We give a test of that trust for any action-conditioned world model: actions held out of training by design and scored against a known answer; whether forecast accuracy predicts accuracy on those actions; and the same structure given to simpler models. We run it in retail, where the action is a price and promotion plan, across 2,853 fitted models. First, forecast accuracy is a fair guide between kinds of model (rank correlation with error on new plans 0.32 to 0.66) and a poor guide between versions of one world model: where merchants plan into high-demand weeks the link reverses, down to -0.69. Second, training the world model to learn the effect of actions (JEPA pretraining, a latent consistency check, adaptation at the plan date) leaves its error on new plans unchanged. Third, in generated worlds the recorded regular price and three price rules improve it. Given the same rules, a log-linear model is best when its curve can match the truth; in a world whose curve lies outside the rules, the world model with the rules is ahead of the log-linear model with the rules in 36 of 40 worlds, and does as well without its recurrent cell. On real data (Breakfast at the Frat, The Complete Journey and M5) the rules lower the world model's error on pure price cuts deeper than any it saw (0.63 to 0.56 on the Frat; 0.45 to 0.44, within chance, on The Complete Journey), but not on lasting price moves. Fourth, a small share of random test plans helps every model a little. In a generated dosing world, a stress test in a second domain, the first finding repeats, and the built-up drug level lowers the world model's error (2.86 to 1.91) though it still predicts only 0.12 to 0.32 of the true gain. The test carries to any domain where a world model is asked about actions outside its history.

analysis.key_results: 预测准确度在不同模型类型间是合理的指南（与新计划误差的秩相关0.32至0.66），但在同一世界模型的不同版本间失效，最高达-0.69；JEPA预训练等未改变新计划误差；价格规则降低了部分真实数据上的误差；少量随机测试计划对所有模型略有帮助；在生成剂量世界中，药物水平降低了误差（2.86至1.91），但仅预测了真实增益的0.12至0.32。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种对动作条件世界模型在未见动作上的信任测试方法，并在零售场景下验证预测准确度作为泛化指标的可靠性，以及价格规则等结构信息的作用。
analysis.method: 将动作从训练中留出，并设计已知真实答案的评估框架；在零售数据上拟合了2853个模型，包括JEPA预训练、潜一致性检查、规则增强等变体。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一种在训练中刻意留出动作的测试方法，评估动作条件世界模型在未见动作上的表现，并在零售领域进行了大规模实证检验。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文关注通用动作条件世界模型在未见动作上的评估，其测试框架和发现（如预测准确度作为泛化指标的局限性、结构先验的价值）对机器人世界模型和VLA的评估与改进具有方法论参考价值，但未直接涉及机器人或VLA系统。

papers.title: Testing World Models on Actions They Have Never Seen: Held-Out Plans, Forecast Accuracy and Price Rules in Retail
papers.title_zh: 在未见动作上测试世界模型：零售中的留出计划、预测准确度与价格规则

papers.abstract: A task specifies how the world should change, while a policy specifies what the robot should do. We introduce Progress Predicts Policy (PPP), which learns a language-conditioned scalar field through the commands induced by its differential. We obtain action conditioning by composing a latent progress field with a shared world model and read its action gradient at a fixed reference command. Continuous commands scale this gradient by a learned positive gain, while discrete commands use finite differences of the same scalar. This yields a hybrid policy without a separate action head or iterative search. Fitting demonstration progress values alone does not ensure that action gradients align with expert commands. PPP trains the induced commands by imitation and uses double backpropagation for the continuous gradient readout to shape the field's local control geometry. Demonstration timing calibrates field values on observed states without additional annotation. The continuous readout remains learnable without progress labels but these timing-derived targets support progress monitoring during execution. Experiments in simulated and real robot manipulation show that PPP outperforms behavioral cloning under a shared architecture.

analysis.key_results: 在模拟和真实机器人操作中，PPP 在共享架构下优于行为克隆。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PPP：学习语言条件的进展标量场，通过其微分诱导指令，并用共享世界模型合成动作条件，在固定参考指令处读取动作梯度，得到无需独立动作头或迭代搜索的混合策略，优于行为克隆。
analysis.method: 学习语言条件标量进展场；通过其微分诱导指令；与共享世界模型组合获得动作条件；连续指令用可学习正增益缩放梯度，离散指令用同一标量的有限差分；用模仿学习训练诱导指令，对连续梯度读出使用双重反向传播；利用演示时间校准状态上的场值。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 PPP 方法，通过语言条件的进展标量场与世界模型结合，以梯度读出和有限差分方式产生连续和离散动作，实现混合策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于 VLA 政策学习，通过语言条件进展场和世界模型实现动作生成，在模拟和真实机器人操作中验证，与本站核心主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: JEPA-style latent world models let embodied agents plan toward new goals with model predictive control, but they are still too slow for real-life embodied control: sampling-based MPC repeats predictor inference tens of thousands of times per plan, and even on high-end GPUs one planning step can take tens of seconds. We observe substantial latent locality in this repeated-inference workload: the predictor maps close actions to close latents, and inside a quantized predictor this closeness takes a form that hardware can exploit, differential bit-level sparsity. Unlike an input stream, whose temporal similarity is given, a planner itself decides which candidates it evaluates together, so the planner can choose its own references and, with reference forest sampling, manufacture more sparsity: it couples the sampled action sequences of each group to a shared root, with competitive planning quality. We build the accelerator on the insights of the rich line of bit-level sparsity accelerators and design it and the planner tightly coupled as a single co-design: the planner increases sparsity and exposes structure for hardware scheduling, and the bit-exact hardware effectively uses the sparsity that the planner creates. On three JEPA world models, our co-design is 1.28-1.80x faster than a dense accelerator and uses 38-52% less energy, and it is 1.22-1.58x faster than prior bit-sparse design and uses 16-36% less energy, with the same area. To our knowledge, our planner is the first planner that manufactures differential bit-level sparsity across its candidates and exposes its structure for hardware scheduling, and our co-design is the first algorithm-hardware co-design for JEPA-style world-model planning.

analysis.key_results: 在三个JEPA世界模型上，与密集加速器相比速度提升1.28-1.80倍，能耗降低38-52%；与先前比特稀疏设计相比速度提升1.22-1.58倍，能耗降低16-36%，面积相同。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了首个规划器与硬件协同设计方案，规划器通过参考森林采样制造差分比特级稀疏性并暴露结构给硬件调度，硬件则利用该稀疏性实现比特精确加速，针对JEPA世界模型规划取得显著加速和能耗降低。
analysis.method: 基于参考森林采样在候选动作序列之间制造共享根的差分比特级稀疏性，并与比特级稀疏加速硬件协同设计，规划器增加稀疏性并暴露结构，硬件利用稀疏性进行比特精确计算。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对JEPA风格世界模型在具身智能规划中推理过慢的问题，提出规划器与硬件的协同设计，通过制造差分比特级稀疏性加速预测器推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对JEPA风格世界模型的规划效率进行硬件协同设计，与本站WAM主题高度相关；通过制造差分比特级稀疏性加速预测器推理，为高效世界模型规划提供了新思路，但未直接涉及VLA。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate visual perception, language understanding, and action generation to control robots. Testing these systems produces trajectories and task outcomes, but existing approaches provide limited guidance on using these recorded trajectories to assess subsequent executions or inform policy repair. We conjecture that, for a given policy and task, traversing certain workspace regions is associated with a higher likelihood of failure. To investigate this conjecture, we propose VoxelSBFL, a black-box adaptation of Spectrum-Based Fault Localization (SBFL) in which workspace voxels replace program elements as units of analysis. Recorded tool-center-point (TCP) trajectories provide binary voxel coverage, which is combined with execution outcomes to construct suspiciousness maps using established SBFL formulas. These maps identify failure-associated regions and score unseen trajectories without requiring internal model access. We evaluate 34 spectrum-based techniques across four VLA models using 96,000 Pick-Up trajectories in simulation and compare the leading techniques against eight action- and trajectory-based metrics. VoxelSBFL obtains an overall macro ROC-AUC of 0.704, significantly outperforming state-of-the art baselines. Sensitivity analyses show that performance varies with spatial granularity and training-set size. These findings support spatial spectra for VLA execution assessment and motivate future research on runtime monitoring, self-healing and targeted policy improvement.

analysis.key_results: 在4个VLA模型、96,000条Pick-Up仿真轨迹上，获得整体宏观ROC-AUC 0.704，显著优于8个动作和轨迹基线。
analysis.limitations: 性能受空间粒度和训练集大小影响；仅评估了Pick-Up任务和仿真环境。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VoxelSBFL，将软件工程中的频谱故障定位适配到VLA机器人执行，用工作空间体素替代程序元素进行故障预测和轨迹评估，无需内部模型访问。
analysis.method: 将TCP轨迹转换为体素覆盖二进制向量，结合执行结果，利用34种频谱公式生成可疑度图，用于识别失败相关区域并评分未见轨迹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出利用体素化工作空间覆盖与任务结果构建频谱可疑度图，以黑盒方式预测VLA模型执行时的故障区域并评估轨迹。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA模型的执行评估与故障诊断，属于VLA范畴，为后续运行时监控、自愈和策略改进提供了空间频谱工具，与WAM无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Multimodal post-training has moved from broad instruction tuning toward reinforcement learning for image and video reasoning, where outcome rewards can improve final-answer accuracy. Yet these rewards are assigned to complete generated trajectories, while visual evidence is used only at sparse and uneven positions inside the response. Recent work has begun to make multimodal RL more token-sensitive through grounding signals or external token-level weighting. We ask a more specific question: can the allocation of the same trajectory-level reward be inferred from the model's own multimodal computation, rather than from an auxiliary annotator, perception module, or process label? We propose Gaze-RL, a representation-driven policy optimization method that redistributes completion-level advantage through a latent reward landing field. The field is computed from internal cross-modal geometry and local predictive uncertainty, assigning larger update weight to positions that are both visually anchored and decision-bearing while remaining mean-one, so the total credit of each rollout is preserved and only its positionwise allocation changes. Gaze-RL requires no process supervision, auxiliary perception module, or architectural modification, and improves both Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 across a broad range of image and video benchmarks.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen2.5-VL和InternVL3.5上，在广泛的图像和视频基准上均取得提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Gaze-RL，一种表示驱动的策略优化方法，通过潜在奖励落点场重新分配完成级优势，提高多模态推理的token敏感性，且无需过程监督、辅助感知模块或架构修改。
analysis.method: 从内部跨模态几何和局部预测不确定性计算潜在奖励落点场，将完成级优势重新分配给视觉锚定且决策关键的位置，保持均值一（mean-one）以保留每条轨迹的总信用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Gaze-RL，利用模型内部跨模态几何和局部预测不确定性构建潜在奖励落点场，在保持总奖励不变的前提下重新分配轨迹级优势至关键位置，无需过程监督或架构修改。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法针对多模态（视觉-语言）推理模型的强化学习，非直接针对机器人操作或世界模型。但其表示驱动的奖励重分配思路对VLA的策略优化具有潜在方法论价值，可借鉴于机器人学习中的信用分配问题。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve high success rates on the LIBERO benchmark but remain sensitive to paraphrasing. Existing VLAs ranging from 0.6B to 7.5B parameters experience a 22-52 point performance drop on LIBERO-Para while SmolVLA exhibits an even larger decline, from 83\% to 8\%. Because most VLAs jointly learn language understanding and action generation, it is difficult to determine whether a failure originates from misunderstanding an instruction or executing it incorrectly. To address these challenges, we introduce CoBoVLA, or CodeBookVLA, a 250M-parameter VLA that decouples language understanding, planning, and control through learned discrete interpretable codes. A text encoder maps the instructions to shared step codes, which a visual planner then converts into action code sequences executed by a language-independent actor. This design improves robustness to instruction paraphrasing while allowing failures to be traced to individual stages. It also enables efficient real-time control on resource-constrained hardware by encoding instructions only once and using compact discrete representations to keep each component lightweight. CoBoVLA achieves 91.4\% success on LIBERO-Goal, compared with 82.8\% for SmolVLA, under a matched protocol, with 17 ms per control step latency. On LIBERO-Para, it achieves 81.1\% across 4,092 unseen paraphrases and 78.5\% on matched episodes, compared with 36.5\% for SmolVLA LoRA fine-tuned on paraphrases. Without two-step demonstrations, CoBoVLA completes 48.8\% of 160 free-form two-step tasks. Finally, success reaches 91\% when instructions are correctly encoded but falls to 27.2\% otherwise, identifying language understanding as the main source of remaining failures. Together, these results demonstrate that decoupling language understanding and control can improve instruction robustness while making VLA failures easier to diagnose.

analysis.key_results: CoBoVLA在LIBERO-Goal上成功率91.4%（SmolVLA为82.8%），控制延迟17ms；在LIBERO-Para的4092条未见改写上81.1%；两步骤自由形式任务48.8%；指令编码正确时成功率91%，错误时27.2%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CoBoVLA，一个250M参数的VLA模型，通过学习的离散代码将语言理解、视觉规划和动作执行解耦，提高指令鲁棒性并支持失败诊断与高效推理。
analysis.method: 文本编码器将指令映射为共享步骤代码；视觉规划器将步骤代码转换为动作代码序列；语言无关的动作执行器执行动作代码。指令仅编码一次，组件轻量。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出250M参数的CoBoVLA模型，通过离散可解释代码解耦语言理解、规划和控制，提升指令改写鲁棒性并实现高效实时控制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接属于VLA领域，通过设计解耦架构提升VLA的指令鲁棒性、可解释性和推理效率，与本站VLA主题高度相关，但不涉及世界模型。

papers.abstract: Robot failures are difficult to collect at scale, limiting the range of failure scenarios represented in robot learning datasets. We present FailureGen, a method for generating synthetic videos with temporal event annotations by reusing action trajectories from recorded failures. The method comprises four stages: (1) fine-tuning an action-conditioned Cosmos world model on successful and failed real executions; (2) annotating source recordings to identify failure-associated donor segments and compatible successful hosts; (3) transferring donor motion into host contexts, with optional spatial offsets, to generate continuous video rollouts; and (4) annotating and filtering the generated samples according to observed events and visual quality. We study two implementations with different tasks and robot configurations, with visual failure detection serving as one downstream application. In a preliminary comparison, a detector trained on real and generated data achieves an average precision of 0.51, compared with 0.41 using real data alone, and detects 33 of 36 failure intervals, compared with 28 of 36. By reusing observed failures in additional contexts, FailureGen expands the data available for studying robot failures and developing downstream learning methods.

analysis.key_results: 在初步比较中，使用真实和生成数据训练的检测器平均精度为 0.51，仅用真实数据为 0.41；检测到 36 个故障区间中的 33 个，而仅用真实数据检测到 28 个。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 FailureGen 方法，利用世界模型和已有故障数据生成带时间事件标注的合成机器人故障视频，以扩展故障数据规模。
analysis.method: 四阶段流程：(1) 在成功和失败真实执行上微调动作条件 Cosmos 世界模型；(2) 标注源记录以识别故障相关片段和兼容成功宿主；(3) 将捐赠者运动迁移到宿主场景，可选空间偏移，生成连续视频；(4) 根据观察事件和视觉质量筛选生成样本。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FailureGen 通过微调动作条件世界模型，将真实失败轨迹迁移到新的机器人场景中，生成带时间事件标注的合成故障视频数据。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是世界模型在机器人故障数据生成中的应用，与 VLA/WAM 主题高度相关，因为它直接扩展了用于训练下游机器人模型（如故障检测）的数据，对机器人世界建模和基于世界模型的数据增强具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies incur control stalls when inference blocks the next action chunk. Asynchronous early inference can hide latency, but its results may be inconsistent with the arriving actual inputs. Unconditional reuse risks acting on mismatched inputs, whereas full recomputation discards useful precomputation. We propose SR-VLA, combining predicted-input lookahead with selective KV cache repair. During current chunk execution, a lightweight action-conditioned predictor generates next-boundary visual observations and proprioceptive state. These predictions, together with the task instruction, drive the frozen VLA to precompute a speculative KV cache and action chunk. After real inputs are available to VLA, predicted--real differences and task conditions determine whether to accept the action chunk or trigger selective KV repair. On LIBERO, SR-VLA achieves $2.67\times$ and $1.27\times$ query speedups over the respective synchronous $\pi_{0.5}$ and OpenVLA-OFT baselines, while maintaining competitive average task success rates. Under target-motion perturbation, success remains baseline-comparable, with $1.52\times$--$1.93\times$ query speedup.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上，SR-VLA比同步π0.5和OpenVLA-OFT基线分别提升2.67倍和1.27倍查询速度，并保持竞争性的平均任务成功率；在目标运动扰动下成功率与基线相当，查询速度提升1.52-1.93倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SR-VLA，结合预测输入前瞻与选择性KV缓存修复，减少VLA控制停顿并提升查询速度。
analysis.method: 在当前动作块执行期间，轻量级动作条件预测器生成下一时刻视觉观测和本体感受状态，与任务指令一起驱动冻结VLA预计算推测KV缓存和动作块；实际输入到达后，根据预测与实际差异及任务条件决定接受动作块或触发选择性KV修复。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SR-VLA通过预测输入前瞻和选择性KV缓存修复，在保持成功率的同时显著加速VLA推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA（Vision-Language-Action）推理延迟问题，利用预测输入和KV缓存修复实现高效推测解码，对VLA在机器人控制中的实时性具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of quantized large language models is dominated by QLoRA, which combines 4-bit weight quantization with FP16 low-rank adapters. We ask whether the FP16 adapter precision is necessary. Replacing it with a single binary bit per adapter parameter, combined with a learned per-layer scale $s$ and a Scaled Straight-Through Estimator, reduces adapter storage by 13-16x. We introduce two variants -- NormScale, which binarizes under a norm-preserving scale with a clipped STE, and LearnThresh, which makes the binarization threshold learnable -- unified under a framework we call BQ-LoRA. Our main theoretical contribution is a tight characterization of the BQ-LoRA hypothesis class: it has bounded entrywise norm, a typical-set spectral norm bound that is $\Theta(r)$ times sharper than the worst case, a full-rank, near-isotropic update, and consequently a Rademacher complexity that yields an explicit $\tilde{O}(s_{\max}\alpha\sqrt{d_{out}/(rn)})$ generalization bound. FP16 LoRA has no comparable a priori norm or isotropy control. On Qwen2.5 (1.5B-72B), BQ-LoRA exceeds QLoRA's benchmark averages at every scale by 0.8-3.5 points; on LLaMA-2 (7B/70B) it remains competitive at the same storage reduction but does not uniformly lead the strongest FP16-adapter baselines (LoftQ at 7B, QLoRA at 70B). On Qwen2.5-7B the binary adapter preserves the 4-bit base WikiText-2 PPL within 0.06 (9.86 vs. 9.80) while QLoRA worsens it by 0.59. The reduction applies to inference-time adapter storage and serving; training memory matches QLoRA and step time rises by under 4%. We translate the storage saving into a deployment study, BQ-SGMV, by extending Punica's SGMV kernel with a binary inner-product primitive: the same A100-80GB holds 15.6x more adapters in HBM, and our research prototype eliminates cache misses under a skewed synthetic workload.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen2.5 (1.5B-72B)上，BQ-LoRA在每个规模上超过QLoRA的基准平均0.8-3.5个点；在LLaMA-2 (7B/70B)上保持竞争力；在Qwen2.5-7B上，二值适配器将4-bit基座WikiText-2困惑度保持在0.06以内（9.86 vs 9.80），而QLoRA恶化0.59；训练内存与QLoRA匹配，步时增加低于4%；部署研究中，A100-80GB可存储多15.6倍的适配器。
analysis.limitations: 摘要提到在LLaMA-2上不统一领先最强的FP16适配器基线（LoftQ在7B，QLoRA在70B）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出BQ-LoRA框架，将QLoRA中的FP16低秩适配器替换为二值参数，通过NormScale和LearnThresh两种变体减少适配器存储13-16倍，并在实验中优于QLoRA基准。
analysis.method: 用单个二进制位替代每个适配器参数，结合可学习的逐层缩放因子s和缩放直接估计器（Scaled Straight-Through Estimator），并在BQ-LoRA框架下统一了NormScale和LearnThresh两种二值化方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: BQ-LoRA通过将LoRA适配器参数二值化，在保持性能的同时大幅降低适配器存储，并提供了理论上的泛化保证。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于独立的大语言模型量化技术，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人。但二值量化适配器可显著降低部署存储，对需要多任务适配的机器人模型具有潜在应用价值。

papers.abstract: Lifelong embodied navigation requires agents to accumulate experience through continuous interaction and reuse it for subsequent goal searches. Existing memory-enhanced methods typically retain historical observations or construct structured scene representations. However, storing observations or high-dimensional semantic embeddings incurs growing storage costs. Meanwhile, structured representations support retrieval and semantic reasoning but do not explicitly evolve accumulated experience into environment-specific knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose Experience-Evolving Memory (EvoNav), a novel two-timescale memory framework. It organizes semantic observations, spatial relations, and task-feedback cues into sparse experience atoms. During online operation, experience atoms continually consolidate repeated observations and form dynamic links based on transitions. At the slower timescale, EvoNav distills accumulated category co-occurrences and feedback signals into environment-specific structural knowledge without relying on predefined object--room relations. For each new goal, EvoNav combines direct goal evidence from experience atoms with learned structural knowledge to guide goal-directed search on the current traversability map. Experiments on single-goal, sequential multi-floor, and multimodal navigation demonstrate effective experience reuse and improved path efficiency with compact persistent memory, together with successful transfer to a real robot.

analysis.key_results: 在单目标、多楼层序列和多模态导航任务中展示了有效的经验复用与路径效率提升，并成功迁移至真实机器人。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Experience-Evolving Memory (EvoNav)，一种双时间尺度记忆框架，将经验持续整合为环境特有结构知识，并在紧凑持久记忆下实现高效导航。
analysis.method: EvoNav框架：将语义观察、空间关系和任务反馈组织为稀疏经验原子；在线整合重复观察并建立动态链接；在慢时间尺度上将共现与反馈信号蒸馏为环境特有结构知识；目标搜索时结合经验原子与结构知识引导决策。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种双时间尺度记忆框架，将语义观察、空间关系和任务反馈整合为稀疏经验原子，并在线整合为环境特有结构知识，以提升终身具身导航中的经验复用和路径效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于视觉语言导航与机器人学习范畴，通过经验记忆与知识演化提升终身具身导航能力，与VLA的视觉-语言-动作策略学习紧密相关，虽然未直接针对操作任务，但记忆框架可为VLA的长期经验整合提供参考。

papers.abstract: The physical world has inertia: it evolves from what already exists rather than being recreated at every instant. However, many existing video world models lack an explicit mechanism for inertial state evolution, leaving the continuity of motion and structure implicit in video prediction. During autoregressive rollouts, repeated reconstruction can accumulate errors and destabilize the predicted dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce InertialWorld, an Inertial Video World Model that makes inertia a structural prior for autoregressive prediction: existing scene evidence is carried across time rather than reconstructed at every step. Central to this formulation is Inertial Memory, which turns memory from passive predictive context into an evolving video state with two complementary views: a dense Eulerian grid preserves scene-aligned evidence, while persistent Lagrangian carriers bind local content to learned canonical coordinates. At each step, the model transports the carrier content according to action-conditioned motion, predicts the complete next video state from the transported carriers and dense grid, and uses a learned gate to combine transported and newly predicted content into the memory for the next step. Extensive experiments across multiple domains, including robot manipulation, 3D game simulation, and open-world navigation, demonstrate that InertialWorld achieves competitive autoregressive prediction performance against strong video world model baselines. Codes link: https://github.com/YuanGao-YG/InertialWorld

analysis.key_results: 在机器人操作、3D游戏模拟和开放世界导航等多个领域，与强视频世界模型基线相比取得了有竞争力的自回归预测性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入InertialMemory机制，将记忆从被动上下文转化为演化的视频状态，通过稠密欧拉网格和持久拉格朗日载体两种视角，结合动作条件运动传输和门控融合，实现结构先验驱动的惯性状态演化。
analysis.method: Inertial Memory：稠密欧拉网格保持场景对齐证据；持久拉格朗日载体将局部内容绑定到学习到的规范坐标；每步根据动作条件运动传输载体内容，预测下一步视频状态，并用学习门控结合传输与新预测内容更新记忆。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出惯性视频世界模型InertialWorld，通过结构化的惯性记忆机制实现自回归视频预测中的状态演化，提升长期连续预测稳定性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是视频世界模型（WAM），直接面向机器人操作等具身场景，通过惯性结构化先验改善动作条件长期预测稳定性，对基于世界模型的机器人策略学习和VLA训练具有重要价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference, but its optimal configuration depends jointly on workload characteristics, GPU hardware, and available memory. For example, on the RTX~5090, the state-of-the-art speculative drafter DFlash achieves $3.50\times$ the throughput of autoregressive (AR) decoding at low concurrency, but only $0.76\times$ at high concurrency with short outputs. We present SpecSearch, a hardware-aware search engine that jointly optimizes decoding strategy, draft length, and precision across workload--GPU pairs. Its analytical cost model captures memory and compute constraints to identify feasible configurations and narrow the search space for throughput optimization. Guided by this model, calibration measurements are collected from multiple GPUs. Using the measurements, a Jev-based predictor learns to select high-throughput decoding configurations on held-out GPUs without requiring deployment-GPU calibration. The predictor is parameter-efficiently trained on calibration data, while adapting a frozen Qwen3-4B using LoRA adapters and a linear correction layer. Across NVIDIA RTX~5090, H100, L40 and AMD MI300X GPUs, SpecSearch with full calibration achieves an average of $2.01\times$ the throughput of AR and $1.36\times$ the throughput of SD, both served by vLLM. The proposed Jev-based predictor closely matches this search performance with $1.30\times$ throughput improvement over SD with vLLM, while eliminating the need for held-out GPU calibration. Additionally, it retains $97.36\%$ of the throughput achieved by SpecSearch that utilizes full calibration.

analysis.key_results: 在NVIDIA RTX 5090、H100、L40和AMD MI300X GPU上，完整校准的SpecSearch平均达到vLLM自动回归解码的2.01倍吞吐量和vLLM投机解码的1.36倍吞吐量；Jev预测器在无需校准的情况下达到SD的1.30倍吞吐量，并保留完整校准SpecSearch 97.36%的吞吐量。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SpecSearch，一个硬件感知的搜索引擎，联合优化解码策略、草稿长度和精度，并引入基于Jev的预测器，在无需部署GPU校准的情况下选择高吞吐配置。
analysis.method: 分析成本模型捕捉内存和计算约束，缩小搜索空间；在多个GPU上收集校准测量值；使用基于Jev的预测器，通过LoRA适配器和线性校正层对冻结的Qwen3-4B进行参数高效训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出SpecSearch，一个硬件感知的搜索引擎，联合优化投机解码策略、草稿长度和精度，以在不同GPU上最大化吞吐量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于LLM推理加速的投机解码方法，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人模型；但其硬件感知优化和参数高效预测器技术可能为机器人基础模型的推理效率优化提供方法论参考。

papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies fill their context with the demonstrations whose frames look most like the current observation under frozen DINOv2 embeddings. We ask whether visual similarity selects the demonstrations that make the policy succeed. For a frozen retrieval-augmented VLA (RICL on $\pi_0$-FAST, LIBERO), we make the demonstration pool swappable at run time and score each demonstration's utility by regressing the closed-loop success of 60 fixed-size pools on their membership. On initial states disjoint from those used for scoring, pools of the five highest-utility demonstrations succeed on 66.4% of 760 paired episodes across 19 tasks, pools of the five most similar on 55.7%, and random pools on 55.5%. Utility beats similarity by 10.8 points ($p=3.2\times10^{-6}$; positive on 15 of 18 untied tasks), including on 12 tasks the policy was never primed on, and similarity-selected pools do no better than random ($+0.1$ points). Within a task, a pool's visual similarity to the test scenes tracks its success at Spearman 0.10; across tasks, similarity separates tasks whose scenes differ and falls to chance when two tasks share a scene. The gain comes from on-task closed-loop evidence: best-of-ten direct search over pools recovers two-thirds of it with 100 rollouts. Against the shipped 20-demonstration pool, utility-curated pools of five lead by 7.0 points over 560 paired episodes from two evaluation runs ($p=0.006$), and utility-ordered retrieval inside the full pool leads by 4.5 points ($p=0.055$).

analysis.key_results: 在19个任务的760对测试回合中，效用最高的五个演示池成功率为66.4%，相似性选择为55.7%，随机池为55.5%；效用比相似性高10.8个百分点（p=3.2×10^-6），且在12个未预训练任务上也有效；效用策划的五演示池比基准20演示池高7.0个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种基于闭环效用的上下文演示选择方法，替代常用的视觉相似性选择，并证明其在检索增强VLA策略中能显著提升成功率。
analysis.method: 通过将演示池变为运行时可交换，对固定大小演示池的成员进行闭环成功率回归来评分每个演示的效用，并使用效用分数选择演示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文评估检索增强的视觉-语言-动作策略中基于视觉相似性的演示选择，并提出基于闭环效用的演示选择方法，证明其优于相似性选择。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接关注检索增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中的演示选择问题，通过闭环效用评估改进了策略性能，对VLA的上下文学习机制和部署效率具有重要价值。

papers.abstract: Physical agents must use what they previously saw or touched after visibility or contact is lost. Their actions change the implications of these remembered facts. We introduce executable perceptual memory (EPM), a world-model framework that advances explicit perceptual state alongside neural latent dynamics during imagination. Its evolving read-out informs reward prediction, value estimation and policy learning. We align reward inputs with the transitions that produced them and supervise the reward head on open-loop rollouts of recorded actions. On Memory Maze $13\times13$, EPM reaches 30.37 return at 1M interactions, compared with 23.37 when the same evolving read-out informs only policy and value on a common perceptual front end: a gain of 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]. The complete method also improves control on $9\times9$ and in MiniWorld. Probes of remembered, out-of-view arrivals show stronger reward anticipation in both visual implementations. Concentration, tactile recovery and real tactile frames demonstrate complementary roles of remembered facts in imagined-policy training, motion-dependent decisions and sensory-content retention. EPM connects persistent perception to the predicted consequences and learning signals of a world model for Physical AI.

analysis.key_results: 在Memory Maze 13×13上，EPM在1M交互时达到30.37回报，高于基线23.37，增益7.00；在9×9和MiniWorld上也有改进；探针显示更强的奖励预期。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出可执行感知记忆（EPM），一种在想象过程中推进显式感知状态的世界模型框架，并使其读出同时服务于奖励预测、价值估计和策略学习。
analysis.method: 在神经潜在动力学中引入显式感知状态，通过开放环路记录的动作来监督奖励头，使奖励输入与产生它们的转移对齐。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出可执行感知记忆EPM，作为世界模型框架在想象过程中推进显式感知状态，并利用其读出来改进奖励预测、价值估计和策略学习。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接属于世界模型（WAM）研究，面向物理智能体提出可执行感知记忆框架，将持久感知与预测后果及学习信号连接，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To benchmark these capabilities, we introduce HH-Bench, comprising 12 tasks involving teams of 2 to 10 humanoids, including heterogeneous teams. Systematic evaluations show that Heave-Ho consistently outperforms baseline methods, while real-world experiments demonstrate robust decentralized collaboration across challenging tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在HH-Bench的12个任务上，Heave-Ho一致优于基线方法；真实世界实验展示了在挑战性任务上的鲁棒去中心化协作。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Heave-Ho框架，实现去中心化的长时程多人形机器人协作；设计了多智能体后训练方法使基础跟踪模型适应物理耦合交互；引入语音领导-跟随机制同步执行；系统可扩展至10个机器人且无需重训练即可泛化到异构团队；构建HH-Bench基准。
analysis.method: 低层：多智能体后训练，适应人形基础跟踪模型到物理耦合交互；高层：训练视觉-语言规划器和基于语音的领导-跟随协调机制，实现无网络通信的去中心化同步。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Heave-Ho是一个去中心化的多人形机器人长时程协作框架，结合了多智能体后训练和视觉-语言规划，实现从2到10个机器人团队及异构团队的协调控制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作以人形机器人协作中的全身操作和长时程规划为核心，使用视觉-语言规划器进行高层决策，并采用多智能体后训练适应底层控制，属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）在机器人学习中的直接应用，对本站VLA主题有高度相关性，但不涉及世界模型（WAM）。

papers.abstract: Scaling has driven the success of large language models (LLM), with sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures enabling greater parameter capacity without a proportional increase in computation. At large scales, MoE models rely on expert parallelism to distribute experts across devices. Each MoE layer requires two synchronous collective communication steps during inference: dispatching hidden states to the activated experts and combining the resulting expert outputs. As compute throughput has outpaced interconnect bandwidth, these synchronous collectives have become a major bottleneck to MoE scaling and efficiency. We address this challenge with EchoMoE, a lightweight architecture modification that retrofits existing MoE models, requiring approximately 8,500x fewer training tokens than full pretraining. Motivated by the observation that transformer blocks update the residual stream incrementally, we use a hidden state from an earlier layer as a reference and communicate only the compressed difference between it and the current state, rather than communicating each hidden state in full. EchoMoE periodically refreshes these reference states and transmits only the compressed differences synchronously, reducing the traffic on latency-critical paths without significant computational overhead. EchoMoE reduces inter-node communication volume by 58% and improves throughput by 22.6%, while preserving average performance within 3.8 percentage points across 18 benchmarks. EchoMoE further improves inference throughput by up to 2.38x over bandwidth-constrained Ethernet, paving the way for wide-area distributed inference. EchoMoE also tolerates quantization of the communicated representations without measurable quality loss. We release an efficient implementation for applying EchoMoE to pretrained MoE models, together with an inference integration for vLLM.

analysis.key_results: 节点间通信量减少58%，吞吐量提升22.6%，在18个基准上平均性能保持在3.8个百分点以内；在带宽受限的以太网上推理吞吐量提升高达2.38倍；通信表示量化无质量损失。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出EchoMoE，一种轻量级架构修改，通过通信压缩的激活差分而非完整隐藏状态来减少专家并行MoE模型的节点间通信量，仅需约8500倍少于完整预训练的训练tokens。
analysis.method: 利用早期层的隐藏状态作为参考，仅同步传输当前状态与参考状态的压缩差分，并周期性刷新参考状态。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: EchoMoE通过压缩通信激活差分来减少专家并行MoE模型推理中的节点间通信量，提升吞吐量且几乎不损失质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文主要针对专家并行MoE模型的通信效率优化，属于模型推理加速方法，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界模型，但可作为通用效率技术融入相关模型推理。

papers.title: Communicate the Change: Efficient Expert Parallelism via Activation Compression
papers.title_zh: EchoMoE：通过激活压缩实现高效专家并行

papers.abstract: Chat models on phones and laptops are usually 4-bit copies of the model that was evaluated, and audits of such copies disagree about what quantization does to refusal. A 4-bit build is one of many weight perturbations of the same size, so a change in its behaviour could come from its specific rounding error or from any perturbation that large. In a pre-registered study of three 3-4B chat models, with paired tests, blind human labels and an 8-bit null, we find two 4-bit shifts of opposite sign: with a compliant reply prefilled, Qwen2.5-3B continues into harmful content more often, and on held-out jailbreaks Llama-3.2-3B complies 10.3 points less often. Matched perturbations separate the two. Shuffled and Gaussian versions of the error average close to zero, while scaling the real error, from its mirror image to twice its size, changes behaviour near-linearly. At half the real error, Llama's likelihood is almost unchanged, yet it already complies 5.8 points less often, and llama.cpp's Q4_K_M, at the same bits per weight, moves neither model. Refusal under 4-bit quantization depends on the specific rounding error, not on bits per weight or likelihood, so each build has to be compared with its original.

analysis.key_results: Qwen2.5-3B在预填合规回复时更频繁输出有害内容，Llama-3.2-3B在未见过越狱上合规率下降10.3个百分点；缩放真实误差行为近乎线性；半误差时Llama似然几乎不变但合规率下降5.8个百分点；llama.cpp的Q4_K_M对两者行为无显著影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明4位量化导致的拒绝行为变化是由特定的舍入误差引起的，而非权重扰动的大小或似然度，并提出使用匹配扰动来分离量化误差与噪声。
analysis.method: 对三个3-4B聊天模型进行预注册研究，使用配对测试、盲人标签和8位基线，引入匹配扰动（缩放真实误差、随机化版本）来分离量化误差的影响。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究4位量化对聊天模型拒绝行为的影响，发现行为变化源于特定的舍入误差，而非比特数或似然度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究模型量化对行为的影响，属于高效推理技术；未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，但量化技术可直接应用于VLA/WAM模型的部署与优化。

papers.abstract: Multimodal agents can now control robot arms by calling tools and writing code. Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions. We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone. Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes. We start from the most flexible agent system, the adaptive system, where one agent decides when to fork delegates. With it, gpt-6.1-sol and opus-5.5 complete 28 and 27 tasks, and four other models at most 3. But at a high price: a typical task takes gpt-6.1-sol 3.5 hours and 218 million input tokens, and a third of its steps fail at least once and must be retried. We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchical, and decentralized. All four complete a similar number of tasks but differ in time and tokens. The hierarchical and decentralized systems are faster but use up to 1.9 times the tokens, and the single agent uses fewer tokens but takes 1.6 times as long, so the adaptive system lies between them. Even so, no model or system is yet fast, cheap, and reliable at once. RoboTeam measures these limits where earlier benchmarks cannot: long multi-arm jobs, camera images only, and a world that never pauses.

analysis.key_results: 自适应系统下gpt-6.1-sol和opus-5.5分别完成28和27个任务，其他四个模型最多完成3个；所有系统完成的任务数量相近，但在时间和令牌消耗上有差异，尚无模型或系统同时满足快速、廉价和可靠。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RoboTeam基准，用于评估基于视觉的多代理在实时、仅凭摄像头图像条件下协调控制多个（4-16个）机械臂完成长时任务的能力。
analysis.method: 构建模拟环境，包含36个长时多臂协作任务，并对比自适应、单代理、层级式和去中心化四类代理系统。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RoboTeam模拟基准，评估多模态代理在实时、仅摄像头图像输入条件下协调控制4至16个机械臂完成长时任务的能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 作为机器人操控多臂协作基准，涉及视觉-语言模型在物理任务中的应用，但未直接涉及VLA或世界模型，其模拟环境和评估方法可为本研究相关主题提供参考。
