papers.abstract: Autoregressive normalizing flows (NFs) provide a tractable density for learning and sampling continuous robot actions. We show that a single maximum-likelihood objective can train vision--language--action (VLA) policies competitive with leading methods on manipulation benchmarks. We present NF-VLA, which combines conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with score-based action refinement. Its deep--shallow architecture concentrates visual, language, and proprioceptive prefix conditioning in a high-capacity deep block, while unconditioned shallow blocks provide a shared invertible action transformation. The vision--language backbone and flow are jointly trained by exact maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks. The same learned density supplies a single score-based correction at inference, refining generated actions to account for training-time smoothing without a separately trained denoiser. Trained on LIBERO from a pretrained vision--language backbone without robot pretraining, NF-VLA achieves 98.35\% success across the four standard suites and 72.6\% on LIBERO-Plus using the same checkpoint without further fine-tuning. Ablations show that deep-only prefix conditioning and score-based refinement both improve closed-loop success. Together, these results establish carefully structured autoregressive flows as a competitive approach to VLA control, with one learned density supporting policy training, action generation, and refinement.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO 四个标准套件上达到 98.35% 成功率，在同一检查点上 LIBERO-Plus 达到 72.6%；消融实验表明仅深前缀条件化和基于分数的细化均能提高闭环成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 NF-VLA，将条件自回归归一化流与基于分数的动作细化结合，实现使用单一最大似然目标训练 VLA 策略，并在无机器人预训练的情况下取得有竞争力的操作性能。
analysis.method: 条件自回归归一化流与基于分数的动作细化；深层块进行视觉、语言和本体感觉前缀条件化，浅层块提供共享可逆动作变换；对高斯平滑后的动作块进行精确最大似然联合训练，推理时使用同一密度进行单步分数校正。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: NF-VLA 使用条件自回归归一化流与基于分数的动作细化，在 LIBERO 上以单一最大似然目标训练达到与领先方法相当的操作成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 核心贡献为 VLA 策略学习，结合归一化流进行动作分布建模与细化，可直接提升机器人操作策略训练与推理，与 VLA 主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are capable of producing desired robotic behaviors in ideal settings. However, they often fail when the robot's actuation changes at deployment. For example, remounting, mechanical wear, or command latency changes can lead to failed tasks and unsafe behaviors. To address the inevitable actuation shift, we propose ReGround, an inference-time method that keeps the VLA frozen and re-grounds its intended motion. ReGround learns the deployed robot's dynamics from task-agnostic motor babbling, and then tracks the policy's intended motion while staying close to the policy's own plan. ReGround activates only upon detecting a shift, and needs no rewards, demonstrations, or retraining. We show via two VLAs, eight LIBERO tasks, and five shift settings that ReGround can restore near-oracle success, such as raising $\pi_{0.5}$'s success from 0.16 to 0.90 under 400 ms latency, while remaining safer than a linear-calibration baseline. Project website and open-source code: https://umersiddique94.github.io/ReGround/.

analysis.key_results: 在两种VLA、八个LIBERO任务和五种偏移设置下，ReGround恢复接近oracle的成功率，例如在400ms延迟下将π0.5的成功率从0.16提高到0.90，且比线性校准基线更安全。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ReGround，一种无需奖励、演示或重训练的推理时方法，通过任务无关的运动噪声学习部署机器人动力学，并在检测到执行器偏移时跟踪VLA的意图运动，同时保持接近原始计划。
analysis.method: ReGround通过任务无关的运动噪声学习部署机器人动力学，并在检测到偏移后，在保持接近VLA自身计划的同时追踪其意图运动。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ReGround方法，在推理时保持VLA冻结，通过重新接地其意图运动来应对机器人执行器偏移。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于VLA领域，解决VLA模型在机器人执行器变化时的鲁棒性问题，对VLA在真实世界的部署具有直接意义。

papers.abstract: Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. To account for the varying informativeness of visual and EMG cues across joint DoFs and input conditions, the decoder assigns a separate learnable query to each DoF, enabling DoF-specific and context-adaptive fusion of the two modalities. The framework was evaluated on synchronized multimodal data from 10 participants. Averaged across participants, the proposed fusion model achieved a mean coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of $0.88$ and a mean absolute error (MAE) of $2.80^\circ$, compared with $0.82$ and $3.21^\circ$ for the vision-only model and $0.68$ and $5.13^\circ$ for the EMG-only model. It also outperformed the evaluated representative unimodal baselines and alternative fusion designs. DoF-wise analyses showed larger fusion gains for visually ambiguous joints and viewing conditions, while synthetic visual occlusion demonstrated greater robustness than vision-only estimation. These results highlight the complementary value of egocentric vision and forearm HD-sEMG for capturing fine-grained human hand kinematics, with potential applications in human demonstration acquisition and dexterous robot learning.

papers.abstract: The CAPSARII project advances a cyber-secure, ultra-low-power wearable platform and Internet of Battlefield Things (IoBT) framework to support real-time monitoring of military personnel and data-driven decision support. The architecture integrates smart-textile sensing, a body/squad area mesh, edge-deployed AI on secure RISC-V microcontrollers, and cloud/federated analytics for cross-mission learning and comparative studies. Two representative use cases--pilot fatigue and warfighters operating in harsh environments--guide requirements, validation, and interface design (including HUD and haptic feedback). As an initial step toward embedded models, we benchmark stress classification on a public wearable dataset: tree-ensemble baselines achieve state-of-the-art performance for accuracy and F1 (e.g., XGBoost: $\mathrm{Accuracy}=0.901\!\pm\!0.023$, $\mathrm{F1}=0.920\!\pm\!0.019$), while a feature-based Transformer attains the highest AUC ($0.963\!\pm\!0.025$), informing feature-engineering and compression choices for edge deployment. Building on these results, CAPSARII employs HW/SW co-design, model compression (pruning, quantization, distillation), and precision tuning to meet stringent energy and memory budgets; it further investigates Processing-in-Memory accelerators for future efficiency gains. A structured gap analysis highlights the remaining challenges: establishing validation standards for physiological signal quality and textile durability; achieving low-latency, scalable BAN/SAN communications under mobility and interference; and deploying hybrid lightweight/post-quantum cryptography with robust device identity and side-channel resilience on constrained endpoints. By consolidating these elements into a coherent, secure IoBT stack, CAPSARII delineates a practical roadmap from laboratory baselines to mission-ready soldier monitoring in both training and operational scenarios.

papers.abstract: An autonomous vehicle must foresee the consequences of its actions, especially in the rare, time-critical situations where crashes happen. A world model offers this foresight, but only within the coverage of its training data, which poses an exploration-exploitation dilemma. Within this coverage a planner can hardly improve on the data, and beyond it the model's errors mislead it. Logs of competent driving rarely contain the failures that would widen the coverage, and agents that learn from interaction gain them only by failing themselves, without being shown what to do instead. We propose SAFER, a framework that learns offline from failures that others make, judged by an expert, and keeps learning online from its own driving. Offline, partially trained agents and scripted, recoverable perturbations Stage failures in simulation, and an expert Annotates every visited state with its action and value, so that much of what the planner explores is covered before it drives. In planning, a chunked latent world model Foresees the consequences fast enough for real-time use, and a risk-aware sampling-based planner Evaluates candidate maneuvers by their return minus a bounded collision penalty. Online, a loop continuously Refines the model wherever this driving leaves the coverage of the offline data. In closed-loop evaluation against the compared methods, SAFER reaches the highest route completion and reward per step on the CARLA Leaderboard routes, 0.95 and 0.77 from a privileged bird's-eye view, and the highest episode reward in MetaDrive, 53.4 in regular and 49.0 in safety-critical traffic. Project page: https://ys-qu.github.io/safer-website.

analysis.key_results: 在CARLA Leaderboard路线上达到最高路线完成率0.95和每步奖励0.77（特权鸟瞰视角），在MetaDrive中达到最高回合奖励53.4（常规）和49.0（安全关键交通）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SAFER框架，通过离线从专家评判的他人失败中学习，并结合在线自车驾驶数据持续细化世界模型，以解决自动驾驶中世界模型覆盖范围有限的问题。
analysis.method: 离线阶段利用部分训练智能体和可恢复扰动在仿真中制造失败，专家为每个访问状态标注动作和价值；在线规划采用分块潜空间世界模型和风险感知采样规划器；在线再通过连续细化循环更新模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SAFER框架通过离线从他人失败中学习并在线持续细化，解决自动驾驶世界模型规划中的探索-利用困境。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接聚焦于自动驾驶的世界模型（WAM）构建与使用，并涉及基于世界模型的策略学习，与本站主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Learning paradigms for autonomous driving, compared by where the experience beyond competent driving comes from. The glyph under each paradigm shows the coverage of its data (gray) and how the paradigm treats it. Exploiting (blue) spreads the candidates over the coverage and takes the best one up to its edge, but no further. Exploring (orange) grows the coverage at the price of failures (red crosses), the paradigm’s own or, for SAFER, failures that others make, labeled by the expert (teal). A step out of the coverage that does not grow it is misjudged (?). (a) Imitation learning copies expert demonstrations and never observes a failure; reinforcement learning discovers consequences by failing in the environment. (b) A world model learned online ( Hafner et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2024 ) still explores by failing. A world model learned from logged expert driving ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) covers competent driving only, and a planner that searches beyond this coverage favors the actions that the model misjudges. (c) SAFER broadens the coverage offline with staged failures that an expert annotates, plans with a fast chunked world model that prices collision risk, and extends the coverage online from the planner’s own driving. The BEV frames, candidates and risk curves in (c) are from a recorded collision of the corpus (Fig. 5 a).

(1) Parents praise what works and point to negative examples, so that the child need not fail first. (a) Likewise, weaker drivers and scripted perturbations stage failures in simulation, and the expert labels every visited state with its action and value. (2) The child learns what each choice leads to. Hard work (action) brings good grades (reward), a far goal is worth pursuing (value), and staying out all night is risky (risk). (b) Likewise, the world model foresees these quantities for each candidate action chunk, and (c) the planner scores the candidates by their return minus a price on risk. (3) Away from home, school and work keep reshaping the beliefs while the core ones stay. (d) Likewise, the planner’s own driving refines the dynamics and the reward and risk heads, while the prior and the value, whose targets only the expert provides, stay fixed.

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are routinely aligned with offline pairwise RLHF objectives, but multimodal preference data is scarce and treats every response token as equally informative. Under a small preference budget, pair construction becomes nearly irrelevant: standard DPO-style, image-conditional, and self-improvement objectives all perform within 1.1 points on MM-RLHF metrics and 0.5 points on hallucination rates, matching the SFT baseline. We call this entropy-blind preference optimization: the learning signal ignores policy uncertainty, which in chain-of-thought VLMs concentrates on specific fork tokens where visual claims are made. We introduce GEM-MM, extending entropy-guided preference modeling to VLMs. It samples on-policy candidates, rewards high-entropy reasoning forks, penalizes uncertain final answers, and updates the model via group-normalized policy gradients. On a 3000-prompt MM-RLHF budget with Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, GEM-MM achieves the best entropy-depth preference score (61.7% vs. 57.3-58.4% baselines) and implicit-reward accuracy (41.4%). Crucially, it reduces AMBER hallucination from 23.4-24.0 to 20.6 and CHAIR from 5.0-5.1 to 4.6 at matched caption coverage. It also ranks best on all three HallusionBench granularities, with a conservative operating point raising the near-chosen rate to 62.4%. An off-the-shelf multimodal reward model ranks GEM-MM first, and two such models independently confirm our main ablations (p < 0.001). We report confidence intervals, paired significance tests, metric-reward functional overlaps, and document a collapse mode when exceeding the fair budget. Code and evaluation harness: https://github.com/SNOWTEAM2023/GEM-MM

analysis.key_results: 在 3000 提示 MM-RLHF 预算下，GEM-MM 实现最佳熵深度偏好分数 61.7%（基线 57.3-58.4%），隐式奖励准确率 41.4%，AMBER 幻觉率降至 20.6，CHAIR 降至 4.6，且在 HallusionBench 各粒度排名最佳。
analysis.limitations: 摘要提到在超过公平预算时会出现崩溃模式（collapse mode），并报告置信区间和配对显著性检验，但未具体描述该崩溃模式的细节。

papers.abstract: Offline language models could extend access to maternal-health information where internet connectivity is unreliable, but deployment requires both clinically appropriate responses and feasible local execution. This study presents an offline Android assistant integrating ready-made quantized language models, a clinically validated local knowledge package, conversational context, and model-initiated local retrieval. Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen3.5 0.8B were compared across 45 conversations and 312 turns per configuration, including a dedicated offline agentic benchmark. Gemma achieved higher response-quality, context-retention, and safety scores; Qwen offered faster generation and lower memory use. Clinician assessment of 150 Gemma responses across nine clinical domains yielded a mean quality score of 3.80/4, with 147 responses meeting the acceptance criterion. A paired RAG-on/off experiment evaluated 74 questions: retrieval improved 11 responses, left 56 neutral, produced four adverse response changes, and left three pairs unassessable. RAG-on had descriptively higher mean usefulness, safety, correctness, and actionability in the conditional 70-pair subset excluding the four flagged pairs from both conditions. Physical-device testing demonstrated offline responses on a 6 GB Android handset, with a 14.3 s median latency, alongside successful reconnection synchronization in the integrated application. Together, the findings document clinical response quality and practical performance of the integrated offline maternal-health assistant.

analysis.key_results: Gemma在响应质量、上下文保留和安全性方面优于Qwen；Qwen推理速度更快且内存占用更低。150条Gemma响应经临床评估平均质量得分3.80/4，其中147条达到接受标准。14.3秒中位延迟，6GB Android设备可离线运行。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged in autonomous driving with the promise of strong generalization to long-tail scenarios. Although these models achieve state-of-the-art results on autonomous driving benchmarks, most existing benchmarks are dominated by nominal scenarios and therefore cannot test this promise. To test one such long-tail capability that is critical for safety, we introduce ReactBench-AD, a benchmark that measures how driving models react to objects that appear in the ego vehicle's path. Built on real NAVSIM and PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles scenes, ReactBench-AD composites a crossing pedestrian, a standing pedestrian, or a stationary car consistently across all camera views and history frames. Each edited scene thus forms an exact, pixel-level counterfactual pair with its original, which allows us to isolate the causal effect of the inserted object on the predicted trajectory. Evaluating four VLAs and two WAMs, we find that they react weakly, often barely at all. Finally, we test how easily one of the evaluated VLAs, ReCogDrive, can be taught to brake hard for imminent hazards: a short fine-tuning stage on edited scenes substantially improves its reactions, with the learned behavior generalizing to unseen objects and fully real scenes, at minimal cost to nominal driving. These results call into question the out-of-the-box long-tail capabilities of these models, but suggest that they can be a strong foundation for acquiring them with little additional training, highlighting the value of real or synthetic data that demonstrates the long-tail behaviors nominal datasets rarely contain. Code and data will be made publicly available.

analysis.key_results: 四个VLA和两个WAM对插入的物体反应微弱，通常几乎没有反应；对ReCogDrive进行少量微调可大幅改善其对迫近危险的反应，且该行为可泛化到未见物体和完全真实场景，同时对标称驾驶的性能代价很小
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ReactBench-AD基准，利用像素级反事实编辑构建精确对照场景，以因果方式评估驾驶模型对路径内迫近危险的即时反应，并展示对VLA进行少量微调可有效提升该长尾能力
analysis.method: 基于NAVSIM和PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles真实场景，在所有相机视图和历史帧中一致地合成穿过行人、站立行人或静止车辆，生成与原场景配对的反事实场景；评估四个VLA和两个WAM，并对ReCogDrive进行编辑场景上的短期微调

papers.abstract: Test-time scaling improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies by drawing several action candidates and executing the best one. We find that its returns diminish quickly when the candidates are resampled from one decoder: they differ by noise rather than by plan, and for each of three resampling sources, going from four to eight candidates adds only 0.06-0.07 to the average number of completed tasks on CALVIN. We introduce PlanDiv, an action head that makes the candidates differ by plan: a lightweight planner proposes K latent plan hypotheses, a shared masked-diffusion executor decodes one action chunk per plan from a single backbone pass, and the policy executes the chunk that its own likelihood ranks highest. The plans are learned from demonstrations alone, without plan labels or rewards. With the backbone, data and training recipe held fixed, eight plan-conditioned candidates raise five-task chain success on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D from 56.9% to 69.9%, while eight candidates from autoregressive, plan-free or same-plan resampling reach at most 64.9%. The same-plan baseline is PlanDiv's own checkpoint with the plan held fixed, so this gap comes from the plans, not from drawing more samples. On LIBERO-Long, four plans remove 40% of single-candidate failures, against at most 21% for matched resampling. On a real Franka arm the gain appears where a task admits more than one solution: PlanDiv is on par with a single-output OpenVLA-OFT+ baseline on a one-solution task and succeeds in 51 of 54 trials against 40 of 54 on two tasks with two solutions.

analysis.key_results: 在CALVIN ABC→D上，八个计划条件候选将五任务链成功率从56.9%提升至69.9%，而自回归、无计划或同计划重采样的最多64.9%；在LIBERO-Long上，四个计划消除了40%的单候选失败；真实Franka臂上在两解任务中51/54次成功对40/54次成功。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PlanDiv动作头，使候选动作在计划层面而非噪声层面产生差异，并通过自身似然排序选择最佳执行，从而在测试时缩放VLA策略且无需额外标注或奖励。
analysis.method: 轻量级规划器提出K个潜在计划假设，共享掩码扩散执行器从单次骨干网络传递中解码每个计划对应的动作块，策略执行自身似然最高的动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PlanDiv通过轻量级规划器提出多个潜在计划假设，并用共享掩码扩散执行器解码动作块，选择似然最高的块执行，从而在保持单次骨干网络传递的条件下实现测试时缩放，提升VLA策略的任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的测试时缩放问题，通过引入潜在计划实现计划层面的多样性，提升VLA在机器人操作任务中的表现，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Automated tunnel-lining inspection must segment different defect geometries: cracks are thin, elongated, and connectivity-sensitive, whereas leakage, lining falling off, and segment damage are spatially extensive and context-dependent. Existing approaches generally apply a common decoder across defect classes or introduce boundary, topology, and directional mechanisms as isolated enhancements. This paper introduces Morphology-Decoupled Segmentation (MDS), in which defect morphology becomes the organising principle for feature routing, decoding, and interaction. A supervised routing module partitions multiscale encoder features into complementary linear and areal streams. The linear stream employs Deformable Strip Attention with image-conditioned direction hypotheses to preserve crack continuity without assuming fixed horizontal or vertical orientations, while the areal stream combines Pyramid Pooling with feature-pyramid fusion to capture diffuse boundaries and regional context. The representations are coupled through gated cross-morphology attention, allowing complementary information exchange while retaining morphology-specific features. A resolution-adaptive tiling and probability-blending pipeline preserves fine defects across variable-resolution imagery. MDS achieves 81.17% mIoU on the internal validation set and improves foreground image-level recognition over a backbone-matched SegDINO model, primarily for areal defects. Controlled ablations demonstrate the complementary contributions of routing supervision and cross-stream interaction while revealing a trade-off between areal-class performance and crack specialisation. The submitted model achieved 67.55% mIoU on an organiser-controlled hidden test, and the team placed second. Selective dynamic INT8 quantisation reduced model storage by 2.83 times with negligible accuracy loss.

analysis.key_results: 内部验证集mIoU 81.17%，隐藏测试mIoU 67.55%获第二名；动态INT8量化减少存储2.83倍且精度损失可忽略。
analysis.limitations: 摘要指出在面状类性能与裂缝特化之间存在权衡。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出形态解耦分割方法，将缺陷形态作为特征路由、解码和交互的组织原则，包括线性流与面状流的互补架构以及跨形态注意耦合。
analysis.method: 监督路由模块将编码器特征分为线性流（可变形条带注意力与方向假设）和面状流（金字塔池化与特征金字塔融合），通过门控跨形态注意力交互，并使用分辨率自适应平铺与概率融合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出形态解耦分割网络（MDS），通过形态学引导的特征路由、解码与交互，提升隧道多类缺陷分割性能，并采用动态INT8量化减小模型存储。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于隧道缺陷分割的模型量化，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作/世界模型；仅模型量化部分对本研究方向有潜在通用价值。

papers.abstract: Rendered images are cheap to label, but a microcontroller classifier must survive 8-bit integer (INT8) quantisation and compute correctly on the chip. Five models, from MobileNetV2 at 224 px to a 61K-parameter convolutional neural network (CNN), were fine-tuned on a six-class scene dataset with and without a synthetic stage, against thresholds fixed in advance, and deployed on an ESP32-S3 and an RP2040. With full real data the stage gave no detectable gain. For the main deployable model the INT8 difference was +0.312 percentage points (pp), its interval below the +1.6 pp gain recomputed from the source study; quantisation did not detectably change it, nor did model size. With 10% of the real data the stage paid off for the CNN, by +3.438 pp on one seed and +2.715 pp over three; its cause is open. On the ESP32-S3 the main model took 152.7 ms and 16.3 mJ above idle per inference, and adding the stage changed neither beyond preset bounds. The model's INT8 outputs matched TensorFlow Lite's reference kernels exactly, but only after a memory overrun in a vendor kernel was patched. On the RP2040 the same model took 1.80 s and 27.3 mJ above idle, about twelve times slower, and the largest 96 px model exceeded the board's flash-capacity limit. Neither the RP2040 nor the host interpreter used for scoring reproduced the reference arithmetic. A synthetic stage is worth adding only when real data are scarce, and on-device INT8 outputs should be checked against reference kernels, not inferred from host scores.

analysis.key_results: 全量真实数据下合成阶段无增益；主模型INT8差分+0.312pp，低于源研究的+1.6pp；10%真实数据下CNN增益+3.438pp（单种子）或+2.715pp（多种子）；ESP32-S3上主模型推理152.7ms、16.3mJ，添加阶段无显著变化；RP2040上1.80s、27.3mJ，且最大模型超出闪存容量。
analysis.main_contribution: 量化评估了合成预训练阶段在微控制器部署中的实际收益，并强调了设备端INT8输出验证的必要性。
analysis.method: 在六类场景数据集上微调五种模型（MobileNetV2至61K参数CNN），在有/无合成阶段、固定阈值、部署于ESP32-S3和RP2040的条件下，比较INT8量化前后的精度、延迟与能耗。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究了在微控制器上部署INT8量化分类模型时，合成预训练阶段对精度、延迟和能耗的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系，属于独立模型量化研究，但提供了嵌入式部署中量化精度与硬件验证的方法学参考，对机器人端的VLA/WAM部署有潜在工程价值。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as an important paradigm in robot learning, jointly predicting future scene states and robot actions from current observations and instructions. However, future states entangle task-related changes with large amounts of task-irrelevant content, such as static backgrounds, which weakens the model's ability to capture changes relevant to task execution. To address this, we propose Difference World Action Model (DiffWAM), a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that enhances world representations by jointly learning future-state prediction and consecutive visual difference prediction. We define consecutive visual differences as differences between the latent representations of consecutive observations, providing an explicit learning signal for temporal variation. The framework comprises a World Expert for future frame prediction, an Action Expert for action generation, and a Diff Expert for predicting these latent differences along the trajectory. A structured unidirectional attention mask conditions the Diff, World, and Action Experts solely on the current-frame representation while blocking attention between experts. This design allows both the World and Diff Experts to be removed during inference, introducing no additional inference overhead. DiffWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks and substantially improves over FastWAM on real-world manipulation tasks. Specifically, it attains average success rates of 98.8%, 92.65%, and 88.3%, outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline (i.e., FastWAM) by 1.75, 1.55, and 15.0 percentage points, respectively.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到最先进性能，真实世界操作任务上优于 FastWAM，平均成功率分别为 98.8%、92.65%、88.3%，比 FastWAM 高 1.75、1.55、15.0 个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 DiffWAM，一种通过引入 Diff Expert 预测连续视觉差异来增强世界表示的混合专家框架，且可移除专家模块以避免增加推理开销。
analysis.method: 混合专家（MoE）框架，包含 World Expert、Action Expert 和 Diff Expert，采用结构化单向注意力掩码，仅依赖当前帧表示，并可移除 World 和 Diff Expert。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 DiffWAM，一种混合专家世界动作模型，通过联合预测未来状态和连续视觉差异来增强任务相关变化表示，并在推理时无额外开销。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 高度相关：该工作直接改进世界动作模型（WAM），通过差异建模增强任务相关状态预测，且可在推理时无额外开销移除模块，对机器人操控学习和高效推理具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Looped language models such as Ouro and Raven apply one weight-shared block several times per token, so autoregressive decoding (AR) runs every loop of every token in sequence. Pipelined self-speculative decoders overlap these loops by drafting tokens from shallow readouts and verifying them at full depth. Yet every loop of a looped LM ends in a readout of the next token, and draft tokens pass through every depth anyway, so each depth can check them without an extra pass. We introduce LoopSkim, in which the depth of the pipeline is the verifier. Draft tokens copied from the context, as in prompt lookup decoding, enter after the first loops, any later readout that contradicts one replaces it at that depth, and only full-depth readouts commit tokens. LoopSkim fixes the random draws of every position in advance, so each check compares two tokens and decoding stays lossless in exact arithmetic under sampling for any number of checks and draft chains. Without training, its speedup over AR averages 1.73x that of LoopSpec across greedy decoding and sampling, and its checks between the first loops and full depth speed it up on every model. An optional draft head adds a second chain and raises this average to 1.99x.

analysis.key_results: 在贪心解码和采样下，LoopSkim相对自回归解码的平均加速比为LoopSpec的1.73倍；加入可选草稿头后提高到1.99倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LoopSkim，一种适用于循环语言模型的无损多深度自投机解码方法，无需训练即可在多个模型上平均取得比LoopSpec高1.73倍的加速，加入可选草稿头后平均提升至1.99倍。
analysis.method: 将流水线深度作为验证器，利用上下文复制草稿token，在后续深度读出中逐层验证并替换，仅全深度读出的token才会被提交；同时预先固定每个位置的随机采样，保证精确算术下无损。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LoopSkim通过在循环语言模型的流水线各深度直接验证草稿token，实现了无损的多深度自投机解码并带来显著加速。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于循环语言模型的投机解码加速，未直接涉及VLA或WAM；但其无损多深度验证策略可为机器人策略模型的推理加速提供方法借鉴。

papers.abstract: Video world models promise to predict the future of a scene from its present. Do current models keep this promise? We probe this question counterfactually. When a small change to the present flips the future, such as a box resting a few millimeters before or past a table edge, a model that tracks the state of the world must flip its prediction too. We build FlipTest, a three-level hierarchy of increasingly strict tests over 1,680 initial frames from 10 simulated and 15 real-world tasks. At the base, visual minimal pairs, two nearly identical frames whose true futures differ, test whether predictions change across the boundary; matched controls go further and test whether they change only where the future does; and dense sweeps, the strictest level, locate exactly where they change. All 11 video world models we evaluate fall short. The best averages 18.3% pair accuracy over real and simulated scenes, below the 25% of random guessing. Models flip as often on steps that leave the future unchanged as on steps that change it, and their response stays flat across the sweeps. On the same frames, a vision-language model is selective and traces a near S-shaped curve near the boundary, and a coding agent that measures the image comes close to the true boundary. This implies that the deciding information is in the frame, and video models just miss it. We therefore urge the community to rethink world modeling as pure video prediction. Next-frame prediction must do more than draw plausible pixels; it must also identify the causal states that control future dynamics.

analysis.key_results: 所有11个视频世界模型表现不佳；最佳模型在真实和模拟场景上的平均对准确率仅为18.3%，低于随机猜测的25%；模型对改变未来与不改变未来的步骤翻转频率一样，且响应平坦；相比之下，视觉语言模型具有选择性并在边界附近呈现近S形曲线，编码代理接近真实边界。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FlipTest，一个三级递进的严格测试框架（视觉最小对、匹配控制、密集扫描），用于检验视频世界模型是否学习到控制未来动态的世界状态，并评估了11个模型。
analysis.method: 设计了基于反事实的FlipTest基准，包含1680个初始帧，涵盖10个模拟任务和15个真实世界任务，通过最小对、匹配控制和密集扫描三个层次评估模型行为。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过构建反事实的翻转测试框架，系统评估并揭示了当前视频世界模型在捕捉决定未来动态的因果状态上的不足。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接评估视频世界模型对世界状态的学习能力，对机器人世界模型（WAM）的评估与改进有重要方法学价值，但其本身不涉及VLA或具体的机器人策略学习。

papers.abstract: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.

analysis.key_results: 在多个具有挑战性的3D开放世界游戏中表现出扎实的泛化能力和接近熟练玩家的操作效率；在多种传统2D游戏基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个统一的端到端通用智能体框架Gamer，支持2D图形界面和3D模拟世界中的长时程实时交互，并通过大规模键盘鼠标轨迹的持续预训练、稀疏思考指令调优和稳定多轮强化学习，实现高效的训练与推理。
analysis.method: 利用数万小时设备级键盘和鼠标交互轨迹构建的数据集进行持续预训练，结合稀疏思考指令调优和面向长时程交互的多轮强化学习，并采用云端-边缘推理引擎支持并发模拟环境和低延迟在线推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Gamer是一个面向复杂交互环境中长时程任务的通用智能体框架，通过端到端架构结合感知、记忆管理和多步推理，在2D界面和3D模拟世界中训练和部署。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接相关。该工作属于VLA（视觉-语言-动作）基础模型，在模拟游戏和具身环境中学习跨数字与物理世界的动作执行能力，并强调了实时推理效率，与VLA/WAM的高效训练、部署和长时程决策主题高度契合。

At each step, the agent uses the current screen, task context, recent interaction history, long-term memory, and reasoning to generate native keyboard and mouse actions in real time. The agent interacts continuously through this loop. Cross-game training, multi-level supervision, and persistent memory support transferable control and sustained task execution.

papers.abstract: Independently pretrained language models and vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide complementary building blocks for embodied agents, but connecting them does not automatically produce coordinated behavior. The VLA may generate actions that diverge from the LLM's intended subtask and, upon regaining control after a correction, undo the promising state restored by the LLM. We introduce ESI (Embodied Self-Improvement), an automated flywheel that uses environmental interaction to align reasoning and action. ESI treats the modular agent as the unit of post-training, repeatedly refining the prompts that guide the LLM, the shared skill interface that expresses its intent, and the VLA parameters that realize that intent, then redeploying these components together. Our key insight is that collaboration itself can supply supervision for improving this interface. The LLM's subtask decisions provide semantic supervision for what the policy should execute, while its effective corrections and subsequent student continuations provide action-level supervision for recovery and handoff. The student also learns from its own effective execution, allowing locally useful experience to contribute even when the overall episode fails. On ten selected RoboDojo tasks, ESI achieves a mean Score of 62.03 and a mean success rate of 49.41% using an LLM-VLA agent without generating task-specific control code. On both metrics, it outperforms the published reference results of all hybrid embodied agents, including the Agent+WAM system GO-3 Nano Preview (47.27 Score and 36.60% success), as well as all compared code-based methods.

papers.abstract: Large language and vision-language models have substantially advanced robotic behavior planning from natural-language instructions and visual observations. However, safe manipulation in tabletop environments remains challenging because the safety constraints required for a task depend on the surrounding scene and may not be explicitly specified in the instruction. We propose a safety-aware behavior planning framework based on an explicit Constraint Space that stores reusable textual safety rules. Rather than retrieving rules solely by semantic similarity, we formulate constraint selection as task- and environment-conditioned applicability learning. A lightweight query-conditioned dual-tower model identifies the constraints applicable to the current context, which are then provided together with the original task and image to a multimodal behavior planner. To handle incorrect constraint selections and previously unseen hazards, we introduce a multimodal Safety Inspector that evaluates generated primitive plans, reconstructs the complete applicable constraint set, and provides corrective planning feedback. Validated inspection feedback is further used for test-time adaptation of constraint applicability and parameter-efficient adaptation of the Safety Inspector through LoRA, while newly identified constraints are incorporated into the Constraint Space. The resulting framework integrates explicit safety knowledge representation,context-aware constraint selection, corrective safety inspection, and test-time knowledge adaptation for safety-aware robotic behavior planning.

analysis.key_results: 摘要未说明

analysis.method: 使用轻量级查询条件双塔模型进行约束选择，通过多模态安全检查器评估生成的规划并重建约束集，利用LoRA进行参数高效适应，并将新识别的约束纳入约束空间。

papers.abstract: How do action budgets shape vision-language navigation (VLN) exploration, and what expert supervision best teaches budget-aware search? We study budget-conditioned object search: finding as many distinct instances of a requested category as possible within a budget, with discovery defined geometrically by camera field of view and proximity. Distinct discoveries provide a denser evaluation signal than single-target success. We cast expert design as a choice of scene abstraction: a single budget-indexed Bellman recursion, applied to different abstractions of the full environment, yields experts that differ in what they know. An object-level Bellman expert is given every target location and reduces search to budgeted routing. A room-level Bellman expert retains observed room connectivity, doorway evidence, and cross-scene semantic priors but withholds the contents of unexplored rooms, so it must search for targets that its student also cannot see. We distill both experts into Uni-NaVid under matched training conditions and also evaluate greedy-frontier supervision on held-out HM3D scenes. Changing only the stated budget changes learned trajectories. Despite higher object-level expert return, room-level supervision achieves the highest mean collection among evaluated VLNs at every tested budget. At 2000 steps, it finds 72.7% of reachable targets, versus 68.5% under greedy-frontier supervision, 65.5% under object-level supervision, and 44.8% for the pretrained VLN. These results show that expert-return rankings need not predict supervision quality for VLN exploration, and motivate choosing an expert's abstraction with the student's information in mind rather than by expert return alone.

analysis.key_results: 在2000步预算下，房间级专家监督的Uni-NaVid找到72.7%的可达目标，优于贪心前沿的68.5%、对象级监督的65.5%和预训练VLN的44.8%；在所有测试预算下均取得最高平均收集数。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出通过预算索引的Bellman递归在不同场景抽象上设计专家，并证明房间级抽象专家虽然返回较低，但能为学生VLN提供更优的监督，显著提升预算约束目标搜索的表现。
analysis.method: 采用预算索引的Bellman递归，分别构建对象级和房间级专家，并通过蒸馏训练Uni-NaVid；同时与贪心前沿监督进行对比。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文研究如何通过不同的专家场景抽象（对象级与房间级Bellman专家）来训练预算约束的视觉语言导航代理，以最大化在有限步数内发现的目标类别实例数量。

papers.abstract: Embodied interaction requires an agent to integrate multimodal perception with verbal and nonverbal behaviors to effectively communicate its intentions, including speech, body motion, and facial expressions. We present XBot-Omni, a Thinker--Talker--Actor architecture that extends the Omni paradigm to robotic modalities, including body motion and facial expressions, with ``X'' representing the extensibility to robotic-specific modalities. The Thinker processes text, images, audio, and video to formulate contextually appropriate responses, which are then realized by the Talker and Actor through speech and coordinated bodily expressions, respectively. In this report, we innovatively introduce the concept of ``Actor'' as a dedicated component for embodied agents: a coordinated, streaming module that leverages the native representations of the Thinker and Talker within an end-to-end pipeline, introducing only modest latency overhead. This unified architecture enables multimodal generation conditioned on omni-modal inputs directly to prevent information loss in staged designs. We comprehensively evaluate XBot-Omni across seven benchmarks, demonstrating strong multimodal understanding capabilities on both general-domain and robot-centric videos, as well as high-quality, natural, and well-coordinated motion generation. Furthermore, our results validate its capability to generate embodied multimodal responses directly from omni inputs, meeting the diverse requirements of embodied interaction. XBot-Omni enables robots not only to perceive the omni world but also to express themselves through speech and bodily behaviors, extending Omni models from conversational interaction to embodied communication in physical environments.

analysis.key_results: 在七个基准上评估，展现出强大的多模态理解能力（涵盖通用领域和机器人中心视频）以及高质量、自然、协调的动作生成，并能直接从全模态输入生成具身多模态响应。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种Thinker-Talker-Actor架构的全模态模型XBot-Omni，扩展Omni范式到机器人模态，引入Actor作为具身代理的专用组件，实现端到端的多模态生成。
analysis.method: 采用Thinker-Talker-Actor架构，Thinker处理文本、图像、音频和视频以制定上下文响应，Talker和Actor分别生成语音和协调的身体动作，所有模块在端到端管线中集成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Thinker-Talker-Actor架构的全模态模型XBot-Omni，使机器人能基于多模态输入生成协调的语音、肢体动作和面部表情，实现具身交互。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文核心是面向具身交互的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，直接结合机器人模态，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Physical AI aims to learn transferable physical knowledge from real-world experience to understand, predict, and act in the physical world. Internet videos and embodied demonstrations provide complementary observations of motion, interaction, and state evolution. A foundational data challenge is to measure and preserve this physical information as training supervision. In video-language pretraining, captions express observed processes in language, yet a semantically correct description can omit the interactions and transitions that define those processes. Rich physical experience in video does not automatically translate into sufficient language supervision. This gap calls for a yardstick to assess annotation quality, compare captioning strategies, and guide training-data refinement. Motivated by our data construction for world-model pretraining, we introduce PhysCapBench, to our knowledge the first unified physical-caption benchmark spanning all three domains: third-person scenes, egocentric manipulation, and handheld-gripper demonstrations. It provides human-verified annotations for 1,500 video sequences and evaluates accuracy and coverage through seven physical dimensions. We examine downstream utility through video reconstruction and manipulation-policy fine-tuning. Physical captions reduce reconstruction LPIPS by 8.6-9.5% on third-person videos and 26.9-30.9% on egocentric videos relative to metadata captions. Training-instruction enrichment improves both PhysCapBench scores and policy success, including a 7.5-percentage-point gain for pi0.5 on a RoboTwin 2.0 subtask. PhysCapBench makes the physical content of language supervision inspectable and comparable, providing a cross-domain basis for its evaluation and improvement.

analysis.key_results: 物理描述相比元数据描述在第三人称视频上重建LPIPS降低8.6-9.5%，在自我中心视频上降低26.9-30.9%；训练指令丰富化同时提高PhysCapBench得分和策略成功率，包括在RoboTwin 2.0子任务上pi0.5获得7.5个百分点的提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了第一个统一的物理描述（physical-caption）基准PhysCapBench，覆盖第三人称场景、自我中心操作和手持夹爪演示三个领域，并提供人工验证的标注来评估描述的准确性和覆盖范围。
analysis.method: 构建了包含1,500个视频序列的基准数据集，在七个物理维度上评估描述质量，并通过视频重建和操作策略微调来检验下游实用性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了PhysCapBench，一个评估视频描述（captioning）物理内容质量与覆盖范围的跨域基准，并展示了其在世界模型预训练和机器人操作策略微调中的实用性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准旨在衡量语言监督中的物理信息质量，对世界模型预训练和机器人操作策略微调有直接价值；虽不涉及VLA或WAM具体模型架构，但可作为评估和改进这些模型训练数据中物理基础描述的工具。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models drive the robot directly from camera views, yet a VLA alone shows three typical failures. It walks past the goal, stops before reaching it, and rarely recovers after going off track. Pairing a VLA with a large language model (LLM) planner fixes these failures, but queries the LLM throughout every episode, adding token costs and latency. We introduce Harness-to-Executor (H2E), a task-level distillation method that pairs an LLM planner and a frozen VLA as a heterogeneous training agent, keeps only sessions that reach the goal, and then trains a VLA alone on them so no LLM is used at test time. In these sessions, the planner gives sub-instructions and moves the robot with its own tools, detours are common, and the planner decides when to stop. H2E therefore labels every motion as a VLA action for the original task, whoever made it. It masks the loss on steps moving away from the goal and assigns end labels to states near it, so the VLA learns where the task ends. H2E sets a new state of the art on REVERIE-CE and NavRAG-CE. It raises an 8B VLA's success rate by 15.6% and 11.1% respectively, surpassing a method trained on 10M samples. The distilled VLA exceeds its agent on unseen episodes with zero LLM tokens and runs 3.7 times faster.

analysis.key_results: 在 REVERIE-CE 和 NavRAG-CE 上取得新 SOTA；8B VLA 成功率分别提升 15.6% 和 11.1%，超过使用 10M 样本训练的方法；蒸馏后的 VLA 在零 LLM token 下超过其训练代理，且运行速度快 3.7 倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Harness-to-Executor (H2E) 方法，通过任务级经验蒸馏消除 VLA 对 LLM 规划器的依赖，并提升具身导航性能。
analysis.method: 以 LLM 规划器和冻结 VLA 作为异构训练代理，保留成功轨迹，将其中所有运动标注为原始任务的 VLA 动作，对远离目标的步骤掩盖损失，并为目标附近状态赋予终止标签，训练独立的 VLA。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一种任务级蒸馏方法，将 LLM 规划器与冻结 VLA 配对产生的成功轨迹蒸馏到单独的 VLA，从而在测试时无需 LLM 并提升导航成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作以 VLA 为核心，通过蒸馏提升其独立执行能力和推理效率，直接属于 VLA 研究范畴；未涉及世界模型或动作预测之外的 WAM 内容。

papers.abstract: Industrial manipulation requires precise alignment and controlled handling of rigid, deformable, and flexible components. Yet, the benefits of pretrained visuomotor policies remain underexplored in settings where limited access to specialized hardware, components, and fixtures constrains demonstration collection and evaluation. Understanding task-specific data requirements is important for assessing their scalability across diverse processes on the factory floor. We investigate whether video pretraining can support reliable industrial manipulation with limited action data. We propose FLUX-mimic, a video-action model, motivated by the potential of video pretraining to capture motion and interaction patterns that enable sample-efficient training. FLUX-mimic is built on a backbone pretrained on large-scale web and industrial task data, and an action expert to generate robot trajectories. We train our policy by joint video-action training. Across four automotive manufacturing benchmark tasks and two bimanual robot platforms, FLUX-mimic outperforms all considered baselines on the dexterous robot platform and matches pi_{0.5}'s average success rate on the gripper-based robot platform. On a deformable part kitting task, FLUX-mimic reaches 77.5% success with as little as two hours of task-specific action-labeled demonstrations.

analysis.key_results: 在四个汽车制造基准任务和两个双臂机器人平台上，FLUX-mimic优于所有对比基线，并达到pi_0.5的平均成功率；在可变形零件配套任务中，仅用两小时任务特定动作标注演示即达到77.5%成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FLUX-mimic视频-动作模型，利用大规模网络和工业任务数据预训练的视频骨干结合动作专家，在工业操作中实现高样本效率。
analysis.method: 基于视频预训练骨干和动作专家生成机器人轨迹，通过联合视频-动作训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出视频-动作模型FLUX-mimic，通过视频预训练实现数据高效的工业机器人操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，通过视频预训练提升机器人操作的数据效率，属于VLA和机器人动作预测核心主题。

papers.abstract: Imitation policies can fail through compounding errors, while existing refinement methods often require additional on-policy learning or expensive online planning. Our key insight is to model the response to small corrections around a policy proposal in an affine form that enables fast optimization. We refine a frozen imitation policy using an \textit{action-affine world model} (A\textsuperscript{2}WM), trained offline from perturbed policy rollouts. Conditioned on history and the proposal, the model directly predicts a nominal trajectory and a linear action response over the full horizon. With quadratic costs and linear constraints, refinement becomes a cheap quadratic program (QP), requiring only one model evaluation and one QP solve per control step. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to combine an action-affine world model with QP-based inference-time refinement of frozen imitation policies. Across four manipulation tasks, our framework achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines, adding only 4.2 ms of mean refinement latency per control step, excluding base-policy sampling.

analysis.key_results: 在四个操作任务中，框架在所有评估基线中达到最高成功率，平均精炼延迟每控制步仅4.2毫秒（不包括基础策略采样）。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次将动作仿射世界模型与基于二次规划的推理时精炼结合，用于冻结模仿策略，在四个操作任务上达到最高成功率且每控制步仅增加4.2毫秒精炼延迟。
analysis.method: 训练离线动作仿射世界模型，预测名义轨迹和全时域线性动作响应；利用二次代价和线性约束，将精炼问题转化为二次规划，每控制步仅需一次模型评估和一次QP求解。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出用动作仿射世界模型对冻结模仿策略进行推理时精炼，将精炼问题转化为二次规划，实现低延迟和高质量控制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于世界模型（WAM）在机器人操作中的应用，通过动作仿射世界模型实现快速策略精炼，与本站主题高度相关，但未直接涉及VLA；其方法具有可借鉴性，可用于VLA策略的推理时优化。

With F F and Z ¯ \bar{Z} fixed, quadratic task costs and linear correction bounds define a convex QP over Δ ​ A \Delta A . The first optimized correction is applied to the base action, and refinement repeats after the next observation. Both the base policy and world model remain frozen during deployment.

papers.abstract: Robots that travel long distances through public outdoor spaces must do more than avoid obstacles: they must remain on terrain suited to their mobility and decide when to proceed, yield, or detour around pedestrians, cyclists, vehicles, traffic signals, and temporary restrictions. These decisions are difficult because their correctness often depends on how a scene evolves, such as whether an approaching car is slowing or a cyclist will cross the robot's path. Vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret such cues, but they reason over images that lack metric geometry and motion. Supplying this evidence at every step is too slow for real-time navigation, and hand-crafted triggers cannot anticipate the open-ended variety of outdoor situations. We present MOSU2, a long-range navigation system with two-stage trajectory selection, in which first-stage contextual reasoning determines when additional evidence is needed and what to retrieve. Only when an interaction remains unresolved does the first stage trigger the second stage to retrieve geometric and dynamic information and align it with scene context to make navigation decisions. Building on MOSU, MOSU2 follows routes from GPS-based route planning and filters candidate trajectories through multi-modal traversability analysis before selecting a trajectory to move the robot. In real-world experiments spanning stop gestures, construction sites, crosswalks, and roads shared with vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians, MOSU2 raises mean navigation success from 61.8% to 94.2% and condition-detection accuracy from 72.2% to 91.4% over its single-image predecessor, at about 2.2 times its mean decision latency. Project website: https://jinggm.github.io/mosu2/

analysis.key_results: 在真实世界实验中，MOSU2将平均导航成功率从61.8%提高到94.2%，条件检测准确率从72.2%提高到91.4%，平均决策延迟约是单图像前身系统的2.2倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了MOSU2系统，通过两阶段轨迹选择，在第一阶段进行上下文推理以决定何时需要额外证据，并触发第二阶段检索几何和动态信息进行导航决策，显著提升真实世界户外长距离导航性能。
analysis.method: 两阶段轨迹选择：第一阶段上下文推理决定何时需要额外证据以及检索什么；第二阶段在交互未解决时触发，检索几何和动态信息并结合场景上下文做出导航决策。系统遵循GPS路径规划，并通过多模态可通行性分析过滤候选轨迹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MOSU2是一个使用两阶段轨迹选择和多模态场景理解的长距离户外导航系统，在真实世界实验中显著提升了导航成功率和条件检测精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于视觉-语言机器人导航，核心是利用VLM进行上下文推理，但未涉及世界模型（WAM）或动作-世界建模的预测学习；与VLA/WAM主题有部分方法学关联（VLM用于机器人决策），但非直接针对VLA或世界模型的研究。

papers.abstract: Spatial agents must interpret observations, maintain consistent spatial memory and make decisions over long interactions. We use Pac-Man as a testbed to study the training challenges behind these capabilities in a Qwen3.5-9B-based agent. Our research trajectory progresses from primitive-action RL on text-based mazes to visual inputs with an internal-state-assisted harness, then toward observation-driven memory and joint policy--harness improvement. The main analysis focuses on text-based maze RL; supplementary sections report visual-adaptation and harness experiments and discuss subsequent directions. Text-based maze RL requires curriculum and training-recipe design to overcome cold starts; normal-start clear rates on eight held-out mazes rise from 0% to a peak of 81.25%. In the second step, model adaptation and harness improvements raise the clear rate from 26.6% to 96.9% on one fixed map with three extra lives. These results highlight three development lessons: use curricula to address cold starts, establish visual grounding before language adaptation, and treat harness design as a determinant of agent performance. They provide practical guidance for subsequent VLM training and spatial-agent development.

analysis.key_results: 文本迷宫RL通过课程和训练配方设计，在八个保留迷宫上的正常启动通关率从0%提升至81.25%；在固定地图上，模型适应和外部状态辅助将通关率从26.6%提升至96.9%。
analysis.main_contribution: 通过文本迷宫强化学习和视觉适应实验，揭示训练空间智能体的三个关键教训：使用课程学习克服冷启动、先建立视觉基础再进行语言适应、以及将外部状态辅助视为智能体性能的决定因素。
analysis.method: 采用基于Qwen3.5-9B的智能体，在文本迷宫上进行基础动作强化学习，并通过内部状态辅助和观察驱动记忆进行视觉适应性训练及联合策略改进。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文以吃豆人游戏为测试平台，研究基于Qwen3.5-9B的视觉-语言智能体在感知、空间记忆和长程决策中的训练挑战。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究视觉-语言智能体的空间记忆、决策和感知失败，属于VLA类智能体的行为训练和诊断，虽不涉及机器人操作或世界模型，但其训练经验（课程学习、视觉基础、辅助设计）对VLA训练具有直接借鉴意义。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a promising path toward general-purpose robot manipulation. While inference latency can affect task success in a constantly evolving physical world, the relationship between latency and task success rate remains poorly understood. In this paper, we introduce VLALagBench, a comprehensive benchmark for studying VLA inference latency sensitivity across task types, object speeds, execution modes (synchronous and asynchronous), and VLA policies. Using VLALagBench, we find that even a modest inference latency of 100 ms can nearly halve task success on moving targets, with sensitivity varying substantially across tasks and policies. These differences reflect task-specific requirements for precision and continuous motion. By overlapping inference with action execution, asynchronous execution can recover some of the lost success at the cost of more frequent inference requests. Building on these findings, we develop an empirical model that predicts task success from limited calibration data, achieving root-mean-square prediction errors of only 5.7-7.8% across various VLA policies. Given an inference system's latency and per-robot throughput, these predictions guide the selection of system-specific VLA algorithm configurations to maximize task success. We believe VLALagBench and these findings provide a solid foundation for future robotics algorithm-system co-design.

analysis.key_results: 100ms的推理延迟可使移动目标任务成功率几乎减半；不同任务和策略的敏感性差异显著；异步执行可部分恢复成功率但增加推理请求频率；预测模型在多种VLA策略下的均方根误差仅为5.7-7.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入VLALagBench基准，系统研究VLA推理延迟对任务成功率的影响，并提出基于有限校准数据预测任务成功率的经验模型，用于指导算法-系统协同设计。
analysis.method: 通过构建VLALagBench基准，在不同任务类型、物体速度、执行模式（同步/异步）和VLA策略下测量推理延迟对任务成功率的影响；基于校准数据建立经验预测模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出了一个评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推理延迟敏感性的基准VLALagBench，并建立了预测任务成功率的经验模型。

papers.abstract: We present See, Think, Use, a protocol that traces each answer of a vision-language model to perception, reasoning or the use of perception. The diagnosis shows a developer which stage to improve and directs test-time compute to the stage that fails. Benchmarks score the final answer, and an answer that rests on the image earns the same credit as a guess or a memorized prior. The protocol asks the model two extra questions per item and needs no access to its weights. A localization probe asks for a box around every instance and measures seeing, and a text-replacement probe answers from a description and measures thinking. Use is the rate at which the answer follows the model's own perception across counterfactual image pairs. The rate needs no answer labels, because the question and its prior are the same on both images. On two model families and six datasets the protocol shows that the knob that helps follows the task family. Answers follow the model's perception except on images that contradict a common prior, and asking the model to localize first repairs this failure when its boxes are right. Allocating compute by the measured stages comes close to the best uniform policy at lower cost and beats a random allocation of the same compute wherever a knob raises the short stage. We will release the code, the prompts and the per-question outputs.

analysis.key_results: 在六个数据集上两个模型家族中，模型的答案通常遵循自身感知，但在违背常见先验的图像上失败；先定位可修复此失败；按测量阶段分配计算接近最优统一策略且优于随机分配。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出See, Think, Use协议，通过定位探针、文本替换探针和反事实图像对，将VLM的答案归因于感知、推理或感知使用阶段，并指导测试时计算分配。
analysis.method: 定位探针要求模型框出每个实例以衡量感知；文本替换探针根据描述回答以衡量推理；反事实图像对衡量感知使用率。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种诊断VLM答案背后感知、推理与感知使用情况的协议，无需模型权重，通过定位探针、文本替换探针和反事实图像对来衡量各阶段。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文提出的诊断协议对视觉语言模型的感知与推理阶段进行归因，可迁移到VLA或机器人世界模型的分析与评估，但摘要未直接涉及机器人或VLA/WAM。

papers.abstract: Human demonstrations offer an efficient and scalable source of data for dexterous robot manipulation, but differences in sensing and hand morphology complicate the transfer of contact-rich interactions. We present TouchBridge, a hardware--software co-designed framework for human-to-robot data transformation. A wearable human demonstration interface and a corresponding robot interface establish cross-embodiment correspondence in visual and fingertip tactile sensing. We introduce Tac-Retarget, a tactile-conditioned retargeting method that uses measured contact to align fingertip contact patches and preserve their spatial relations within and across hands. Unlike object-aware or simulation-based transfer pipelines, Tac-Retarget requires no object mesh, object-pose estimate, or physics simulation for retargeting, enabling direct and scalable conversion of human demonstrations into robot-domain training data. Combined with visual synthesis and camera-anchored action conversion, TouchBridge produces robot-domain demonstrations for fine-tuning a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model. Across four real-world contact-rich tasks, policies fine-tuned solely on TouchBridge-converted human demonstrations achieve a 72.5% average success rate, compared with 77.5% using an equal number of teleoperated robot demonstrations, while human demonstration collection is 7.0x faster. Under the same policy and training setup, Tac-Retarget outperforms DexPilot and UniDex by 25.0 and 42.5 percentage points, respectively.

analysis.key_results: 在四个真实世界接触丰富任务中，仅使用TouchBridge转换的人类演示微调的策略平均成功率为72.5%，与等量遥操作机器人演示的77.5%接近，人类演示采集速度快7.0倍；Tac-Retarget在相同策略和训练设置下优于DexPilot和UniDex分别25.0和42.5个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出硬件-软件协同设计的人机数据转换框架TouchBridge，以及触觉条件重定向方法Tac-Retarget，无需物体网格、姿态估计或物理仿真即可建立跨实施例对应并转换人类演示为机器人训练数据。
analysis.method: 利用可穿戴人类演示接口和机器人接口建立视觉与指尖触觉的跨实施例对应；Tac-Retarget利用实测接触对齐指尖接触斑块并保持空间关系；结合视觉合成和相机锚定动作转换生成机器人域演示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出TouchBridge框架，通过触觉条件重定向方法Tac-Retarget将人类演示高效转换为机器人训练数据，用于微调VLA模型实现接触丰富的灵巧操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接聚焦于机器人操作与VLA模型的训练数据问题，从方法论上与WAM/VLA的数据构建密切相关，其触觉条件跨实施例转换有望为机器人世界模型和VLA策略提供高效的数据来源。

papers.abstract: Recent advances in video world models have enabled increasingly realistic and interactive virtual environments, opening new possibilities for player-customizable gameplay. Agentic frameworks further advance this direction by decoupling explicit game logic and controllable world representations from visual generation. However, existing approaches support only simple game settings and predefined motion patterns, generalize poorly to unseen environments and characters, and offer limited real-time interactivity. In this paper, we introduce Wizard, an agentic game world model that enables real-time, precise control over character motions while generalizing zero-shot across novel scenes, characters, and actions. To achieve this, we construct a diverse dataset spanning 805 scenes and 178 characters, incorporating skeleton and geometry information as structured proxies to condition video generation. Our agentic framework explicitly tracks and updates game states to support character-aware adaptive masking and world-anchored spatial conditioning, improving character identity preservation and spatial consistency. Experiments on WBench show that our method achieves higher gameplay fidelity with comparable video quality and spatiotemporal consistency, while using fewer parameters and less training data than state-of-the-art world models. These advantages are also retained in our two-step real-time variant. Overall, Wizard combines agentic control with structured proxy-based generation to enable player-driven game creation with real-time, generalizable, and mechanically consistent world simulation.

analysis.key_results: 在WBench上，相比最先进世界模型，Wizard以更少参数和更少训练数据获得更高的游戏保真度，并保持可比的视频质量和时空一致性；这些优势在两步实时变体中也得到保留。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Wizard，一个代理式游戏世界模型，能在实时、精确控制角色动作的同时，零样本泛化到新场景、新角色和新动作。
analysis.method: 构建包含805个场景和178个角色的多样化数据集，利用骨架与几何信息作为结构化代理条件视频生成，并通过代理框架跟踪和更新游戏状态，实现角色感知自适应掩码和世界锚定空间条件。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个代理式游戏世界模型Wizard，通过结构化代理和显式游戏状态跟踪，实现实时、零样本且可泛化的角色动作控制与视频生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于世界模型，专注于游戏环境的实时视频生成与控制，并未涉及机器人动作预测或VLA；其结构化条件生成和实时交互思想对具身世界模型可能有一定的参考价值，但无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterogeneous mixture of 1.44 million object-level samples spanning simulated and real-world domains. We further introduce WorldFlowBench, comprising 1,678 evaluation samples from 11 data sources across simulated and real-world interactions, including spatial reasoning tasks. Across all three evaluation sets, WorldFlow achieves the lowest average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) among the evaluated learning-based methods. Notably, on the challenging SpatialCog set, WorldFlow achieves an ADE of 0.060 m, a 54.2\% reduction compared with the strongest external baseline. It also reduces ADE and FDE by 55.9\% and 68.5\%, respectively, compared with its flow-only variant. Project page: https://worldflow-rbs.github.io/.

analysis.key_results: 在三个评估集上取得最低的平均位移误差和最终位移误差；在 SpatialCog 上 ADE 为 0.060 米，比最强外部基线降低 54.2%；与仅用光流监督的变体相比，ADE 和 FDE 分别降低 55.9% 和 68.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 WorldFlow，一个联合预测未来视频和查询式三维轨迹的生成式世界模型，通过统一的 Mixture-of-Transformers 骨干在 rectified-flow 目标下联合去噪两种模态，从而显式耦合几何动力学与视觉演化，并利用预训练视频模型中的物理常识。
analysis.method: 将三维运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移 token，使用统一的 Mixture-of-Transformers 骨干在 rectified-flow 目标下联合去噪视频和三维轨迹；在 144 万物体级样本（仿真和真实领域混合）上进行训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: WorldFlow 提出一个生成式世界模型，通过联合预测未来视频和基于查询的三维轨迹，并在大规模混合数据上训练，在多个基准上取得了最低的预测误差。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接致力于机器人世界模型研究，属于 WAM 核心主题；通过联合预测视频和 3D 轨迹，显式建模物理动力学，对机器人动作预测和策略学习具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) introduce predictive supervision into robot policy learning by jointly modeling future visual observations and actions. Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies acquire rich visual and semantic representations as well as action-generation capabilities. Their action objectives typically lack direct supervision for predicting future visual observations. Future videos in robot demonstrations record object motion and task progress. They can provide temporal visual supervision that complements action labels. We propose Training-Only Video Supervision, which introduces future-video prediction as an auxiliary objective for VLA fine-tuning. We condition a randomly initialized video-prediction expert on the VLA's shared vision-language features. The expert learns to predict future video latents from robot demonstrations. The video prediction loss and the original action loss jointly update the shared vision-language backbone, providing additional temporal visual supervision. After training, we remove the video expert and its adapter. The fine-tuned VLA retains its original action-generation pathway at inference. On the 50-task RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, our method achieves 71.18% average success, compared with $\pi_{0.5}$ of 58.33%. In a matched evaluation on four real-world manipulation tasks, success increases from 42.50% to 61.25%. These results show that future visual modeling can serve as auxiliary training supervision for pretrained VLAs. The fine-tuned action policy benefits from this supervision without retaining a video-prediction branch at deployment.

analysis.key_results: 在50任务RoboTwin 2.0基准上平均成功率达到71.18%，高于基线π0.5的58.33%；在四个真实世界操作任务中，成功率从42.50%提升到61.25%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出仅训练阶段视频监督方法，将未来视频预测作为辅助目标联合微调预训练VLA策略，无需在部署时保留视频预测分支。
analysis.method: 随机初始化的视频预测专家以VLA共享的视觉语言特征为条件，通过预测未来视频潜在表示产生损失，与原始动作损失共同更新共享视觉语言骨干网络。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出在预训练VLA策略微调中引入未来视频预测作为辅助训练监督，从而提升机器人操作策略的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法直接改进预训练VLA策略，通过引入视频预测作为辅助监督，与WAM利用未来视觉模型增强策略的理念一致，为VLA微调提供了新的时间视觉监督途径。

figures.caption: Future-Video Prediction as Training-Only Supervision for Pretrained VLA Policies. (a,b): Pretrained VLAs learn to map current visual observations to actions conditioned on language instructions and proprioceptive state. However, their original action-learning objective primarily constrains the correspondence between current observations and target actions, providing limited direct supervision for how the environment changes visually after action execution. The dashed box highlights future observations in the demonstrations, which can provide additional temporal visual supervision. (c): Our training-time video-prediction objective introduces additional temporal visual supervision into the shared representations of the pretrained VLA. The video-prediction loss updates the shared VLM through auxiliary gradients (orange dashed arrow), while gray arrows denote forward computation. The video expert and its adapter are removed at inference. (d): Reported average success rates on RoboTwin 2.0 for the original π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} reference, recent WAM methods, and our variants. Randomly initialized DiT-2.2B achieves 71.18%, outperforming the original reference (58.33%) and the pretrained DiT-2.2B variant (68.04%), indicating that performance gains can be achieved without pretrained Video DiT generation weights under our experimental settings. (e): Four real-world tasks and representative execution frames. Overall success increases from 42.50% to 61.25% (+18.75 percentage points), over 80 trials per policy.

The shared VLM processes current observations, language, and state to condition the action expert and a training-only video expert. A frozen video encoder supplies video latents, and the randomly initialized DiT-2.2B expert learns future-latent flow prediction conditioned on shared VLM features. The dashed orange arrow shows the video-loss gradient updating the shared VLM. The auxiliary branch is removed at inference, leaving only the shared VLM and action expert for deployment.

papers.title_zh: 面向预训练VLA策略的仅训练阶段未来视频预测监督

papers.abstract: Generative image compression (GIC) delivers strong perceptual quality. However, GIC methods with strong perceptual quality often rely on pretrained diffusion models with high latency, while recent lightweight GIC methods reduce latency but compromise perceptual quality. At low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can map nearby encoder latents representing different fine details to the same quantized point, making those details difficult to recover. Motivated by this, we propose GR-GIC which delivers competitive compression performance with fast inference. For better performance, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR), which combines latent refinement guided by entropy context with adaptive perturbations, jointly improving reconstruction at low bitrates. For fast inference, we introduce reorganized projected residual vector quantization, which equivalently reorganizes residual updates into low-dimensional lookups to expose greater parallelism and reduce latency. Experiments on Kodak show that GR-GIC achieves BD-rate savings of 22.09%, 42.14%, 19.35%, and 30.87% over OneDC for LPIPS, DISTS, PSNR, and FID, respectively. Moreover, our CUDA implementation encodes and decodes in 2.81 and 3.48 ms on an NVIDIA A100, achieving $27.36\times$ and $58.77\times$ speedups over the official OneDC implementation, respectively. We further evaluate GR-GIC on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, demonstrating competitive coding speed on edge hardware.

analysis.key_results: 在 Kodak 上，GR-GIC 相比 OneDC 在 LPIPS、DISTS、PSNR、FID 上分别达到 22.09%、42.14%、19.35%、30.87% 的 BD-rate 节省；在 NVIDIA A100 上编码 2.81 ms、解码 3.48 ms，比 OneDC 官方实现快 27.36 倍和 58.77 倍；在 Jetson Orin NX 上具有竞争力的编码速度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 GR-GIC，一个快速且感知质量强的生成式图像压缩方法。
analysis.method: 结合熵上下文引导的潜在精修与自适应扰动（GR），以及重组投影残差向量量化以提高并行度和降低延迟。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 GR-GIC，通过引导精修和重组投影残差向量量化，实现高质量生成式图像压缩并大幅降低编解码延迟。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文为图像压缩中的量化技术，与 VLA/WAM 无直接关系，但其低延迟量化思想可为机器人策略或世界模型的高效推理提供参考。

figures.caption: Reconstruction performance and computational cost on Kodak, with latency measured on an NVIDIA A100. Quality axes show BD-rate relative to OneDC on linear scales, while cost axes use logarithmic scales. Larger radii indicate better results.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Motivation and overview of GR-GIC. (a) Images with similar coarse content but different fine details are mapped to nearby points in the continuous latent space. (b) At low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can collapse these distinct latents to the same quantized point, leaving their fine detail differences unspecified. (c) GR uses entropy context to define a Gaussian refinement distribution around the recovered latent and introduces adaptive perturbations during training. (d) System overview of GR-GIC.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Efficient Generative Image Compression with Quantized Latents Refinement
papers.title_zh: 高效生成式图像压缩：量化潜在变量精修

papers.abstract: Conventional digital image transmission typically optimizes source coding, channel coding, and modulation separately, limiting how source representations adapt to channel impairments. Such impairments can corrupt the latent representations recovered at the receiver and propagate through autoregressive coding, degrading reconstruction quality. We propose SemQAM, a unified generative image codec that supports conventional source coding and joint semantic-channel coding and modulation within a single model. SemQAM represents latent features using vector quantization (VQ), maps the resulting indices to QAM symbols, and updates the codeword selected by the detected index, encouraging easily confused symbols to represent similar latent features. We also use the conditional expectation of received codewords to approximate the receiver reconstruction at the transmitter, reducing error propagation during autoregressive coding without feedback. In the special case of noiseless transmission, SemQAM reduces to a conventional source codec called SemQAM-C. Experiments show that (i) SemQAM-C achieves lower bitrates than OneDC at matched LPIPS and DISTS, with approximately $27\times$ faster decoding. (ii) Compared with the separated SemQAM-C system using LDPC and QAM, SemQAM further achieves BD-CBR savings of 30.85%, 28.06%, and 28.80% on LPIPS, DISTS, and FID, respectively, demonstrating the benefit of joint optimization.

analysis.key_results: SemQAM-C 在匹配 LPIPS 和 DISTS 时比 OneDC 实现更低码率，解码速度约快 27 倍；与分离的 SemQAM-C 加 LDPC 和 QAM 系统相比，SemQAM 在 LPIPS、DISTS 和 FID 上分别实现 30.85%、28.06% 和 28.80% 的 BD-CBR 节省。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SemQAM，一个支持常规源编码和联合语义信道编码调制的统一生成式图像编解码器，利用 VQ 索引与 QAM 符号的映射以及条件期望近似来抑制错误传播。
analysis.method: 使用向量量化表示隐特征，将 VQ 索引映射为 QAM 符号，用检测索引更新码字以鼓励易混淆符号表示相似特征，并在发射端用接收码字的条件期望近似重建以减轻自回归编码中的错误传播。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SemQAM 是一种统一的生成式图像编解码器，通过向量量化将隐特征映射到 QAM 符号，并在单一模型中联合优化源编码、信道编码和调制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于生成式图像传输中的联合语义信道编码与量化，属于独立的高效推理/压缩方向，与 VLA 或 WAM 无直接关系，但其向量量化与符号映射技术可能为机器人领域的模型压缩和高效通信提供方法借鉴。

figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Conventional separated transmission and SemQAM. (a) A conventional system optimizes source coding, channel coding, and modulation separately. (b) Design of SemQAM. SemQAM (i) trains VQ codewords using the detected indices at the receiver, and (ii) uses the expectation of received codewords to approximate the receiver reconstruction during autoregressive coding. 𝔼 \mathbb{E} , VQ, and iVQ denote conditional expectation, vector quantization, and codeword lookup, respectively.
