papers.title: SemQAM: A Unified Generative Image Codec for Joint Semantic-Channel Coding and Modulation
papers.title_zh: SemQAM：一种用于联合语义信道编码与调制的统一生成式图像编解码器

papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses the weights of a trained model with a limited compute and data budget. Down to 4 bits, state-of-the-art PTQ methods are near-lossless; below this limit, the tested scalar PTQ configurations collapse to near-random accuracy and quality becomes acutely sensitive to choices such as the quantization representation and calibration data. At such low bitwidths, recovery fine-tuning becomes crucial, and its effectiveness depends heavily on these same choices. Yet there is little systematic evidence on how the quantization method, the quality and task alignment of calibration data, and the design of the recovery procedure interact to determine the final 2-bit model. We present a systematic study of 2-bit quantization and recovery fine-tuning across model families, scales, and data distributions, and distill our findings into practical, architecture-dependent best practices for obtaining an accurate 2-bit model. This recipe, which combines a vector codebook representation, a small task-aligned calibration mixture, and a short codebook-only distillation stage, restores 63-68% average accuracy across seven question-answering tasks at 2 bits (a 71-73% BF16 ceiling), versus the near-random 29% of the evaluated scalar PTQ pipelines, at roughly half the compute of a full-model QAT baseline. Given the same calibration and recovery data, EfficientQAT, a trained scalar baseline, avoids the collapse. However, at a matched rate it trails the vector recipe on generation on every model (2.8-10.9 AvgGen; within noise on Qwen3-MoE) and on question answering on three of the four studied models (2.7-7.8 AvgQA). We also find that the best recovery data depends on the calibration data, an interaction confirmed on a held-out model. Our architecture-aware map of the 2-bit design space shows that representation, calibration data, and recovery data must be chosen jointly.

analysis.key_results: 在七个问答任务上恢复63-68%的平均准确率（BF16上限为71-73%），而评估的标量PTQ流程仅29%；计算量约为全模型QAT基线的一半。EfficientQAT避免了崩溃，但在生成和部分问答任务上落后于向量配方。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个针对2位量化的实用、架构相关的最佳实践，结合了向量码本表示、小型任务对齐校准混合数据和仅码本蒸馏阶段。
analysis.method: 系统研究2位量化与恢复微调，融合向量码本表示、任务对齐校准数据和简短的仅码本蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 系统研究2位训练后量化与恢复微调在模型家族、规模和数据分布上的联合影响，并提出架构相关的实践配方。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于独立于机器人学的模型量化，没有直接涉及VLA或WAM。其方法在低比特率下的有效性可能为机器人策略或世界模型的压缩提供参考，但本身并非针对这些主题。

papers.title: Beyond 4 bits: Data-Centric Post-training Quantization and Recovery
papers.title_zh: 超越4位：以数据为中心的训练后量化与恢复

papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires long-horizon instruction-consistent planning and short-horizon path planning grounded in the currently observed geometry. Anticipating how future observations evolve along the instructed route provides predictive guidance beyond the current field of view, motivating video-action models (VAMs) that learn representations of future visual states. However, many existing VAMs couple future visual prediction with action generation during inference, despite their distinct temporal requirements: instruction-conditioned route guidance can be reused across multiple control steps, whereas local trajectories must continuously adapt to fresh observations. To bridge this gap, we introduce HAVANA, a dual-system VAM that decouples predictive reasoning from reactive local planning. A slow system produces a compact language-conditioned latent plan from observation history, while a fast system combines the latest plan with the current observation to generate local trajectories. Their asynchronous execution enables rapid adaptation without repeated future prediction, and no future video is generated during inference. Experiments on OmniNavBench demonstrate state-of-the-art navigation performance over prior baselines, while zero-shot real-world deployments further show robust generalization to unseen environments.

analysis.key_results: 在OmniNavBench上取得最先进的导航性能，并在零样本真实世界部署中表现出对未见环境的鲁棒泛化。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入HAVANA，一种分层VAM，解耦了慢速的预测推理和快速的反应式局部规划，实现异步执行且无需未来视频生成。
analysis.method: 双系统架构：慢速系统从观察历史生成紧凑的语言条件潜在计划，快速系统结合最新计划和当前观察生成局部轨迹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种双系统视频-动作模型，将预测推理与反应式局部规划解耦，以提高视觉语言导航的效率与泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文的核心贡献是引入分层视频-动作模型，直接推动了VLA和世界模型在机器人导航中的应用。通过解耦预测推理与局部规划，解决了VAM推断时耦合未来视频预测与动作生成所导致的低效问题，对VLA框架中的高效推断和实时控制具有直接方法论价值。

figures.caption: Overview of the HAVANA training pipeline. Left: The slow system processes an RGB observation history, a navigation instruction, and four learnable time-conditioned queries with a video reasoner. Its contextual and query states form the understanding (UND) stream. The query states are also decoded by a supervised MLP into four egocentric waypoints ( waypoint prediction ). A clean conditioning latent and noisy future latents form the generation (GEN) stream. UND uses causal self-attention; GEN jointly attends to both streams within each sample. Future latents are supervised by flow matching. Right: RGB, depth, and UND latents condition a 1D U-Net for flow-matching-based prediction of a 24-step trajectory.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: HAVANA: A Hierarchical Video-Action Model for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.title_zh: HAVANA：用于视觉语言导航的分层视频-动作模型

papers.abstract: Low-bit post-training quantization freezes integer codes and zero points, leaving groupwise scales as a compact adaptation interface. We study cross-precision transfer, non-local context, optimizer capacity, and readout behavior on Qwen3-1.7B and Llama-3.2-3B. First, transferring relative scale gains between floating-point and INT3 Qwen models with zero recipient training retains 76.9%-90.5% of self-calibration NLL reductions on fresh WikiText and C4, alongside resolved own-source preferences. Group permutation destroys transfer, and norm-matched layer withdrawal degrades all 16 layer-domain comparisons. A Llama control with identical initial tensors at all calibrated projections isolates preferences induced by surrounding network context. Second, expanding Llama calibration from 4 to 196 projections (0.79M to 22.02M scales) makes learning rate 0.01 win a 50-step training-loss pilot. Continuing to 200 steps memorizes the 28-block WikiText pool, inflates unseen perplexity by 2.06-2.28 times relative to 4-site calibration, and degrades mixed-action PIQA accuracy; learning rate 0.001 prevents memorization and restores accuracy. Third, across 24 Qwen ARC readout endpoints, advancing from 200 to 600 steps worsens INT3 teacher KL on plain-text readouts yet improves it under chat wrapping. Cross-fitted four-parameter static option bias explains 71.4%-75.4% of quantized Chat-Space score-shift SSE, versus less than 2.3% on floating point. Subtracting this bias raises INT3 chat teacher agreement from 33.3%-33.9% to 56.6%-57.5% and cuts KL from 4.15-4.42 to 1.18-1.24 nats.

analysis.key_results: 跨精度迁移可保留76.9%-90.5%的自校准NLL减少；增加校准投影数会使学习率0.01出现记忆化并导致未见过数据困惑度膨胀2.06-2.28倍，而学习率0.001可防止；选项偏置解释了71.4%-75.4%的量化聊天空间得分偏移方差，偏置校正后INT3聊天教师一致率从33.3%-33.9%提升至56.6%-57.5%，KL从4.15-4.42降至1.18-1.24 nats。
analysis.main_contribution: 系统性地分析了低比特量化模型尺度校准中的跨精度迁移、非局部上下文影响、优化器容量与记忆化边界，并揭示了基于选项偏置的量化聊天空间分数偏移机制。
analysis.method: 在Qwen3-1.7B和Llama-3.2-3B上开展尺度校准实验，研究跨精度迁移、上下文控制、优化步数与学习率、以及校准投影数量对校准质量和泛化的影响；并引入四参数静态选项偏置进行偏置校正。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究了低比特LLM中仅对groupwise尺度进行校准时的跨精度迁移、训练容量限制和读出行为。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于独立的后训练量化主题，与VLA（Vision-Language-Action）或WAM（World Action Model）无直接关联；但所揭示的尺度校准在低比特LLM中的行为可能为嵌入式或资源受限的机器人策略模型提供效率优化参考。

figures.caption: Bidirectional scale-gain transfer and common-gain precision gaps on fresh unseen a,b, Token NLL across uncalibrated (1), floating-point donor (a ), and INT3 donor (a ) Qwen3-1.7B text.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: Cross-Precision Transfer, Non-Local Context, and Capacity-Readout Boundaries of Scale Calibration in Low-Bit LLMs
papers.title_zh: 低比特LLM中尺度校准的跨精度迁移、非局部上下文与容量-读出边界研究

papers.abstract: Real-time interaction requires agents to perceive evolving environments and act under temporal constraints, yet existing evaluations of real-time streaming models focus on conversational quality and streaming perception, leaving effective action under strict temporal constraints untested. We introduce Realtime-Bench, a suite of carefully curated dynamic tasks where delayed actions directly affect success. Under Wall Clock, where environments advance according to actual inference latency, the best success rate reaches only 44% and the best Pass^3 is only 36%, demonstrating that real-time interaction remains challenging. To separate serving latency from models' real-time streaming capability, we compare Wall Clock with Paused Clock, which removes inference delays as an idealized reference, and introduce Token Clock, which advances simulated time according to generated token counts, testing temporal awareness independently of physical serving speed. We find that temporal costs limit success in evolving environments and that higher reasoning effort has mixed effects under time pressure, reflecting a trade-off between decision quality and timely execution. Based on these results, we discuss future directions for improving real-time multimodal models, including adaptive reasoning with temporal awareness and continuous perception and action.

analysis.key_results: 在 Wall Clock 下最高成功率仅 44%，最高 Pass^3 仅 36%；时间成本限制了模型在演化环境中的成功率；更高的推理努力在时间压力下效果不一。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入 Realtime-Bench，一套动态任务套件，用于评估模型在严格时间约束下的实时交互能力；并提出 Token Clock 机制，将时间推进与生成 token 数绑定，独立测试时间感知能力，与物理服务延迟解耦。
analysis.method: 构建动态环境任务，比较 Wall Clock（按实际推理延迟推进环境）、Paused Clock（移除推理延迟的理想参考）和 Token Clock（按生成 token 数推进模拟时间）三种时钟模式，评估模型表现。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一个评估实时交互模型在严格时间约束下行动能力的基准，揭示现有模型成功率低且存在决策质量与及时执行的权衡。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准关注实时交互中的行动与时间约束，对机器人实时决策和高效推理有方法学价值，但未直接涉及 VLA 或世界模型。

figures.caption: Realtime-Bench evaluates models on interactive game and web tasks under three clock protocols. Wall Clock advances environments with actual inference latency, while Paused Clock removes inference delays as an idealized reference. Token Clock (ours) advances simulated time according to generation tokens consumed before action commitment, testing temporal awareness of models independently of physical serving speed.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Realtime-Bench: Can Frontier Models Solve Real-time Interactive Problems?
papers.title_zh: Realtime-Bench：前沿模型能解决实时交互问题吗？

papers.abstract: Failures in long-horizon embodied tasks can arise from how a vision-language-action model (VLA) is called or from its execution capabilities. We introduce AdaRSI, an on-demand recursive self-improvement framework in which a coding agent first refines its tools and procedures, then adapts sub-steps that remain unreliable after testing alternative instructions and approaches. The agent collects demonstrations, tests their utility through temporary fine-tuning probes, and pools accepted data across tasks to train a specialist VLA that works alongside the original executor. At the end of each development round, its records are summarized into shared experience that guides subsequent diagnosis and data collection. On unseen composite tasks in RoboCasa365, AdaRSI raises success from 4.6% to 13.3%. On perturbed LIBERO-Pro 2.0 tasks, success rises from 32.9% to 49.1%. On RoboCasa365's Composite-Unseen suite, it achieves higher success than adapting every manipulation sub-step, using 34% of the GPU time and 36% of the demonstrations. On a real robot, the agent autonomously collects demonstrations and adapts the executor to recover fallen bottles, improving task completion.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboCasa365未见复合任务上成功率从4.6%提升至13.3%；在扰动LIBERO-Pro 2.0任务上从32.9%提升至49.1%；在RoboCasa365 Composite-Unseen套件上优于全子步骤微调，且仅使用34%的GPU时间和36%的演示数据；在真实机器人上自主收集演示并恢复掉落瓶子，提升任务完成率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AdaRSI框架，通过按需递归自改进，在无需全面微调的情况下显著提升VLA在长程任务上的成功率和数据效率。
analysis.method: 编码智能体先细化工具和流程，对不可靠子步骤进行替代指令与方法的测试，利用临时微调探针筛选有效数据，跨任务池化经验训练专用VLA，并将记录总结为共享经验以指导后续迭代。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: AdaRSI通过编码智能体递归地诊断并改进VLA子步骤，收集专家数据训练专用执行器，从而提升长程具身任务的成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接涉及VLA的优化与数据增强，通过修正VLA执行子步骤、训练专用VLA和真实机器人数据采集，是典型的机器人动作策略自改进研究。

figures.caption: Pipeline of AdaRSI. After harness refinement, temporary probes validate demonstrations; accepted data jointly train a specialist VLA. Deployment uses the original and specialist VLAs, with shared experience guiding later rounds.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
papers.title_zh: AdaRSI：具身智能体的按需递归自改进框架

papers.abstract: We introduce WorldOracle, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) against paired real-world executions. Given the same initial observation and low-level action sequence, WorldOracle asks whether a predicted rollout reproduces what happens in the real world, including physical consequences and task-state transitions. We evaluate models along four complementary dimensions: physical state correctness, interaction spatial alignment, key interaction area fidelity, and multi-view action coherence. To support this evaluation, we curate real-world training and evaluation suites that cover different interaction dynamics and embodiments. The evaluation suite contains long, multi-segment episodes with both successful and failed executions, enabling evaluation across varied action outcomes and behavior distributions. Experiments on seven representative ACWMs reveal distinct model strengths and failure modes. WorldOracle provides a systematic foundation for measuring and advancing action-conditioned world modeling for manipulation. We release the datasets, evaluation code, and leaderboard: https://worldoracle-benchmark.github.io/.

papers.abstract: A robot following a multi-step instruction needs to act on the right objects in the right order, even as the scene changes. It must also maintain awareness of task progress and determine when to advance. To address these challenges, we introduce Orchestra, an agent harness that separates task planning and execution management from action generation. Orchestra decomposes a complete multimodal instruction into ordered subtasks, tracks completed steps, and updates the locations of relevant objects and destinations during execution. It maintains a shared context containing the active subtask, spatial grounding, and recent observations. An action policy uses this context to generate actions, while a separately trained progress evaluator estimates when to advance to the next subtask. To evaluate whether robots trained on atomic instructions and short trajectories can execute longer subtask sequences, we introduce a benchmark named RMBench-Compose. Orchestra achieves a mean success rate of $68.22\%$ across nine RMBench tasks, outperforming Mem-0 by $26.22$ percentage points. On RMBench-Compose, it achieves an Average Success Length (ASL) of $7.35$ subtasks, $2.46$ times that of HarnessVLA. Across four real-world multi-step tasks, it improves mean ASL by $25.0\%$ over Orchestra using the base $\pi_{0.5}$ policy. These results show that Orchestra helps robots carry out longer sequences of subtasks while preserving the requested subtask order and acting on the specified objects. Our code and project page are available at https://youpengwen.github.io/Orchestra

analysis.key_results: Orchestra在9个RMBench任务上平均成功率达68.22%，比Mem-0高26.22个百分点；在RMBench-Compose上平均成功长度(ASL)为7.35个子任务，是HarnessVLA的2.46倍；在4个真实世界多步任务上，平均ASL比使用基础π0.5策略的Orchestra提高25.0%。

papers.abstract: Flow Matching (FM) has recently emerged as a principled and efficient generative modeling framework for reinforcement learning (RL), enabling expressive, multimodal policy parameterizations via deterministic probability transport. Compared to diffusion-based policies that rely on stochastic denoising chains, FM uses sampling based on ordinary differential equations (ODEs), with learned velocity fields, which can substantially reduce inference latency and simplify the incorporation of RL objectives. As research in flow-based RL rapidly accelerates across offline continuous control, online fine-tuning, and foundation model alignment, the literature has become highly fragmented. In this survey, we provide a comprehensive taxonomy of flow-matching approaches in reinforcement learning. We organize the literature along two axes: the target distribution being modeled (e.g., action policies, value critics, transition dynamics) and the mechanism of RL signal integration (e.g., energy-weighted regression, flow-based policy gradients, and group relative policy optimization). Furthermore, we survey emerging frontiers such as discrete and non-Euclidean action spaces, provide a systematic comparative analysis against Gaussian and diffusion baselines, and outline critical open problems. Ultimately, this survey serves as a foundational roadmap for the next generation of generative reinforcement learning and alignment.

papers.abstract: Automated terminal-agent training relies on generated environments and verifiers to turn open-ended interaction into reward. Yet a runnable Docker image and executable test suite do not guarantee that the resulting reward is faithful, informative, or even attributable to agent behavior. We present a pipeline that generates containerized terminal tasks and their executable verifiers, and use it to demystify failure modes in task generation and live-environment evaluation. Our analysis separates four requirements that are often conflated: structural validity, verifier faithfulness, policy solvability, and infrastructure reliability. In a GRPO training of Qwen3.5-9B, it overfits on a relatively easy dataset within 20 steps. Conversely, in a controlled Qwen3.5-9B comparison, adding hard tasks lowers mean rollout pass@2 from 81.3% to 20.6%, restoring informative failures without changing the training configuration. We further identify near-duplicate task generation, incomplete anti-shortcut safeguards, Dockerfile failures, asynchronous pass@k bias, and concurrency-induced environment errors as distinct threats to measurement. These findings should motivate the community for a terminal agent specific evaluation harness that pairs structural checks and rollout-derived solvability with extensive verifier audits.

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bridge multimodal understanding and robotic control, advancing the dominant paradigm for embodied intelligence. However, most existing models rely on large Transformers, whose latency and energy costs hinder deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Through sparse event-driven computation, spiking neural networks offer a promising paradigm for high-performance and energy-efficient computing. Here, we propose the first Spike-driven VLA framework enabling end-to-end direct training for robotic manipulation, which mainly comprises three core components. First, we develop spiking visual and instruction encoders for multimodal perception, encoding visual observations and language instructions into sparse, reliable spike representations for subsequent cross-modal fusion. Then, we introduce Multi-Winner Spike Fusion for instruction-guided scene understanding, using bidirectional top-$k$ winner-take-all spike routing to suppress background interference and yield fused memory. Finally, we propose a Spike Action Chunking Transformer that incorporates spiking cross-attention over the fused memory and the current robot state, enabling efficient end-to-end generation of continuous action chunks for robotic control. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and Meta-World demonstrate that Spike-driven VLA achieves competitive performance with fewer parameters and lower estimated inference energy than conventional VLA models. This work establishes a foundational framework for neuromorphic VLA modeling, paving the way for future advances in resource-efficient embodied intelligence.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和Meta-World基准上，Spike-driven VLA以更少参数和更低估算推理能耗达到与传统VLA模型相当的性能。

analysis.method: 采用脉冲神经网络进行稀疏事件驱动计算，设计脉冲视觉和指令编码器，引入双向top-k赢家通吃脉冲路由的Multi-Winner Spike Fusion，以及基于脉冲交叉注意力的Spike Action Chunking Transformer进行动作块生成。

papers.abstract: Does memory-dependent control need nonlinear recurrent dynamics? We study simulated air-hockey defence under temporary loss of puck tracking. A DreamerV3 teacher outperforms a memoryless policy under tracking loss, and erasing its recurrent state at the moment tracking fails cuts its save rate sharply, so the task requires memory. We distil this teacher into compact recurrent policies with a 64-dimensional state, combining a diagonal linear recurrence with an optional rank-$k$ nonlinear innovation while the observation encoder and action head stay nonlinear. Across five matched seeds, the purely linear recurrent model ($k=0$) matches both the GRU baseline and the teacher throughout the tested range of tracking loss. Increasing nonlinear innovation rank provides no measured benefit. This result comes from a fresh test split that was opened only after all models and analyses were frozen. Under 5\,mm observation noise, without retraining, the linear student keeps a higher save rate than the GRU baseline, while using fewer recurrent parameters and less computation. These results suggest that, for this memory-dependent control task, nonlinear representation learning around a simple linear memory can be sufficient, and that nonlinear recurrent dynamics are not necessarily required.

analysis.key_results: 线性递归模型（k=0）在追踪丢失范围和5mm观测噪声下，保持与GRU基线和教师模型相当的救球率，且使用的递归参数和计算量更少。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明了在模拟空气曲棍球防守任务中，带线性对角线递归的紧凑策略足以匹配GRU基线及教师模型，非线性创新秩的增加未带来增益。

papers.abstract: Recent LLMs increasingly adopt hybrid designs that replace standard attention with linear attention, such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). Although they compress the context into a fixed-size recurrent state and substantially reduce the cost of long-context processing, repeatedly reading and updating that state remains a major inference bottleneck. Quantization offers a natural way to reduce this cost, but can significantly degrade model quality, due to the accumulation of rounding errors and the presence of outlier rows and columns in the state. To address these challenges, we propose LeapQuant, a training-free method that achieves near-lossless performance under 8-bit recurrent-state quantization. First, to mitigate error accumulation, we propose per-window quantization, which leaps over a window of tokens and quantizes the state only once at its end. Within a window, outputs are computed from the fixed low-bit state together with high-precision buffered updates. Second, to reduce the error introduced by each quantization, LeapQuant retains the state's largest outliers as a few high-precision Compensator Tokens, which share the update path of real tokens. We then smooth the remaining residual before quantization to further reduce the error. Comprehensive experiments across the Qwen, Kimi, and GLM model families show that LeapQuant substantially reduces memory and compute costs during inference. With accuracy comparable to the FP32 baseline, it achieves average speedups of 2.05--3.70$\times$ at the kernel level and 1.47$\times$ for end-to-end inference on NVIDIA B200, RTX PRO 6000, and RTX 5090 GPUs.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen、Kimi和GLM模型系列上，LeapQuant显著降低了推理时的内存和计算成本；与FP32基线精度相当，在NVIDIA B200、RTX PRO 6000和RTX 5090 GPU上实现了内核级2.05-3.70倍的平均加速，端到端推理1.47倍的加速。
analysis.main_contribution: LeapQuant，一种训练无关的量化方法，通过逐窗口量化和高精度补偿器令牌保留状态异常值，实现8位循环状态量化下的近无损性能。
analysis.method: 逐窗口量化，在窗口结束时仅量化一次状态；在窗口内使用固定低位状态和高精度缓冲更新计算输出；保留状态中最大的异常值作为少数高精度补偿器令牌；量化前平滑剩余残差以进一步降低误差。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种训练无关的8位循环状态量化方法LeapQuant，用于降低混合线性注意力语言模型的推理成本，同时保持近无损精度。

papers.abstract: A pretrained video world model admits many plausible futures for a scene, but a robot must realize the exact task-conditioned one. To turn world models into executable robot policies, existing methods fine-tune the heavy world model backbone using large-scale robot data and computational resources. Challenging this status quo, we argue that the expensive part has already been paid in the world model pretraining since the representation space of a video world model encoder lays out the diverse potential futures. In this case, what remains is to determine the future that accomplishes the task and to read out the actions that realize it. We formalize this task as actualization, which learns a task-conditioned realization on top of a prior supplied by a frozen world model encoder. This can be solved by a tiny actualizer model. We implement RoboActualizer with as few as 60M parameters on top of a frozen world model encoder. The actualizer is composed of two lightweight DiT experts that jointly predict future latents and actions by flow matching. The model can be trained entirely on a single GPU with 32 GB peak memory. With up to 100x fewer trainable parameters than existing WAMs and VLAs, RoboActualizer reaches great performance on simulation benchmarks including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0 and five tasks on two real-world platforms, with a low latency of 39 ms that allows real-time control.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0仿真基准以及两个真实平台的五个任务中达到优秀性能，延迟为39ms，可实时控制，且可训练参数比现有WAM和VLA少高达100倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RoboActualizer，通过任务条件实际化将预训练世界模型转化为机器人策略，仅需60M参数和单GPU训练，即可在仿真和真实机器人任务上达到高性能。
analysis.method: 使用冻结的世界模型编码器，在其上训练由两个轻量级DiT专家组成的实际化模型，通过流匹配联合预测未来潜在状态和动作。

analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对世界模型到机器人动作的转化问题，属于世界模型（WAM）在机器人操作中的高效利用，与VLA/WAM主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is the standard way to run modern diffusion models on memory-constrained accelerators, yet every existing diffusion PTQ scheme fixes the $\mathit{number\ format}$ in advance and only tunes the scale, zero point, or per-layer bit-width. At a fixed bit-width the best format depends on the distribution being encoded, and that distribution differs across weight channels, across layers, and along the diffusion timestep, where activation distributions slide from heavy-tailed and noise-dominated to tightly clustered and structured. We propose Chameleon, a PTQ framework that holds the bit-width fixed and treats the format itself as a discrete variable, chosen per weight channel and per activation layer, optionally refined per timestep bucket. Activation formats come from {INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8}, selected ahead of time from two cheap statistics (empirical kurtosis and the closed-form diffusion SNR) and stored in a lookup table; weight formats come from {INT8, MXINT8} at 8 bits or {INT4, NF4, FP4 E2M1, MXINT4, MXFP4} at 4 bits, selected offline by reconstruction error. An architectural fork adapts the same selection layer to multi-step UNets, single-step distilled models, and Diffusion Transformers. Most of the gain comes from the per-layer choice; the timestep refinement helps mainly at 6-bit activations. Across SDXL, SDXL-Turbo, and PixArt-$\alpha$ on COCO-2014, Chameleon achieves the best FID in all six backbone $\times$ bit-width settings, with CLIP within 0.24 of the FP16 reference and the best of all quantized methods at $W_{4}A_{8}$. On PixArt-$\alpha$, a real mixed-format kernel runs 1.09$\times$ faster than FP16 end-to-end with 3$\times$ smaller weights.

analysis.key_results: 在 SDXL、SDXL-Turbo 和 PixArt-α 上，Chameleon 在所有骨干网络与位宽组合中取得最佳 FID；CLIP 与 FP16 参考差距在 0.24 以内，且是所有量化方法中 W4A8 下最优；在 PixArt-α 上实际混合格式内核端到端比 FP16 快 1.09 倍，权重大小减少 3 倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Chameleon 框架，在固定位宽下将数值格式作为离散变量进行逐通道、逐层选择，并可选择按扩散时间步细化激活格式，从而超越现有仅调整尺度/零点/位宽的 PTQ 方案。
analysis.method: 通过经验峰度和闭式扩散 SNR 提前选择激活格式（INT8、FP8、MXFP8、MXINT8 等），通过重建误差离线选择权重格式（INT8、INT4、NF4、FP4、MXINT4、MXFP4 等），并设计架构分支适配多步 UNet、单步蒸馏模型和 Diffusion Transformer。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Chameleon 是一种后训练量化框架，将数值格式本身作为可调变量，为扩散模型的不同权重通道和激活层动态选择最佳格式，以提升量化效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于扩散模型的后训练量化，不涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人动作-世界模型。但其针对扩散模型的高效量化方法（如动态格式选择、混合格式内核）可能为机器人策略或世界模型中的扩散模型部署提供通用技术参考。

papers.abstract: HopChain has shown on still images that multi-hop data synthesis improves vision-language reasoning, because long chain-of-thought reasoning exposes errors that compound across steps, while most data used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rarely demands a chain of visual evidence, so these weaknesses are likely to stay unexposed. We observe the same problem in video, where this framework has not yet been explored. We therefore build Video-HopChain, a dataset of 22,550 multi-hop video questions over 13,378 videos, together with a held-out benchmark of 1,000 questions. Each question chains three to six yes/no questions about moments in one video, and each yields one of two integers depending on its answer. The final answer is the sum of these integers, so an exact match on that sum gives the verifiable reward that RLVR needs. We first train Qwen3-VL-8B with GRPO on a standard video dataset, and a second stage on Video-HopChain then raises the mean over eight video understanding and reasoning benchmarks from 55.4 to 57.9 and improves every one of them. Training on such a dataset, however, exposes a known limitation of GRPO: its learning signal comes from the reward variance within a group, so hard questions whose rollouts are all incorrect and easy questions whose rollouts are all correct both leave the group with no gradient. To recover these groups at the same compute budget, we introduce Confidence-Gated Exploration (CGE). With 8 rollouts per question, CGE samples the first 4 as usual. If these 4 are either all correct or all incorrect, it samples the last 4 with the policy's most confident token masked inside the reasoning span, and removes the masked positions from the loss while all 8 rollouts enter the advantage. With CGE, the mean rises further to 59.3. We release the dataset, the checkpoint, and the data generation and training code.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-VL-8B上，使用Video-HopChain进行第二阶段训练将八个视频理解与推理基准的平均分从55.4提升到57.9，且每个基准均有提升；加入CGE后平均分进一步提高到59.3。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Video-HopChain多跳视频问答数据集及基准，并引入置信度门控探索（CGE）方法，有效缓解GRPO在组内奖励方差为零时梯度消失的问题，将平均基准得分从55.4提升至59.3。
analysis.method: 构建多跳视频问答数据集并采用GRPO进行训练；第二阶段使用Video-HopChain进行强化学习微调；提出置信度门控探索（CGE），在8次采样中前4次常规采样，若全对或全错则后4次遮蔽推理段中最自信的token进行采样，并从损失中移除遮蔽位置，全部8次采样参与优势估计。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作构建了包含22550个多跳视频问题的数据集和基准，提出置信度门控探索（CGE）策略以改善强化学习训练效果，并在Qwen3-VL-8B上取得视频理解与推理基准的提升。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦视频推理模型的数据构建与强化学习训练效率，不涉及机器人动作预测、世界模型或VLA（视觉-语言-动作）策略，与本站主题无直接关系。

(c, d) When every rollout of a group fails in the same way, the group gives no gradient. In the second wave, CGE masks the token that the policy is sure of, so the rollouts take new paths and the rewards differ.

papers.abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving operate primarily through feedforward inference across the perception--reasoning--planning hierarchy. While modern architectures maintain temporal recurrence within the perceptual module, early perception remains blind to downstream reasoning and navigation goals, processing visual inputs agnostically without prioritizing cues informed by prior decisions. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces PRIME, a learned feedback mechanism that conditions the VLA perceptual queries on a novel Situational Memory. By aggregating latent representations of past perception, reasoning, navigation goals, and predicted behaviors across an L-step window via cross-attention, PRIME enables intent-driven perceptual attention at minimal computational cost, adding only a maximum of 29.7M parameters (0.41% of the 7.3B-parameter base model). Evaluated on the Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, PRIME achieves a state-of-the-art Driving Score of 82.47 (+4.73 over ORION) and a Success Rate of 60.00% (+5.38 percentage points), the highest reported Driving Score among published VLAs trained on Think2Drive demonstrations.

analysis.key_results: 在Bench2Drive闭环基准上达到82.47的驾驶得分（较ORION提升4.73）和60.00%的成功率（提升5.38个百分点），为基于Think2Drive演示训练的已发表VLA中最高驾驶得分。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种学习的反馈机制PRIME，通过情境记忆聚合过去感知、推理、目标和行为，使感知查询受意图驱动，以极小计算开销提升VLA模型性能。
analysis.method: 在VLA感知查询上引入情境记忆，通过跨注意力聚合L步窗口的过去潜在表示，实现意图驱动的感知注意力。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PRIME通过引入情境记忆机制，使VLA模型的感知模块能够关注与下游推理和导航目标相关的线索，从而提升自动驾驶性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对自动驾驶领域的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，提出通过情境记忆进行感知反馈以增强模型规划能力，属于VLA政策学习的核心研究。

figures.caption: Comparison of typical feedforward inference versus the proposed integration of situational memory via a feedback path.

papers.title_zh: PRIME：VLA模型中带有情境记忆嵌入的感知反馈

papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions. This representation enables observation-based approximate self-localization, task progress verification, and visual revisitation-based recovery. Navi-Agent performs closed-loop navigation by decomposing instructions into sub-goals, executing local visual navigation, and verifying visited places through the constructed spatial state. Experiments on zero-shot VLN-CE benchmark and real-world robot platforms show that Navi-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods while remaining competitive with approaches relying on geometric localization.

analysis.key_results: 在零样本 VLN-CE 基准和真实机器人平台上达到几何约束方法中的最先进性能，且与依赖几何定位的方法相比具有竞争力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Navi-Agent，一种零样本连续环境视觉语言导航智能体，利用纯视觉观测和运动历史构建坐标无关的空间状态（导航拓扑），实现无需几何定位和深度信息的闭环导航。
analysis.method: 将指令分解为子目标，执行局部视觉导航，并通过导航拓扑进行观察式近似自定位、任务进度验证和基于视觉重访的恢复。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种无需几何定位和深度信息的零样本视觉语言导航智能体，通过构建基于视觉地点和运动转移的导航拓扑来实现长距离指令执行与自我恢复。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）领域，专注于具身导航中的空间状态表示与策略执行，不涉及世界模型或预测推理，但对于无地图、无定位的机器人导航策略学习具有直接参考价值。

figures.caption: Navi-Agent overview. The proposed agent builds a coordinate-free Visual Anchor Graph to maintain visual spatial memory for long-horizon navigation.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Navi-Agent system overview. A long-horizon instruction is first decomposed into ordered typed sub-goals ( Decompose ). For each active sub-goal, SelectTarget ranks six RGB views with a VLM and grounds the selected visual target (floor mask, trackable point, and ViNT goal crop); ExecuteLocal then performs navigation via point tracking and ViNT. Each physical stop is registered into a coordinate-free visual anchor graph, where nodes store RGB views, semantic signatures, place identities, and visit contexts, and edges record executed motion. Associate identifies each new visit as Same / New / Ambiguous , while VerifyProgress determines stage transition as Commit / Intermediate / Wrong / Uncertain . Upon verification failure, the agent explores alternatives or backtracks through recorded edges to re-confirm the parent place.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: Benchmarks for coding agents typically assess implementation from explicit specifications, leaving open whether agents can discover and reproduce systems whose rules are undocumented and accessible only through interaction. We study this capability in web games, which offer controlled environments with observable actions and outcomes, and introduce GameReplica, a benchmark for end-to-end black-box game replication. It comprises 125 instances spanning 25 web games and five core mechanism families, with each game instantiated at five difficulty levels. Under container isolation, an agent accesses the target game only through an action--screenshot interface, may iterate between probing the game, implementing a replica, and checking it, and delivers a self-contained runnable replica together with a rule checklist. A reference-grounded evaluation then scores the deliverables separately on rule consistency, implementation consistency, and visual fidelity. Experiments across six models and five agent runtimes show that black-box replication remains challenging: Claude Opus 4.8 achieves the highest Overall score, 71.6%, while the other models obtain 4.0%--43.0%. Every model scores highest on visual fidelity and lowest on rule consistency, suggesting that reproducing appearance is easier than recovering mechanics. Difficulty widens the gap: from L1 to L5, the four lower-scoring models show relative Overall score declines of 33%--63%, whereas the strongest model declines by less than 5%. In the evaluated configurations, outcomes vary more across models than across agent runtimes, and most attributed failures of weaker models arise during exploration, before replica code is written. Resources and interactive demonstrations are available at https://qqqqqqby.github.io/GameReplica/.

analysis.key_results: Claude Opus 4.8 总体得分最高（71.6%），其他模型为 4.0%–43.0%；所有模型视觉保真度最高、规则一致性最低；难度从 L1 到 L5 时，较弱模型相对总体得分下降 33%–63%，最强模型下降不到 5%；结果差异主要来自模型而非智能体运行时，弱模型多数失败发生在探索阶段。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建并发布 GameReplica 基准，包含 125 个实例、25 个网页游戏、5 种核心机制族及 5 个难度级别，并提出参考引导的评估方法。
analysis.method: 在容器隔离下，智能体仅通过动作-截图接口访问游戏，可循环进行探测、实现复刻和检查，最终交付可运行复刻及规则清单；评估分别考察规则一致性、实现一致性和视觉保真度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 GameReplica 基准，评估视觉-语言智能体通过交互黑盒地发现并复刻网页游戏规则的能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文是面向视觉-语言智能体的基准，不直接涉及机器人操作、VLA 或世界模型；但其黑盒系统发现与规则归纳方法对具身智能体理解未知环境具有一定方法学参考价值。

figures.caption: Comparison of existing benchmarks and GameReplica. (a) Program synthesis and software engineering benchmarks provide explicit specifications for implementation. (b) Vision-to-code benchmarks provide visual observations or pre-collected interaction trajectories. (c) Game benchmarks evaluate agent performance in predefined environments without requiring executable reconstruction. (d) GameReplica instead requires agents to actively probe black-box games, infer latent rules, reconstruct executable replicas, and verify their behavior against the original games.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of GameReplica. Stage 1. Complexity-Controlled Multi-Difficulty Task Construction. Each base game is systematically scaled across five difficulty levels accompanied by a semantically aligned specification, rule checklist, and reference implementation. Stage 2. Pixel-Only Black-Box Game Replication. The evaluated agent actively probes the live environment only via an action–screenshot interface to synthesize a self-contained executable replica alongside an induced rule checklist. Stage 3. Reference-Grounded Replication Evaluation. The synthesized replica is benchmarked against curated reference artifacts across the decoupled dimensions of rule consistency, implementation consistency, and visual fidelity.

papers.title: GameReplica: A Benchmark for Black-Box Visual Game Replication by Vision-Language Agents

papers.abstract: Spatial reasoning depends not only on metric properties such as distance, angle, and shape, but also on topological relations that remain invariant under continuous deformation. Cognitive science identifies these relations as foundational to spatial understanding, yet foundation-model evaluations largely focus on metric or viewpoint-dependent relations. We introduce MindTopo, a benchmark of topological intuition across five properties grounded in cognitive science and formal topology, namely continuity, separation, order, enclosure, and knots. MindTopo evaluates each property at two cognitive levels. Reasoning asks a model to identify topological relations or infer how they change. Planning instantiates a foundation model as a closed-loop agent whose policy selects environment actions. MindTopo provides a Core Set of 3,900 instances across 13 procedurally generated task types, split into an Easy and a Hard level, and an Extended Set of 11,035 original instances. On the Core Set, we benchmark 13 multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and study agent configurations augmented with image and video generation, covering seven video generative models in planning settings. Every MLLM performs better on reasoning than on planning. On the Easy level, where human scores are available, the strongest model trails humans in both reasoning and planning. On Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning improve reasoning more than planning. Generated observations retain local cues and reach solved endpoints, yet none of the 1,890 evaluated video rollouts passes all process-validity checks.

analysis.key_results: 所有MLLM在推理上的表现优于规划；在Easy级别上，最强模型在推理和规划上均落后于人类；在Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct上，监督微调和强化学习对推理的提升大于规划；生成的观察保留局部线索并到达解决终点，但1,890个视频rollouts中没有一个通过所有过程有效性检查。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入MindTopo，一个基于认知科学和形式拓扑学的拓扑直觉基准，包含五个属性和两个认知层次（推理与规划），并提供Core Set和Extended Set。
analysis.method: 构建包含3,900个Core Set实例和11,035个Extended Set实例的基准，评估13个多模态大语言模型在推理和闭环规划任务上的表现，并结合图像和视频生成模型进行代理配置。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了MindTopo基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在拓扑空间中的推理与规划能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文提出的基准涉及闭环代理规划和视觉-语言模型评估，与机器人学习和世界建模有一定关联，但主题是拓扑推理而非VLA或WAM，无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Humans can perform complex manipulations given a simple intent through an overall instruction, while continuously adapting to evolving visual observations. However, current vision-language action (VLA) models and other action policies struggle to realize this high-level intelligent behavior under dense, evolving visual inputs and sparse language guidance. Visual correlations can then dominate semantic intent, leading actions to follow visual shortcuts rather than human goals. We present HINT (Human-INTent INcepTion), an agentic framework inspired by the human manipulation principles: semantic intent changes sparsely at manipulation-pattern transitions, whereas continuous control primarily depends on the evolving object-hand relationship. HINT invokes semantic reasoning only at pattern transitions to resolve the current subtask and target, then maintains this commitment through multi-view grounding and visual tracking. We explore two visual interfaces-image-space semantic highlighting and attention-prior injection-to communicate the tracked intent to the action policy without introducing additional trainable parameters into the foundation action model. Experiments across three long-horizon tasks and out-of-distribution variants show that HINT substantially improves intent understanding, task progress, and end-to-end success across two foundation policies while preserving low-latency control. Project page: https://robot-hint.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 在3个长时程任务及其分布外变体上，HINT显著提升意图理解、任务进度和端到端成功率，同时保持低延迟控制。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HINT框架，利用稀疏的语义推理与多视角视觉跟踪来维持人类意图，在不引入额外可训练参数的情况下，提高VLA基础策略在长时程任务中的意图理解与执行成功率。
analysis.method: 在任务模式转换时进行语义推理，获取当前子任务与目标；通过多视角视觉跟踪保持意图；利用图像空间语义高亮或注意力先验注入两种视觉接口，将意图传达给现有动作策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: HINT框架通过在任务模式转换时注入人类意图语义，并在连续控制阶段保持意图，从而提升视觉语言动作模型在长时程机器人操作中的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接面向VLA模型，解决其在密集视觉输入和稀疏语言指导下意图理解不足的问题，提出的意图注入与跟踪机制对机器人动作生成及视觉-语言-动作策略有重要意义。

figures.caption: System overview of HINT. HINT consists of three parts: (1) The pattern router estimates the current manipulation pattern and its progress to select the prioritized camera views 𝒱 k \mathcal{V}_{k} and the semantic update time t k t_{k} . (2) At an update, the task manager resolves the active subtask and target entity, the semantic grounder localizes the target in the routed views, and goal-consistent tracking maintains the target state between updates; (3) The intent is injected into the action policy through pixel-level highlighting and a token-level semantic attention bias to generate robot actions.

papers.title: HINT: Human-Intent Inception for Agentic Robot Manipulation
papers.title_zh: HINT：面向智能体机器人操作的人类意图植入框架

papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to reduce the cost of serving large language models (LLMs), but its accuracy cost is uneven and is often tuned per model. We study where quantization damage occurs and how to allocate a small additional precision budget. Using causal mixed-precision intervention as ground truth (raise each layer to 8-bit in turn and measure the accuracy it recovers) across 9 open-weight models in 4 architecture families, we test 3 intuitive hypotheses: that quantization damage lives in task circuits, where the model computes, or in weight statistics. None of them predicts which layers benefit from restored precision. Recovery is instead diffuse: for 8 of 9 models, recovering 75% of the gap takes roughly half the layers; the lone exception, Qwen3-8B, is sharply concentrated. At a matched precision budget, spending it globally on finer quantization granularity beats locally repairing the most recoverable layers for all 8 group-128-compatible models (all but OpenLLaMA, whose width rules out group-128), by 21-52 points, including the concentrated Qwen3-8B. We report 2 secondary findings: the residual is budget-limited (8-bit is near-lossless in our evaluation across RTN, GPTQ, and AWQ), and the location of peak recovery correlates with architecture within a family, though not across families. Within this budget setting, global granularity is a better default than selectively protecting critical layers. More broadly, cheap signals that correlate with quantization damage do not necessarily identify where restoring precision improves accuracy; this must be tested with causal intervention.

analysis.key_results: 8/9的模型恢复75%的差距需要约一半的层；全局细粒度量化比局部修复高出21-52个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示LLM中量化损伤是弥散的，并展示在匹配精度预算下全局细粒度量化优于局部修复最可恢复层。
analysis.method: 使用因果混合精度干预作为基准，在9个模型和4个架构家族中逐层恢复8位精度并测量准确率恢复。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究后训练量化中损伤的位置，并发现全局细粒度量化优于选择性保护关键层。

papers.abstract: Modeling action-conditioned physical evolution is fundamental to latent world models. World Action Models (WAMs) couple such models with policy learning through predictive supervision or future-conditioned action generation. Yet their latent transitions typically rely on transformer-based predictors, leaving dynamical structure to be learned implicitly from data. We derive a latent-transition formulation from controlled mechanical evolution. A common finite-dimensional projection of observable dynamics yields a shared operator family affine in physical control and an explicit projection residual. Guided by this principle, we introduce the Latent Evolution Operator Network (LEON), which adapts pretrained visual features into learned observables and evolves them through an affine family of shared operator matrices and complementary additive updates. Coefficients inferred from evolving observables and action-related context modulate the operators. We instantiate LEON in two WAM architectures while preserving their distinct original prediction targets and policy interfaces. Across single-arm and bimanual manipulation, LEON improves average policy success over corresponding WAM baselines, including under diverse perturbations. Ablations support its observable adaptation and operator-structured evolution, while controlled-system evaluations demonstrate improved extrapolation beyond training conditions.

analysis.key_results: 在单臂和双臂操作中，LEON平均策略成功率优于对应WAM基线，包括在多种扰动下；受控系统评估显示训练条件外外推能力提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入LEON，将受控机械演化原理转化为仿射算子族和残差更新，用于改进世界动作模型（WAM）的潜在演化。
analysis.method: LEON将预训练视觉特征适配为学习到的观测，通过共享算子矩阵的仿射族和可加更新进行演化，系数从演化观测和动作相关上下文推断。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Latent Evolution Operator Network（LEON），通过算子结构化的潜在演化替代Transformer预测器，在两种WAM架构中提升了策略成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对世界动作模型（WAM）的核心组件——潜在演化——提出结构化改进，属于WAM主题的中心研究。

papers.abstract: In the physical world we inhabit, space and time are fundamentally continuous. However, existing machine learning paradigms for world modeling are largely confined to discrete-time prediction, thereby exhibiting significant inefficiency in capturing the dynamics of physical world. We introduce Physical-Time Flow (PT-Flow), a novel approach that learns a continuous latent velocity field operating in physical time. Crucially, the underlying dynamics of sequential data are parameterized by an ordinary differential equation (ODE) embedded in a well-structured representation space. Under this paradigm, the prediction of future can be recast as temporal integration via an ODE solver in the compressed latent space. Building upon PT-Flow, we construct ODEWorld, a continuous-time latent world model that is both efficient and versatile. By extracting time-variant features and enforcing ODE properties on both the dynamical representation space and the latent velocity field, ODEWorld effectively addresses the long-standing representation collapse issue in latent world model literature. This also enables high-quality image reconstruction even after long-horizon prediction. Moreover, its continuous nature allows for arbitrary temporal resolution and even backward prediction, which is impossible for most discrete-time models. Lastly, ODEWorld can provide rich planning-oriented information to facilitate downstream policy learning. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ODEWorld successfully reconciles planning-conducive dynamics abstraction with visual realism, excelling in both video generation and robotic control. Project page: https://dstate.github.io/odeworld_website/.

analysis.key_results: 在视频生成和机器人控制两个任务上表现优异，同时兼顾规划导向的动态抽象和视觉真实感。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入物理时间流（PT-Flow），在结构化表示空间中用ODE参数化动态，构建连续时间潜在世界模型ODEWorld，解决表示坍塌问题，支持任意时间分辨率和向后预测，并为下游策略学习提供规划导向信息。
analysis.method: 学习连续潜在速度场，将未来预测转化为在压缩潜在空间中通过ODE求解器进行时间积分；提取时变特征并在表示空间和速度场上强制ODE性质。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ODEWorld提出一种在物理时间上学习连续潜在速度场的世界模型，通过ODE求解实现高效连续预测并支持机器人控制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作核心是连续时间世界模型，支持视频生成和机器人控制，属于世界模型（WAM）范畴，并通过提供规划信息促进策略学习，与VLA/WAM高度相关。

papers.abstract: Multimodal foundation models learned to see and to speak by consuming the whole internet. Embodied agents admit no such shortcut, since they require data that couple observations with physical states and actions. These signals can be provided, to varying degrees, by multiple data sources. In this work, we organize the embodied data ecosystem as a "pyramid'' spanning five complementary sources: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric data, simulation data, and general vision-language data. We organize the pyramid around the tension between scalability and robot alignment, and further characterize each source in terms of data quality, diversity, reusability, and physical fidelity. We then analyze recent embodied foundation models through the lens of data recipes, examining how different sources are selected, aligned, and mixed during pretraining. For embodied brain models, vision-language-action models, and world-action models alike, we relate data composition to capabilities in perception, reasoning, planning, action generation, and world prediction. To facilitate community use, we additionally consolidate over 10,000 hours of trajectories from widely used robot datasets into a unified LeRobot format, with transparent frame-level quality annotations for filtering. We close by discussing six open challenges: building large-scale tactile datasets, collecting failure and recovery data, developing scalable data-collection pipelines, aligning actions across embodiments, leveraging egocentric data for dexterous manipulation, and designing principled data recipes for robot learning. We hope this work lays the foundation for the design of next-generation embodied systems.

analysis.key_results: 整理超过10,000小时轨迹数据为统一LeRobot格式，带有帧级质量标注；提出六个开放挑战。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出具身数据生态系统金字塔，组织五类数据源（真实机器人、UMI风格、自中心/外中心、仿真、通用视觉-语言数据），并分析近期具身基础模型的数据配方，整理超过10,000小时轨迹数据为统一LeRobot格式并提供质量标注。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该综述提出一个包含五种互补数据源的具身数据金字塔，并分析其在预训练具身基础模型（包括VLA和世界-动作模型）中的作用。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) can improve action generalization in autonomous driving by learning scene dynamics through dense future-video supervision. However, deploying such models often requires costly future-video generation, while architectures that bypass video rollout typically separate video and action parameters or alter their learned dependencies at inference. We introduce UNIVERSE, a unified video-action model built on a single mask-modulated Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that combines shared-parameter learning with modality-independent inference. Its Modality-Decoupling Visibility Mask allows future video and trajectory tokens to attend to a common historical context while blocking mutual attention between the two future modalities. As a result, future-video supervision directly updates the parameters used for trajectory denoising, yet video tokens can be omitted at test time without changing the trajectory branch's training-time attention dependencies. The same model supports trajectory-only, video-only, and joint video-action generation. Trajectory-only inference achieves a 4.3x speedup over coupled video-action rollout with comparable planning accuracy. UNIVERSE achieves 91.0 PDMS on NAVSIM, compared with 89.6 for a Two-DiT variant, and demonstrates strong zero-shot transfer to nuScenes and Bench2Drive without target-domain fine-tuning. Controlled ablations further support the complementary benefits of shared parameters, dense video co-training, and modality-decoupled visibility.

analysis.key_results: 轨迹单模态推理相比耦合视频-动作推理实现4.3倍加速，规划精度相当；在NAVSIM上达到91.0 PDMS（对比Two-DiT变体的89.6）；在nuScenes和Bench2Drive上实现强零样本迁移；控制消融实验验证共享参数、密集视频协同训练和模态解耦可见性的互补优势。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UNIVERSE统一视频-动作模型，首次在单个掩码调制扩散Transformer中结合共享参数学习与模态独立推理，并引入Modality-Decoupling Visibility Mask，使得未来视频监督可直接更新轨迹去噪参数，同时测试时可省略视频token而不改变轨迹分支注意力依赖。
analysis.method: 单掩码调制扩散Transformer（DiT）架构，采用Modality-Decoupling Visibility Mask允许未来视频和轨迹token关注共同历史上下文，同时阻止两种未来模态之间的相互注意力；支持轨迹单模态、视频单模态和视频-动作联合生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出UNIVERSE，一种基于单个掩码调制扩散Transformer的统一视频-动作模型，通过模态解耦可见性掩码实现共享参数学习与模态独立推理，用于自动驾驶中的世界动作建模。

papers.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) enable agents to plan in latent space by imagining the outcomes of candidate actions, yet task specification remains a bottleneck. Visual targets provide precise local gradients but poor distant guidance, while language is flexible yet limited by noisy cross-modal alignment or dependence on distinct large generative models. We introduce LAGO (Latent Goal Prediction from Language), a hierarchical world model in which a single predictor both forecasts action-conditioned dynamics and grounds language instructions as sequences of intermediate latent subgoals, training both modes with a single regression objective over a shared latent space. At each planning step, LAGO predicts a sequence of latent subgoals from a language instruction and optimizes an action sequence using a soft-minimum alignment cost that rewards subgoal proximity without enforcing a rigid path. Subgoals are repredicted as the agent's state evolves, turning a single long-horizon instruction into a sequence of locally tractable objectives. Across environments spanning navigation and manipulation, LAGO outperforms flat and hierarchical image-goal planners, with the largest gains on long-horizon navigation with curved, hazard-constrained paths, where it more than doubles the success rate of a goal-conditioned behavior cloning policy trained on the same demonstrations. Grounding language in the world model's own latent space also outperforms vision-language reward models, including one that plans with ground-truth dynamics.

analysis.key_results: 在导航和操作环境中，LAGO优于平面和分层图像目标规划器；在长时程曲线且带危险约束的导航任务中，成功率比基于相同演示训练的目标条件行为克隆策略提升超过两倍；语言接地于世界模型潜在空间也优于视觉语言奖励模型（包括使用真实动态规划的模型）。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入LAGO，将语言指令接地为世界模型自身潜在空间中的中间子目标序列，并通过单一回归目标同时训练动作条件动态预测和语言子目标预测，实现基于软最小对齐代价的动作优化规划。
analysis.method: 分层世界模型；在共享潜在空间中，用单一预测器同时预测动作条件动态和语言指导的潜在子目标序列；通过软最小对齐代价优化动作序列；随状态演化和重新预测子目标，将长时程指令分解为局部可解目标。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LAGO，一个分层世界模型，将语言指令预测为潜在子目标序列并用于模型预测规划，在导航和操作任务中超越图像目标规划器。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接构建世界模型并以语言指令生成潜在目标序列用于机器人规划，属于世界模型在视觉语言机器人中的核心应用，对VLA/WAM相关研究具有高度相关性。

Given a language instruction, CEM optimizes action sequences to reach the predicted subgoals using J LAGO J_{\text{LAGO}} . papers.abstract: Generative retrieval offers a promising alternative by unifying the fragmented multi-stage retrieval process into a single end-to-end model. However, its practical adoption in industrial e-commerce search remains challenging, given the massive and dynamic product catalogs, strict latency requirements, and the need to align retrieval with downstream ranking goals. In this work, we propose a retrieval framework tailored for real-world recall scenarios, positioning generative retrieval as a recall-stage supplement rather than an end-to-end replacement. Our method, CQ-SID (Category-and-Query constrained Semantic ID), employs category-aware and query-item contrastive learning along with Residual Quantized VAEs to encode items into hierarchical semantic cluster identifiers, significantly reducing beam search complexity. Additionally, we develop EG-GRPO (Expert-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning approach that aligns generative recall with downstream ranking under sparse rewards by injecting ground-truth samples to stabilize training. Offline experiments on TmallAPP search logs show that CQ-SID achieves up to 26.76% and 11.11% relative gains in semantic and personalized click hitrate over RQ-VAE baselines, while halving beam search size. EG-GRPO further improves multi-objective performance. Online A/B tests confirm gains in GMV (+1.15%) and UCTCVR (+0.40%). The generative recall channel now contributes substantially in production, accounting for over 50.25% of exposures, 58.96% of clicks, and 72.63% of purchases, demonstrating a viable path for deploying generative retrieval in real-world e-commerce systems.

analysis.key_results: 离线实验在TmallAPP搜索日志上显示CQ-SID相比RQ-VAE基线在语义点击命中率和个性化点击命中率上分别提升26.76%和11.11%，同时束搜索大小减半；EG-GRPO进一步提升多目标性能；在线A/B测试GMV提升1.15%，UCTCVR提升0.40%，生成式召回曝光占比超过50.25%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CQ-SID（类别与查询约束的语义ID）和EG-GRPO（专家引导组相对策略优化），将生成式检索作为召回阶段的补充，以解决工业级电商搜索中的效率与效果问题。
analysis.method: CQ-SID采用类别感知和查询-商品对比学习，结合残差量化VAE将商品编码为层次化语义聚类标识符；EG-GRPO通过注入真实样本的强化学习在稀疏奖励下对齐生成式召回与下游排序。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种用于电商搜索召回的高效生成式检索框架，通过语义聚类ID和专家引导强化学习降低计算复杂度并提升业务指标。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于电商搜索中的生成式检索效率优化，使用了残差量化VAE（RQ-VAE）进行商品语义ID编码，属于模型量化在非机器人领域的应用。本站主题为VLA（视觉-语言-动作）和WAM（世界-动作模型），本文不涉及机器人策略或动作预测，因此无直接关系，但其量化编码和高效推理思想对VLA/WAM中的语义压缩可能具有方法论参考价值。

papers.abstract: Specialized language models for translating natural language (NL) into SystemVerilog assertions (SVA) reach approximately 76\% accuracy on NL2SVA-Human, but aggregate scores obscure errors on bounded-delay and liveness specifications. Models often reuse a small set of implication templates where different temporal behavior is required. Supervised fine-tuning rewards agreement with reference tokens, whereas SVA correctness depends on property equivalence. We propose \emph{reward-weighted on-policy distillation} (RWOPD), which uses an open SymbiYosys+Z3 property-equivalence checker to select student rollouts and weight their distillation loss. A frozen 14B teacher supplies forward Kullback--Leibler (KL) supervision at each response token; equivalent rollouts receive greater weight than one-sided implications. Starting from curriculum supervised fine-tuning (SFT), RWOPD distills CodeV-SVA-14B into a Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct student. The student has the highest reported pass@1, pass@5, and pass@10 on NL2SVA-Human and NL2SVA-Machine among the compared models, including specialized baselines and 671B general-purpose models.

analysis.key_results: 在NL2SVA-Human和NL2SVA-Machine上，学生模型达到报告的最高pass@1、pass@5和pass@10，优于专用基线和671B通用模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出奖励加权在线策略蒸馏（RWOPD），用性质等价验证器对等价rollout赋予更高权重，结合前向KL监督，实现高效模型蒸馏。
analysis.method: 使用SymbiYosys+Z3性质等价检查器选择学生rollout并加权蒸馏损失；冻结的14B教师模型提供逐token前向KL监督；从课程SFT开始，蒸馏CodeV-SVA-14B到Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出奖励加权在线策略蒸馏（RWOPD），利用开放性质等价验证器将14B教师模型蒸馏为7B学生模型，在NL2SVA任务上取得最佳pass@k。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于自然语言到SystemVerilog断言的模型蒸馏，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域。其奖励加权蒸馏方法对高效推理有通用参考价值，但与VLA/WAM无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have heterogeneous strengths across OCR, chart understanding, spatial reasoning, visual question answering, cost, and latency. Effective MLLM routing therefore requires more than estimating query difficulty: a router must match the multimodal requirements of the current image-question input with the capabilities of each candidate model. We propose LatentRouter, a router that formulates MLLM routing as counterfactual multimodal utility prediction. Given an image-question query, LatentRouter extracts learned multimodal routing capsules, represents each candidate MLLM with a model capability token, and performs latent communication between these states to estimate how each model would perform if selected. A distributional outcome head predicts model-specific counterfactual quality, while a bounded capsule correction refines close decisions without allowing residual signals to dominate the prediction. The resulting utility-based policy supports performance-oriented and performance-cost routing, and handles changing candidate pools through shared per-model scoring with availability masking. Experiments on MMR-Bench and VL-RouterBench show that LatentRouter outperforms fixed-model, feature-level, and learned-router baselines. Additional analyses show that the gains are strongest on multimodal task groups where model choice depends on visual, layout-sensitive, or reasoning-oriented requirements, and that latent communication is the main contributor to the improvement. The code is available at: https://github.com/LabRAI/LatentRouter.

analysis.key_results: 在MMR-Bench和VL-RouterBench上，LatentRouter优于固定模型、特征级和学习型路由器基线；额外分析表明在视觉、布局敏感或推理导向的任务组上增益最大，且潜在通信是主要贡献因素。

papers.abstract: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves large vision--language models, but visual information often fades during generation, limiting long-horizon multimodal reasoning. Existing methods either re-inject vision at inference or train policies for stronger grounding, but where to intervene relies on perception heuristics rather than principled gain analysis, and how local visual influence propagates remains implicit. We study this problem from an information-theoretic standpoint and derive a lower bound on the downstream visual gain of a one-step intervention, which suggests two factors: local branching room (token entropy) and downstream visual propagation potential (suffix divergence from a vision-marginalized reference). Guided by this analysis, we propose reflection-anchor policy optimization (RAPO), a GRPO-based policy optimization method that selects high-entropy reflection anchors and optimizes a chain-masked finite-window KL surrogate for downstream visual dependence. Experiments on reasoning-intensive and general-domain benchmarks show that RAPO delivers substantial gains over strong baselines across multiple LVLM backbones. Mechanism analyses further indicate that reflection anchors are enriched for visually sensitive decision points and that RAPO increases contrastive visual-dependence signals along generated trajectories.

analysis.key_results: 在多个推理密集型和通用领域基准上，RAPO相比强基线有显著提升；机制分析表明反射锚点富含视觉敏感决策点，且RAPO增加了生成轨迹中的对比视觉依赖信号。
analysis.main_contribution: 从信息论角度推导单步干预的下游视觉增益下界，并据此提出反射锚点策略优化（RAPO），通过选择高熵反射锚点和优化链掩码有限窗口KL代理来增强视觉依赖性。
analysis.method: RAPO：基于GRPO的策略优化方法，选择高熵反射锚点，并优化链掩码有限窗口KL代理以增强下游视觉依赖性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文从信息论角度研究长链视觉语言模型推理中视觉信息衰减问题，提出反射锚点策略优化方法（RAPO）以增强下游视觉依赖性。

papers.abstract: World models for deformable objects should recover not only geometry and appearance, but also underlying physical dynamics, interaction grounding, and material behavior. Learning such a model from real videos is challenging because deformable linear, planar, and volumetric objects evolve under high-dimensional deformation, noisy interactions, and complex material response. The model must infer a physical state from visual observations, roll it forward under new interactions, and render the resulting dynamics with high visual fidelity. We therefore present DeformMaster, a video-derived interactive physics-neural world model that turns real interaction videos into an online interactive model of deformable objects within a unified dynamics-and-appearance framework. DeformMaster preserves structured physical rollout while using a neural residual to compensate for unmodeled effects, grounds sparse hand motion as distributed compliant actuators for hand-continuum interaction, represents material response with spatially varying constitutive experts, and drives high-fidelity 4D appearance from the predicted physical evolution. Experiments on real-world deformable-object sequences demonstrate DeformMaster's ability to roll out future dynamics and render dynamic appearance, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines while supporting novel action rollout, material-parameter variation, and dynamic novel-view synthesis. Code and video demos are available at the project page: https://can-lee.github.io/deformmaster-web/

analysis.key_results: 在真实可变形物体序列上，DeformMaster在预测未来动态和渲染动态外观方面优于现有基线，并支持新动作推出、材料参数变化和动态新视角合成。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DeformMaster，一个统一的动力学-外观框架，将真实交互视频转化为可变形物体的在线交互式物理-神经世界模型。
analysis.method: 结构化物理推进结合神经残差补偿；将稀疏手部运动建模为分布式柔顺致动器；空间变化的本构专家表示材料响应；预测的物理演化驱动高保真4D外观渲染。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DeformMaster从真实交互视频中学习可变形物体的物理-神经世界模型，实现动态预测与高保真渲染。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接属于WAM（世界行动模型）范畴，侧重于可变形物体的交互式世界建模，对机器人操作中可变形对象的手-物体交互预测和策略学习具有重要价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by using a fast draft model to generate tokens and a more accurate target model to verify them. Its performance depends on the $\textit{acceptance length}$, or number of draft tokens accepted by the target. Our studies show that the acceptance length of even state-of-the-art speculators, like DFlash, EAGLE-3, and PARD, degrades with generation length, reaching values close to 1 (i.e., no speedup) within a few thousand output tokens, making speculators ineffective for long-response tasks. Acceptance lengths decline because most speculators are trained offline on short sequences, but are forced to match the target on much longer outputs at inference, well beyond their training distribution. To address this issue, we propose $\textit{Test-Time Speculation (TTS)}$, an online distillation approach that continuously adapts the speculator at test time. TTS leverages the key insight that the token verification step already invokes the target model for each draft token, providing the training signal needed to adapt the draft at no additional cost. Treating the draft as the student and the target as the teacher, TTS adjusts the draft over several speculation rounds, with each update improving the draft's accuracy as generation proceeds. Our results across ten models from the Qwen-3, Qwen-3.5, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-OSS, MiniMax, and Llama3.1 families show that TTS improves acceptance lengths over state-of-the-art speculators by up to $72\%$ and $41\%$ on average, with the benefits scaling with generation lengths.

analysis.key_results: 在 Qwen-3, Qwen-3.5, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-OSS, MiniMax, Llama3.1 等十个模型上，TTS 相比最先进推测器将接受长度最多提升 72%，平均提升 41%，且收益随生成长度增加而扩大。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出测试时推测（TTS）在线蒸馏方法，持续自适应草稿模型，解决长生成中接受长度退化问题。
analysis.method: 将草稿模型视为学生，目标模型视为教师，利用验证步骤中目标模型对每个草稿 token 的评估作为训练信号，在测试时多个推测轮次中在线更新草稿模型。

papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) learn manipulation by predicting actions and future observations, yet their success drops sharply when the camera viewpoint, object layout or robot initial state changes. Such changes keep the instructed object the same but alter the appearance and pose features the policy observes, which in standard attention also form the keys that locate the object. We introduce OA-WAM, an object-addressable WAM that finds each object by an identity address fixed for the episode and reads its changing state. In every layer of a pretrained multimodal trunk, object-slot keys depend only on the address and frame position, and values carry the current state; the same addresses key the action pointer and index per-object forecasts, which can trigger re-grounding. Fine-tuned on standard LIBERO demonstrations, OA-WAM transfers zero-shot to LIBERO-Plus with 90.5% success, outperforming all ten published baselines. It also leads on LIBERO (99.0%) and, fine-tuned on BridgeData V2, on SimplerEnv WidowX (88.9%). On five real-robot tasks, it succeeds in 89 of 100 nominal trials, versus 73 for the strongest baseline. Ablations trace its robustness to addressing rather than to object slots: with standard attention, slots do no better than a slot-free policy, and addressing them by identity raises geometric success by 10.7 points. Forecasting the addressed objects is likewise a stronger training signal than forecasting image codes.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-Plus上零样本迁移成功率为90.5%，优于所有已发表的十个基线；在LIBERO上为99.0%；在BridgeData V2上微调后，在SimplerEnv WidowX上为88.9%；在五个真实机器人任务中，100次名义试验成功89次，最强基线为73次；消融表明身份寻址使几何成功率提升10.7个百分点，且预测被寻址对象比预测图像码更强的训练信号。

papers.abstract: Visual control maps visual streams to actions in reinforcement learning and vision-language-action (VLA) policies. Changing weather, noise, blur, and compression can obscure different task cues within one episode. Existing control benchmarks mainly test scene distractions, while generic restorers optimize whole-image fidelity. We introduce the Visual Degraded Control Suite (VDCS) to evaluate seven degradations under Markov switching. We propose Agent-Centric Observations with Mixture-of-Experts (ACO-MoE), which routes each frame to a repair expert, restores RGB content, and composes task-relevant foregrounds. On eight VDCS tasks, corruption lowers DreamerV3's mean return from 769 to 562. ACO-MoE raises it to 730, recovering 81.2% of the lost return. It also improves returns on DMC-GB and RoboSuite and retains 70% to 97% of clean-input mean return under six unseen perturbation families. We train ACO-MoE on robot demonstrations and deploy it with a 3B-parameter VLA policy on a Piper arm for cube placement in blue and white boxes and cup placement on a coaster. On the blue-box and cup tasks, motion blur and physical low light with added noise reduce success from 100% to at most 10%. ACO-MoE raises success to 75% to 95% over 20 trials per task and condition.

analysis.key_results: 在8个VDCS任务中，ACO-MoE将DreamerV3的平均回报从562恢复到730，挽回了81.2%的损失；在真实Piper臂上，将蓝盒和杯放任务的成功率从最多10%提高到75%-95%。

papers.abstract: Neural Representations for Videos (NeRV) encode video sequences within neural decoder parameters, enabling direct frame reconstruction from temporal indices. Deploying NeRV in resource-constrained settings remains challenging because reconstruction quality, model capacity, decoding cost, and numerical precision are tightly coupled. This paper presents TinyNeRV, a deployment-oriented framework for compact neural video representations based on capacity scaling, teacher-guided quality recovery, and low-precision inference. We introduce NeRV-T (0.80M parameters, 22.62 GFLOPs) and NeRV-T+ (1.68M parameters, 89.80 GFLOPs) as minimum-compute and balanced low-capacity configurations. To recover detail without increasing inference cost, frequency-focal knowledge distillation emphasizes high-frequency teacher-student discrepancies, improving PSNR on Big Buck Bunny by 0.84 dB for NeRV-T and 0.88 dB for NeRV-T+. We also evaluate weights-only INT8, INT6, and INT4 quantization using post-training quantization (PTQ), quantization-aware training (QAT), and distillation-assisted QAT. Across the seven-sequence UVG benchmark, frequency-focal distillation improves baseline PSNR by an average of 0.70 dB for NeRV-T and 0.78 dB for NeRV-T+. Across UVG and Big Buck Bunny, INT8 is nearly lossless; INT6 causes modest PTQ degradation largely recovered by QAT; and INT4 benefits from retraining-aware adaptation and teacher supervision. The results establish practical capacity-supervision-precision trade-offs for real-time, resource-constrained neural video reconstruction.

analysis.key_results: 在Big Buck Bunny上，频率焦点蒸馏使PSNR提升0.84 dB（NeRV-T）和0.88 dB（NeRV-T+）；在UVG基准上平均提升0.70 dB和0.78 dB；INT8几乎无损，INT6可通过QAT恢复，INT4受益于重训练感知适配和教师监督。

papers.abstract: Unified models (UMs) hold promise for their ability to understand and generate content across heterogeneous modalities. Compared to merely generating visual content, the use of UMs for interleaved cross-modal reasoning is more promising and valuable, e.g., for solving understanding problems that require dense visual thinking, improving visual generation through self-reflection, or modeling visual dynamics of the physical world guided by stepwise action interventions. However, existing UMs typically rely on pixel decoding as a bridge when their visual representations for understanding and generation are disjoint, which is both ineffective and computationally cumbersome. In this paper, we introduce LatentUM, a novel unified model that represents all modalities within a shared semantic latent space, eliminating pixel-space mediation for model-internal reasoning over generated visual states. By making generated visual tokens directly interpretable to the model itself, LatentUM enables flexible interleaved cross-modal reasoning and generation. Empirically, LatentUM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Visual Spatial Planning benchmark, pushes the limits of visual generation through self-reflection and demonstrates world modeling capability by predicting future visual states in the shared semantic latent space. Code and models are available at https://github.com/SJTU-DENG-Lab/LatentUM.

analysis.key_results: 在 Visual Spatial Planning 基准上达到最先进性能，通过自我反思推动视觉生成极限，并展示在共享语义潜在空间中预测未来视觉状态的世界建模能力。

analysis.method: 在共享语义潜在空间内表示所有模态，使生成的视觉 token 可被模型自身直接解释，从而支持灵活的交错跨模态推理和生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 LatentUM，一种在共享语义潜在空间表示所有模态的统一模型，以支持交错跨模态推理与世界建模。

papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially enhanced the reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing RLVR approaches typically rely on outcome-driven optimization that updates both perception and reasoning using a shared reward based solely on the final answer. This shared reward blurs credit assignment, frequently improving reasoning patterns while failing to reliably enhance the accuracy of upstream visual evidence extraction. To address this perception bottleneck, we introduce PRCO (Perception-Reasoning Coevolution), a dual-role RLVR framework with a shared policy. PRCO consists of two cooperative roles: an Observer that generates an evidence caption tailored to the question and a Solver that predicts the final answer based on this caption. Crucially, PRCO employs role-specific reward signals: the Solver is optimized using verifiable outcome rewards on the final answer, while the Observer receives a utility reward derived from the Solver's downstream success. Extensive experiments across eight challenging multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PRCO yields consistent improvements across model scales by over 7 points on average accuracy compared to the base model, outperforming prior open-source RL-tuned baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在8个多模态推理基准上，平均准确率相比基础模型提升超过7个百分点，优于先前的开源RL微调基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PRCO框架，将感知与推理解耦为Observer和Solver两个角色，并采用角色特定的奖励信号进行强化学习，以解决奖励分配模糊问题。
analysis.method: 双角色RLVR框架，包含生成证据描述的Observer和基于描述预测答案的Solver，分别使用基于最终答案的验证奖励和基于下游成功的效用奖励进行优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种感知-推理协同进化的双角色RLVR框架，通过角色特定的奖励信号提升多模态推理性能。

papers.abstract: Although current Video-LLMs achieve impressive performance in video understanding tasks, their autoregressive decoding efficiency remains constrained by the massive number of video tokens. Visual token pruning can partially ease this bottleneck, yet existing approaches still suffer from information loss and yield only modest acceleration in decoding. In this paper, we propose ParallelVLM, a training-free draft-then-verify speculative decoding framework that overcomes both mutual waiting and limited speedup-ratio problems between draft and target models in long-video settings. ParallelVLM features two parallelized stages that maximize hardware utilization and incorporate an Unbiased Verifier-Guided Pruning strategy to better align the draft and target models by eliminating the positional bias in attention-guided pruning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ParallelVLM effectively expands the draft window by $1.6\sim1.8\times$ with high accepted lengths, and accelerates various video understanding benchmarks by 3.36$\times$ on LLaVA-Onevision-72B and 2.42$\times$ on Qwen2.5-VL-32B compared with vanilla autoregressive decoding.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明，ParallelVLM将draft窗口扩展了1.6~1.8倍，并在LLaVA-Onevision-72B上实现了3.36倍加速，在Qwen2.5-VL-32B上实现了2.42倍加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了ParallelVLM，一个无需训练的draft-then-verify推测解码框架，克服了长视频设定中draft与target模型之间的相互等待和有限加速比问题。
analysis.method: ParallelVLM包含两个并行化阶段以最大化硬件利用率，并采用无偏验证器引导剪枝策略，通过消除注意力引导剪枝中的位置偏差来对齐draft与target模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ParallelVLM，一种无需训练的并行推测解码框架，通过两阶段并行化和无偏验证器引导剪枝，在长视频场景下加速视频LLM解码。
